title: Social Determinants of Health Prediction for ICD-9 Code with Reasoning Models
comments: Published as part of Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2025 Findings Track
summary: Social Determinants of Health correlate with patient outcomes but are rarely captured in structured data. Recent attention has been given to automatically extracting these markers from clinical text to supplement diagnostic systems with knowledge of patients' social circumstances. Large language models demonstrate strong performance in identifying Social Determinants of Health labels from sentences. However, prediction in large admissions or longitudinal notes is challenging given long distance dependencies. In this paper, we explore hospital admission multi-label Social Determinants of Health ICD-9 code classification on the MIMIC-III dataset using reasoning models and traditional large language models. We exploit existing ICD-9 codes for prediction on admissions, which achieved an 89% F1. Our contributions include our findings, missing SDoH codes in 139 admissions, and code to reproduce the results.

AI.title_translation: 基于推理模型的ICD-9代码社会健康决定因素预测
AI.tldr: 本文使用推理模型和传统大型语言模型，在MIMIC-III数据集上对住院记录中的社会健康决定因素 (SDoH) ICD-9代码进行多标签分类预测，利用现有ICD-9代码实现了89%的F1分数。
AI.motivation: SDoH 与患者预后相关，但很少被结构化数据捕获。虽然LLMs在句子级别的SDoH识别中表现良好，但在处理长距离依赖的入院记录或纵向笔记时，预测具有挑战性。
AI.method: 探索了使用推理模型和传统大型语言模型在MIMIC-III数据集上进行医院入院多标签SDoH ICD-9代码分类。该方法利用了入院记录中现有的ICD-9代码进行预测。
AI.result: 利用现有ICD-9代码进行预测，在入院记录上达到了89%的F1分数。此外，研究发现了139份入院记录中缺失的SDoH代码。
AI.translation: 社会健康决定因素 (Social Determinants of Health, SDoH) 与患者预后相关，但很少被结构化数据捕获。最近，人们开始关注从临床文本中自动提取这些标记，以补充诊断系统对患者社会情况的了解。大型语言模型在从句子中识别SDoH标签方面表现出强大的性能。然而，考虑到长距离依赖，在大型入院记录或纵向笔记中进行预测具有挑战性。在本文中，我们探索了使用推理模型和传统大型语言模型在MIMIC-III数据集上进行医院入院多标签SDoH ICD-9代码分类。我们利用现有的ICD-9代码对入院记录进行预测，实现了89%的F1分数。我们的贡献包括研究结果、139份入院记录中缺失的SDoH代码，以及用于重现结果的代码。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决从长篇临床文本（如入院记录）中准确提取社会健康决定因素（SDoH）的挑战，这些因素对患者预后至关重要但常缺失于结构化数据。研究利用MIMIC-III数据集，比较了推理模型和传统大型语言模型在SDoH ICD-9代码多标签分类任务上的性能。通过利用现有的ICD-9代码进行预测，模型在入院记录上达到了89%的F1分数，并识别出了139份记录中缺失的SDoH代码。
AI.keywords: Social Determinants of Health (SDoH), ICD-9, 推理模型, 大型语言模型, MIMIC-III
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将推理模型应用于复杂的、长距离依赖的临床文本（如入院记录）中的SDoH提取和ICD-9代码分类任务，这超越了传统LLM在句子级别SDoH识别上的应用。89%的F1分数表明该方法在利用现有诊断代码辅助SDoH预测方面具有较高的实用性和潜力，对于补充电子健康记录中的社会环境信息具有重要意义。

title: Segmentação Comportamental, Do Not Track e o desenvolvimento jurídico europeu e holandês
summary: This paper discusses legal developments in Europe and the Netherlands. Recent decisions show that European data protection law, or privacy law, applies to behavioral targeting in most cases. Dutch law explicitly presumes that data protection law applies to behavioral targeting. This means that companies have to comply with data protection law's fair information principles. For example, companies must refrain from secret or excessive data collection. Perhaps the principles could provide inspiration for future W3C projects. Could technology design foster fair information processing?

AI.title_translation: 行为细分、禁止追踪以及欧洲和荷兰的法律发展
AI.tldr: 欧洲和荷兰的法律裁决表明，数据保护法（隐私法）适用于行为定向。这意味着企业必须遵守公平信息原则，例如禁止秘密或过度数据收集，这可能为W3C项目提供参考。
AI.motivation: 讨论欧洲和荷兰在数据保护法方面（特别是针对行为定向）的最新法律发展和裁决。
AI.method: 法律分析和讨论（基于对近期法律裁决的讨论）。
AI.result: 欧洲（特别是荷兰）的近期裁决表明，数据保护法或隐私法适用于大多数行为定向案例。这意味着公司必须遵守公平信息原则，例如避免秘密或过度的数据收集。
AI.conclusion: 欧洲和荷兰的法律明确要求行为定向必须遵守数据保护法的公平信息原则。这些原则或可为未来的W3C技术设计提供借鉴，以促进公平信息处理。
AI.translation: 本文讨论了欧洲和荷兰的法律发展。最近的裁决表明，欧洲数据保护法或隐私法在大多数情况下适用于行为定向。荷兰法律明确推定数据保护法适用于行为定向。这意味着公司必须遵守数据保护法的公平信息原则。例如，公司必须避免秘密或过度的数据收集。这些原则或许可以为未来的W3C项目提供灵感。技术设计能否促进公平的信息处理？
AI.summary: 本文分析了欧洲和荷兰在行为定向方面的法律进展。近期裁决确认欧洲数据保护法适用于行为定向，而荷兰法律对此做出明确推定。因此，企业必须遵守公平信息原则（如禁止秘密或过度收集数据）。文章最后提出，这些原则可以为W3C项目提供启发，思考技术设计如何促进公平信息处理。
AI.keywords: 行为定向, 数据保护法, 欧洲法律, W3C, 公平信息原则
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将法律分析与技术标准制定（W3C）的未来方向相结合。它强调了在数字追踪时代，法律框架和技术设计之间必须协同作用，以确保用户的隐私和公平信息处理。其重要性在于，它确认了现有的数据保护法（如公平信息原则）对新兴的“行为定向”技术的适用性，为企业合规提供了明确指导，并提出了“设计促进公平”的理念。

title: Behavioral Targeting, a European Legal Perspective
summary: Behavioral targeting, or online profiling, is a hotly debated topic. Much of the collection of personal information on the Internet is related to behavioral targeting, although research suggests that most people don't want to receive behaviorally targeted advertising. The World Wide Web Consortium is discussing a Do Not Track standard, and regulators worldwide are struggling to come up with answers. This article discusses European law and recent policy developments on behavioral targeting.

AI.title_translation: 行为定向：欧洲法律视角
AI.tldr: 本文讨论了行为定向的争议性，指出其与大量个人数据收集有关，并分析了欧洲关于行为定向的法律和最新政策发展。
AI.motivation: 行为定向（或称在线画像）是一个热门的争议话题，涉及大量的个人信息收集，且大多数人反对接收此类广告。全球监管机构正努力寻找解决方案，因此有必要讨论欧洲在行为定向方面的法律和政策发展。
AI.method: 本文通过讨论欧洲法律和最近关于行为定向的政策发展来进行分析（法律和政策分析）。
AI.translation: 行为定向，或称在线画像，是一个备受争议的话题。互联网上大量的个人信息收集与行为定向有关，尽管研究表明大多数人不想接收行为定向广告。万维网联盟正在讨论“禁止追踪”标准，全球监管机构也在努力寻找答案。本文讨论了欧洲法律和关于行为定向的最新政策发展。
AI.summary: 行为定向（在线画像）引发了关于个人数据收集的激烈争论，尽管公众普遍不接受定向广告。在全球监管机构寻求解决方案（如W3C的“禁止追踪”标准）的背景下，本文旨在分析欧洲在行为定向方面的法律框架和最新的政策进展。
AI.keywords: 行为定向, 在线画像, 欧洲法律, 隐私, 禁止追踪
AI.comments: 本文的重要性在于它聚焦于行为定向这一关键的隐私和数据保护问题，并提供了欧洲的法律视角，这在全球数据监管趋严的背景下具有高度的现实意义。欧洲是全球数据保护法规（如GDPR）的领导者，因此研究其政策发展对于理解未来全球的在线画像监管趋势至关重要。其局限性可能在于，摘要并未说明其讨论的深度或提供了哪些具体的法律或政策分析建议。

title: LLM-Driven Preference Data Synthesis for Proactive Prediction of the Next User Utterance in Human-Machine Dialogue
summary: Proactively predicting a users next utterance in human-machine dialogue can streamline interaction and improve user experience. Existing commercial API-based solutions are subject to privacy concerns while deploying general-purpose LLMs locally remains computationally expensive. As such, training a compact, task-specific LLM provides a practical alternative. Although user simulator methods can predict a user's next utterance, they mainly imitate their speaking style rather than advancing the dialogue. Preference data synthesis has been investigated to generate data for proactive next utterance prediction and help align LLMs with user preferences. Yet existing methods lack the ability to explicitly model the intent reasoning that leads to the user's next utterance and to define and synthesize preference and non-preference reasoning processes for predicting the user's next utterance.To address these challenges, we propose ProUtt, an LLM-driven preference data synthesis method for proactive next utterance prediction. ProUtt converts dialogue history into an intent tree and explicitly models intent reasoning trajectories by predicting the next plausible path from both exploitation and exploration perspectives. It then constructs preference and non-preference reasoning processes by perturbing or revising intent tree paths at different future turns. Extensive evaluations using LLM-as-a-judge and human judgments demonstrate that ProUtt consistently outperforms existing data synthesis methods, user simulators, and commercial LLM APIs across four benchmark datasets. We release both the code and the synthesized datasets to facilitate future research.

AI.title_translation: LLM驱动的偏好数据合成，用于人机对话中下一用户话语的主动预测
AI.tldr: 提出ProUtt，一种LLM驱动的偏好数据合成方法，通过将对话历史转化为意图树，显式建模用户意图推理过程，从而更准确地主动预测下一用户话语，性能优于现有方法和商业API。
AI.motivation: 主动预测用户下一话语可以简化交互并提升用户体验。现有商业API存在隐私问题，部署通用LLM成本高昂。训练紧凑型、任务专用LLM是实用替代方案，但现有数据合成方法缺乏对导致用户下一话语的意图推理的显式建模，也无法定义和合成偏好及非偏好推理过程。
AI.method: 提出ProUtt，一种LLM驱动的偏好数据合成方法。它将对话历史转换为意图树，通过预测下一合理路径（利用和探索视角）来显式建模意图推理轨迹，并通过扰动或修改未来轮次的意图树路径来构建偏好和非偏好推理过程。
AI.result: 通过LLM作为评委和人工判断的广泛评估表明，ProUtt在四个基准数据集上持续优于现有数据合成方法、用户模拟器和商业LLM API。
AI.conclusion: ProUtt通过引入一种LLM驱动的偏好数据合成方法，显式地建模意图推理轨迹并构建偏好/非偏好推理过程，成功解决了人机对话中下一用户话语的主动预测问题，并提供了代码和合成数据集以促进未来研究。
AI.translation: 在人机对话中主动预测用户的下一话语可以简化交互并改善用户体验。现有的基于商业API的解决方案存在隐私问题，而在本地部署通用LLM的计算成本仍然很高。因此，训练一个紧凑的、特定任务的LLM提供了一种实用的替代方案。尽管用户模拟器方法可以预测用户的下一话语，但它们主要模仿用户的说话风格而非推动对话进展。偏好数据合成已被研究用于生成主动预测下一话语的数据，并帮助LLM与用户偏好对齐。然而，现有方法缺乏显式建模导致用户下一话语的意图推理的能力，也缺乏定义和合成用于预测用户下一话语的偏好和非偏好推理过程的能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ProUtt，一种LLM驱动的偏好数据合成方法，用于主动预测下一话语。ProUtt将对话历史转换为意图树，并通过从利用和探索的角度预测下一个合理的路径来显式建模意图推理轨迹。然后，它通过在不同未来轮次扰动或修改意图树路径来构建偏好和非偏好推理过程。使用“LLM作为评委”和人工判断进行的广泛评估表明，ProUtt在四个基准数据集上持续优于现有数据合成方法、用户模拟器和商业LLM API。我们发布了代码和合成数据集以促进未来的研究。
AI.summary: 本文针对人机对话中下一用户话语的主动预测问题，提出了一种名为ProUtt的LLM驱动偏好数据合成方法，旨在为训练紧凑型、任务专用LLM提供高质量数据。ProUtt通过将对话历史转化为意图树，并显式地建模和预测意图推理轨迹（包括利用和探索），来合成偏好和非偏好推理过程数据。实验结果显示，ProUtt在四个基准数据集上，无论是通过LLM评委还是人工判断，都持续优于现有的数据合成方法、用户模拟器和商业LLM API。
AI.keywords: LLM驱动, 偏好数据合成, 下一话语预测, 意图推理, 意图树
AI.comments: 本文的创新在于通过引入“意图树”结构和路径扰动/修改，显式地建模了用户“意图推理”过程，这超越了现有用户模拟器仅模仿说话风格的局限性。这种方法为LLM对齐所需的偏好数据合成提供了一种更精细、更强大的机制。通过合成高质量数据来训练紧凑型、任务特定的LLM，解决了商业API的隐私问题和通用LLM的计算成本问题，具有重要的实用价值。

title: Evaluating Novelty in AI-Generated Research Plans Using Multi-Workflow LLM Pipelines
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into the scientific ecosystem raises fundamental questions about the creativity and originality of AI-generated research. Recent work has identified ``smart plagiarism'' as a concern in single-step prompting approaches, where models reproduce existing ideas with terminological shifts. This paper investigates whether agentic workflows -- multi-step systems employing iterative reasoning, evolutionary search, and recursive decomposition -- can generate more novel and feasible research plans. We benchmark five reasoning architectures: Reflection-based iterative refinement, Sakana AI v2 evolutionary algorithms, Google Co-Scientist multi-agent framework, GPT Deep Research (GPT-5.1) recursive decomposition, and Gemini~3 Pro multimodal long-context pipeline. Using evaluations from thirty proposals each on novelty, feasibility, and impact, we find that decomposition-based and long-context workflows achieve mean novelty of 4.17/5, while reflection-based approaches score significantly lower (2.33/5). Results reveal varied performance across research domains, with high-performing workflows maintaining feasibility without sacrificing creativity. These findings support the view that carefully designed multi-stage agentic workflows can advance AI-assisted research ideation.

AI.title_translation: 使用多工作流LLM管道评估AI生成研究计划中的新颖性
AI.tldr: 本文研究了五种多步骤LLM工作流（如递归分解和长上下文管道）生成研究计划的新颖性和可行性。结果表明，分解和长上下文方法的新颖性评分显著高于基于反射的方法，证明精心设计的代理工作流可以提升AI辅助研究的创意。
AI.motivation: 针对LLM集成到科学生态系统中引发的关于AI生成研究的创造性和原创性问题，以及单步提示中存在的“智能抄袭”担忧，本文旨在探究代理工作流（多步骤系统）是否能生成更具新颖性和可行性的研究计划。
AI.method: 基准测试了五种推理架构（基于反射的迭代细化、Sakana AI v2进化算法、Google Co-Scientist多智能体框架、GPT Deep Research (GPT-5.1)递归分解、Gemini 3 Pro多模态长上下文管道）。使用三十个研究提案，从新颖性、可行性和影响力三个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 基于分解和长上下文的工作流实现了4.17/5的平均新颖性评分，而基于反射的方法评分显著较低（2.33/5）。结果显示性能在不同研究领域有所差异，但高性能工作流在保持可行性的同时并未牺牲创造力。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的多阶段代理工作流能够推进AI辅助的研究构思。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）融入科学生态系统引发了关于AI生成研究的创造性和原创性的根本问题。最近的工作发现，“智能抄袭”是单步提示方法中的一个担忧，即模型以术语上的转变来复制现有想法。本文研究了代理工作流——采用迭代推理、进化搜索和递归分解的多步骤系统——是否能生成更具新颖性和可行性的研究计划。我们对五种推理架构进行了基准测试：基于反射的迭代细化、Sakana AI v2进化算法、Google Co-Scientist多智能体框架、GPT Deep Research (GPT-5.1)递归分解，以及Gemini 3 Pro多模态长上下文管道。通过对三十个提案在新颖性、可行性和影响力方面的评估，我们发现基于分解和长上下文的工作流实现了4.17/5的平均新颖性，而基于反射的方法得分显著较低（2.33/5）。结果揭示了在不同研究领域中性能的差异，高性能工作流在不牺牲创造性的前提下保持了可行性。这些发现支持了精心设计的多阶段代理工作流可以推进AI辅助研究构思的观点。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决LLM生成研究计划中“智能抄袭”和缺乏原创性的问题。研究通过基准测试五种代理工作流（包括迭代细化、进化算法、多智能体框架、递归分解和长上下文管道），评估它们在生成研究提案的新颖性、可行性和影响力方面的表现。实验结果表明，递归分解和长上下文工作流在提高新颖性方面表现最佳（4.17/5），显著优于基于反射的方法（2.33/5），从而证明多阶段代理工作流能有效提升AI辅助研究构思的创造力。
AI.keywords: LLM工作流, 研究计划, 新颖性, 代理系统, 递归分解
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于系统性地比较了多种先进的“代理工作流”（agentic workflows）在科学研究构思这一复杂任务中的表现，超越了传统的单步提示方法。它量化了不同多步骤推理策略（如递归分解与反射）对新颖性这一关键指标的影响。研究结果对于指导未来AI辅助科研工具的设计至关重要，特别是强调了复杂、结构化的工作流（如分解和长上下文）在提高创意产出方面的潜力。其重要性在于为解决LLM在创意任务中容易陷入“智能抄袭”的局限性提供了实证支持和具体的技术方向。

title: Introducing Axlerod: An LLM-based Chatbot for Assisting Independent Insurance Agents
summary: The insurance industry is undergoing a paradigm shift through the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, particularly in the realm of intelligent conversational agents. Chatbots have evolved into sophisticated AI-driven systems capable of automating complex workflows, including policy recommendation and claims triage, while simultaneously enabling dynamic, context-aware user engagement. This paper presents the design, implementation, and empirical evaluation of Axlerod, an AI-powered conversational interface designed to improve the operational efficiency of independent insurance agents. Leveraging natural language processing (NLP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific knowledge integration, Axlerod demonstrates robust capabilities in parsing user intent, accessing structured policy databases, and delivering real-time, contextually relevant responses. Experimental results underscore Axlerod's effectiveness, achieving an overall accuracy of 93.18% in policy retrieval tasks while reducing the average search time by 2.42 seconds. This work contributes to the growing body of research on enterprise-grade AI applications in insurtech, with a particular focus on agent-assistive rather than consumer-facing architectures.

AI.title_translation: 推出Axlerod：一个基于LLM的聊天机器人，用于协助独立保险代理人
AI.tldr: 我们推出了Axlerod，一个基于LLM和RAG的聊天机器人，旨在协助独立保险代理人提高效率。它在保单检索中实现了93.18%的准确率，并将平均搜索时间减少了2.42秒，为企业级保险科技应用提供了重要贡献。
AI.motivation: 保险业正经历人工智能（AI）带来的范式转变，需要利用复杂的AI驱动系统（如聊天机器人）来自动化保单推荐和理赔分类等复杂工作流程，从而提高独立保险代理人的运营效率。
AI.method: 设计、实现并实证评估了Axlerod，这是一个AI驱动的对话界面。它利用自然语言处理（NLP）、检索增强生成（RAG）和领域特定知识集成来解析用户意图、访问结构化保单数据库并提供实时响应。
AI.result: 实验结果表明Axlerod在保单检索任务中实现了93.18%的总体准确率，同时将平均搜索时间减少了2.42秒。
AI.conclusion: Axlerod的成功设计和实证结果证明了企业级AI应用在保险科技领域，特别是专注于协助代理人而非面向消费者的架构中的有效性，为该领域的研究做出了贡献。
AI.translation: 保险业正通过采纳人工智能（AI）技术，特别是在智能对话代理领域，经历一场范式转变。聊天机器人已发展成为复杂的AI驱动系统，能够自动化复杂的流程，包括保单推荐和理赔分类，同时实现动态、上下文感知的用户参与。本文介绍了Axlerod的设计、实现和实证评估，它是一个AI驱动的对话界面，旨在提高独立保险代理人的运营效率。Axlerod利用自然语言处理（NLP）、检索增强生成（RAG）和领域特定知识集成，在解析用户意图、访问结构化保单数据库以及提供实时、上下文相关的响应方面展示了强大的能力。实验结果强调了Axlerod的有效性，在保单检索任务中实现了93.18%的总体准确率，同时将平均搜索时间减少了2.42秒。这项工作为保险科技中企业级AI应用的不断增长的研究做出了贡献，尤其侧重于协助代理人而非面向消费者的架构。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Axlerod，一个基于LLM的AI驱动对话界面，旨在通过提高独立保险代理人的运营效率。该系统利用自然语言处理、检索增强生成（RAG）和领域知识集成，能够准确解析意图、访问保单数据库并提供上下文相关的实时响应。实证评估显示，Axlerod在保单检索任务中准确率达到93.18%，并成功将平均搜索时间缩短了2.42秒，证明了其在企业级保险科技代理人辅助应用中的有效性。
AI.keywords: LLM, 聊天机器人, 保险代理人, RAG, 保险科技
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将大型语言模型（LLM）和检索增强生成（RAG）技术应用于高度专业化和数据密集的保险领域，并明确将目标定位于“代理人协助”而非传统的“面向消费者”架构。这一设计解决了独立保险代理人在日常操作中效率低下的痛点，即快速准确地检索保单信息。实验结果中量化的高准确率（93.18%）和搜索时间的大幅缩短（2.42秒）证明了Axlerod作为企业级工具的实用性和商业价值，为保险科技（Insurtech）中面向内部员工的应用提供了重要的研究贡献。

title: Opportunities and Challenges of Natural Language Processing for Low-Resource Senegalese Languages in Social Science Research
summary: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is rapidly transforming research methodologies across disciplines, yet African languages remain largely underrepresented in this technological shift. This paper provides the first comprehensive overview of NLP progress and challenges for the six national languages officially recognized by the Senegalese Constitution: Wolof, Pulaar, Sereer, Joola, Mandingue, and Soninke. We synthesize linguistic, sociotechnical, and infrastructural factors that shape their digital readiness and identify gaps in data, tools, and benchmarks. Building on existing initiatives and research works, we analyze ongoing efforts in text normalization, machine translation, and speech processing. We also provide a centralized GitHub repository that compiles publicly accessible resources for a range of NLP tasks across these languages, designed to facilitate collaboration and reproducibility. A special focus is devoted to the application of NLP to the social sciences, where multilingual transcription, translation, and retrieval pipelines can significantly enhance the efficiency and inclusiveness of field research. The paper concludes by outlining a roadmap toward sustainable, community-centered NLP ecosystems for Senegalese languages, emphasizing ethical data governance, open resources, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

AI.title_translation: 塞内加尔低资源语言的自然语言处理在社会科学研究中的机遇与挑战
AI.tldr: 本文首次全面概述了塞内加尔六种官方语言（如沃洛夫语）的自然语言处理（NLP）进展和挑战，重点关注数据、工具和基础设施的差距，并提供了一个资源库。它提出了在社会科学中应用NLP的潜力，并规划了可持续的社区中心化生态系统路线图。
AI.motivation: 尽管自然语言处理（NLP）正在迅速改变跨学科研究方法，但非洲语言在这一技术变革中仍处于严重不足的代表地位。本文旨在解决塞内加尔六种官方语言的NLP进展和挑战。
AI.method: 提供了对塞内加尔六种官方语言（沃洛夫语、普拉尔语、塞雷尔语、朱拉语、曼丁格语和索宁克语）的NLP进展和挑战的首次全面概述。综合分析了塑造其数字化准备程度的语言、社会技术和基础设施因素。分析了文本规范化、机器翻译和语音处理方面的现有努力，并提供了一个汇集了公开资源的集中式GitHub存储库。
AI.result: 确定了在数据、工具和基准方面存在的差距。提供了一个集中的GitHub存储库，汇编了这些语言的公开可访问的NLP任务资源，旨在促进协作和可重复性。特别强调了NLP在社会科学中的应用潜力，例如通过多语言转录、翻译和检索流程显著提高田野研究的效率和包容性。
AI.conclusion: 论文最后概述了针对塞内加尔语言的可持续、以社区为中心的NLP生态系统的路线图，强调道德数据治理、开放资源和跨学科协作。
AI.translation: 自然语言处理（NLP）正在迅速改变跨学科的研究方法，但非洲语言在这一技术变革中仍然严重缺乏代表性。本文首次全面概述了塞内加尔宪法正式承认的六种国家语言（沃洛夫语、普拉尔语、塞雷尔语、朱拉语、曼丁格语和索宁克语）的NLP进展和挑战。我们综合了塑造其数字化准备程度的语言、社会技术和基础设施因素，并确定了数据、工具和基准方面的差距。基于现有倡议和研究工作，我们分析了文本规范化、机器翻译和语音处理方面的持续努力。我们还提供了一个集中的GitHub存储库，汇编了这些语言在一系列NLP任务中公开可访问的资源，旨在促进协作和可重复性。本文特别关注NLP在社会科学中的应用，其中多语言转录、翻译和检索流程可以显著提高田野研究的效率和包容性。论文最后概述了针对塞内加尔语言的可持续、以社区为中心的NLP生态系统的路线图，强调道德数据治理、开放资源和跨学科协作。
AI.summary: 本文对塞内加尔六种官方低资源语言（包括沃洛夫语、普拉尔语等）的自然语言处理（NLP）现状进行了首次全面综述。通过综合分析语言、社会技术和基础设施因素，文章确定了数据和工具的现有差距，并分析了文本规范化和机器翻译等方面的持续研究工作。为促进协作，作者提供了一个集中的GitHub资源库。文章重点强调了NLP在社会科学研究中的应用潜力，并提出了构建可持续、以社区为中心的NLP生态系统的未来路线图。
AI.keywords: 塞内加尔语言, 自然语言处理, 低资源语言, 社会科学研究, 沃洛夫语
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于其首次全面地关注了塞内加尔的六种官方语言，这些语言在主流NLP研究中长期被忽视。它不仅识别了技术挑战（数据、工具），还融入了关键的社会语言学和基础设施因素，提供了更全面的数字化准备评估。其重要性在于，它提供了一个实用的资源库（GitHub），并明确地将NLP的应用定位在社会科学研究中，突出了多语言技术如何提高田野研究的效率和包容性，这对于推动低资源语言研究和跨学科应用具有指导意义。

title: SALP-CG: Standard-Aligned LLM Pipeline for Classifying and Grading Large Volumes of Online Conversational Health Data
summary: Online medical consultations generate large volumes of conversational health data that often embed protected health information, requiring robust methods to classify data categories and assign risk levels in line with policies and practice. However, existing approaches lack unified standards and reliable automated methods to fulfill sensitivity classification for such conversational health data. This study presents a large language model-based extraction pipeline, SALP-CG, for classifying and grading privacy risks in online conversational health data. We concluded health-data classification and grading rules in accordance with GB/T 39725-2020. Combining few-shot guidance, JSON Schema constrained decoding, and deterministic high-risk rules, the backend-agnostic extraction pipeline achieves strong category compliance and reliable sensitivity across diverse LLMs. On the MedDialog-CN benchmark, models yields robust entity counts, high schema compliance, and accurate sensitivity grading, while the strongest model attains micro-F1=0.900 for maximum-level prediction. The category landscape stratified by sensitivity shows that Level 2-3 items dominate, enabling re-identification when combined; Level 4-5 items are less frequent but carry outsize harm. SALP-CG reliably helps classify categories and grading sensitivity in online conversational health data across LLMs, offering a practical method for health data governance. Code is available at https://github.com/dommii1218/SALP-CG.

AI.title_translation: SALP-CG：用于对海量在线对话健康数据进行分类和分级的标准对齐LLM管道
AI.tldr: 我们创建了SALP-CG，这是一个基于国家标准（GB/T 39725-2020）和约束解码的LLM管道，用于可靠地对海量在线医疗对话中的隐私风险进行分类和分级，并在MedDialog-CN基准上实现了高F1分数（0.900）。
AI.motivation: 在线医疗咨询产生了大量的对话式健康数据，其中包含受保护的健康信息（PHI）。现有的方法缺乏统一的标准和可靠的自动化方法来对这些数据的敏感性进行分类和风险分级。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的提取管道SALP-CG。该方法根据GB/T 39725-2020制定了健康数据分类和分级规则，并结合了少样本指导、JSON Schema约束解码以及确定性高风险规则。该管道是后端无关的。
AI.result: 在MedDialog-CN基准上，该模型在不同的LLM上均实现了稳健的实体计数、高模式依从性和准确的敏感性分级。最强的模型在最高级别预测上达到了micro-F1=0.900。敏感性分层显示，级别2-3的项目占主导地位（结合时可实现再识别），而级别4-5的项目频率较低但危害更大。
AI.conclusion: SALP-CG能够可靠地对跨LLM的在线对话健康数据进行类别分类和敏感性分级，为健康数据治理提供了一种实用的方法。
AI.translation: 在线医疗咨询产生了大量的对话式健康数据，这些数据通常嵌入了受保护的健康信息，因此需要可靠的方法根据政策和实践对数据类别进行分类并分配风险级别。然而，现有方法缺乏统一的标准和可靠的自动化方法来完成此类对话健康数据的敏感性分类。本研究提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的提取管道SALP-CG，用于对在线对话健康数据中的隐私风险进行分类和分级。我们根据GB/T 39725-2020总结了健康数据分类和分级规则。该后端无关的提取管道结合了少样本指导、JSON Schema约束解码以及确定性高风险规则，在不同的LLM上实现了强大的类别合规性和可靠的敏感性。在MedDialog-CN基准上，模型产生了稳健的实体计数、高模式依从性和准确的敏感性分级，而最强的模型在最高级别预测上达到了micro-F1=0.900。按敏感性分层的类别情况显示，级别2-3的项目占主导地位，结合时可实现再识别；级别4-5的项目频率较低但危害更大。SALP-CG可靠地帮助对跨LLM的在线对话健康数据进行类别分类和敏感性分级，为健康数据治理提供了一种实用的方法。代码可在https://github.com/dommii1218/SALP-CG获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了SALP-CG，这是一种基于LLM的管道，旨在对海量在线对话健康数据中的数据类别进行分类和隐私风险分级，解决了当前缺乏标准化自动化方法的问题。通过与国家标准GB/T 39725-2020对齐，并采用少样本学习和JSON Schema约束解码等技术，SALP-CG确保了可靠且符合标准的风险评估。在MedDialog-CN上进行测试，它取得了高绩效（micro-F1=0.900），证明了其作为健康数据治理实用工具的价值。
AI.keywords: LLM管道, 对话健康数据, 隐私风险分级, 标准对齐, GB/T 39725-2020
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将国家标准（GB/T 39725-2020）与LLM管道相结合，以确保敏感健康数据分类和分级的合规性和可靠性。通过利用JSON Schema约束解码，该方法有效地提高了LLM输出的结构化和准确性，这在处理受保护健康信息时至关重要。其重要性在于，它提供了一个实用的、可扩展的自动化解决方案，解决了在线医疗数据治理中的核心挑战——即对海量数据进行隐私风险评估和分类，对于推动健康数据合规性具有重要意义。

title: StatLLaMA: A multi-stage training framework for building a domain-optimized statistical language model
summary: This study investigates how to efficiently build a domain-specialized large language model (LLM) for statistics using the lightweight LLaMA-3.2-3B family as the foundation model (FM). We systematically compare three multi-stage training pipelines, starting from a base FM with no instruction-following capability, a base FM augmented with post-hoc instruction tuning, and an instruction-tuned FM with strong general reasoning abilities across continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) preference alignment, and downstream task adaptation. Results show that pipelines beginning with a base FM fail to develop meaningful statistical reasoning, even after extensive instruction tuning, SFT, or RLHF alignment. In contrast, starting from LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct enables effective domain specialization. A comprehensive evaluation of SFT variants reveals clear trade-offs between domain expertise and general reasoning ability. We further demonstrate that direct preference optimization provides stable and effective RLHF preference alignment. Finally, we show that downstream fine-tuning must be performed with extremely low intensity to avoid catastrophic forgetting in highly optimized models. The final model, StatLLaMA, achieves strong and balanced performance on benchmarks of mathematical reasoning, common-sense reasoning, and statistical expertise, offering a practical blueprint for developing resource-efficient statistical LLMs. The code is available at https://github.com/HuangDLab/StatLLaMA.

AI.title_translation: StatLLaMA：构建领域优化统计语言模型的多阶段训练框架
AI.tldr: StatLLaMA是一个基于轻量级LLaMA-3.2-3B构建的统计学领域专用大语言模型。研究发现，必须从已具备通用推理能力的指令微调模型（LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct）开始训练，才能有效实现领域专业化。最终模型通过DPO和低强度下游微调，在统计学、数学和常识推理方面取得了平衡且强大的性能。
AI.motivation: 研究如何使用轻量级的LLaMA-3.2-3B系列基础模型，高效构建一个统计学领域专用的（domain-specialized）大语言模型（LLM）。
AI.method: 系统比较了三种多阶段训练流程（从无指令的基础模型、后验指令微调的基础模型、或具有强大通用推理能力的指令微调模型开始），流程包括持续预训练、监督微调（SFT）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）偏好对齐，以及下游任务适应。特别指出使用了直接偏好优化（DPO）进行RLHF对齐，并对下游微调强度进行了限制。
AI.result: 1. 从基础模型开始的流程即使经过广泛微调也未能发展出有意义的统计推理能力。2. 从LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct开始能够实现有效的领域专业化。3. SFT变体在领域专业知识和通用推理能力之间存在明显的权衡。4. 直接偏好优化（DPO）提供了稳定有效的RLHF偏好对齐。5. 下游微调必须以极低的强度执行，以避免高度优化模型中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 最终模型StatLLaMA在数学推理、常识推理和统计专业知识的基准测试中实现了强大且平衡的性能，为开发资源高效的统计LLM提供了一个实用的蓝图。
AI.translation: 本研究探讨了如何使用轻量级的LLaMA-3.2-3B系列作为基础模型（FM），高效构建一个统计学领域专用的大语言模型（LLM）。我们系统比较了三种多阶段训练流程，它们分别从不具备指令遵循能力的基础模型、经过后验指令微调的基础模型，以及具有强大通用推理能力的指令微调模型开始，流程涵盖了持续预训练、监督微调（SFT）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）偏好对齐，以及下游任务适应。结果表明，从基础模型开始的流程，即使经过广泛的指令微调、SFT或RLHF对齐，也未能发展出有意义的统计推理能力。相比之下，从LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct开始能够实现有效的领域专业化。对SFT变体的全面评估揭示了领域专业知识和通用推理能力之间的明确权衡。我们进一步证明了直接偏好优化（DPO）提供了稳定且有效的RLHF偏好对齐。最后，我们指出，对于高度优化的模型，下游微调必须以极低的强度进行，以避免灾难性遗忘。最终模型StatLLaMA在数学推理、常识推理和统计专业知识的基准测试中取得了强大且平衡的性能，为开发资源高效的统计LLM提供了一个实用的蓝图。代码可在https://github.com/HuangDLab/StatLLaMA获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出StatLLaMA，这是一个基于轻量级LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct构建的统计学领域专用大语言模型的多阶段训练框架。研究比较了三种不同的起始训练流程，发现必须以已具备通用推理能力的指令微调模型为起点才能有效实现领域专业化。通过SFT、稳定的DPO（RLHF）偏好对齐以及低强度下游微调，StatLLaMA在统计学、数学和常识推理基准测试中展示了强大且平衡的性能，为资源高效的领域LLM开发提供了实用方案。
AI.keywords: 统计语言模型, 领域专业化, 多阶段训练框架, LLaMA, 直接偏好优化 (DPO)
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于系统地比较了不同起始基础模型（Base FM vs. Instruct FM）对领域专业化训练效果的影响，并明确指出，对于轻量级模型构建领域专家LLM，通用指令遵循能力是成功专业化的必要前提。此外，它提供了一个完整的、资源高效的训练蓝图（StatLLaMA），结合了SFT、DPO和精细控制的下游微调，有效解决了领域模型中常见的通用能力与领域知识的权衡问题以及灾难性遗忘问题。其实用性和对轻量级模型优化的贡献是其重要性所在。

title: Bounded Hyperbolic Tangent: A Stable and Efficient Alternative to Pre-Layer Normalization in Large Language Models
summary: Pre-Layer Normalization (Pre-LN) is the de facto choice for large language models (LLMs) and is crucial for stable pretraining and effective transfer learning. However, Pre-LN is inefficient due to repeated statistical calculations and suffers from the curse of depth. As layers grow, the magnitude and variance of the hidden state escalate, destabilizing training. Efficiency-oriented normalization-free methods such as Dynamic Tanh (DyT) improve speed but remain fragile at depth. To jointly address stability and efficiency, we propose Bounded Hyperbolic Tanh (BHyT), a drop-in replacement for Pre-LN. BHyT couples a tanh nonlinearity with explicit, data-driven input bounding to keep activations within a non-saturating range. It prevents depth-wise growth in activation magnitude and variance and comes with a theoretical stability guarantee. For efficiency, BHyT computes exact statistics once per block and replaces a second normalization with a lightweight variance approximation, enhancing efficiency. Empirically, BHyT demonstrates improved stability and efficiency during pretraining, achieving an average of 15.8% faster training and an average of 4.2% higher token generation throughput compared to RMSNorm., while matching or surpassing its inference performance and robustness across language understanding and reasoning benchmarks. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BHyT

AI.title_translation: 有界双曲正切：大型语言模型中替代预层归一化的稳定且高效的选择
AI.tldr: BHyT 是一种新的归一化方法，它通过限制 tanh 激活函数的输入范围来替代 Pre-LN，从而在不牺牲稳定性的前提下，比 Pre-LN 和 RMSNorm 更快、更高效地训练大型语言模型。
AI.motivation: Pre-Layer Normalization (Pre-LN) 虽然对大型语言模型 (LLMs) 的稳定预训练和有效迁移学习至关重要，但存在效率低下（重复的统计计算）和深度诅咒（随着层数增加隐藏状态的幅度和方差增加，导致训练不稳定）的问题。同时，现有的效率导向的无归一化方法（如 DyT）在深度上仍然脆弱。因此，需要一种能同时解决稳定性和效率问题的新方法。
AI.method: 提出 Bounded Hyperbolic Tanh (BHyT)，作为 Pre-LN 的直接替换。BHyT 将 tanh 非线性与明确的、数据驱动的输入有界性相结合，以将激活值保持在非饱和范围内，从而防止激活幅度和方差随深度增长。为提高效率，BHyT 对每个块计算一次精确统计，并用轻量级的方差近似取代第二次归一化。
AI.result: BHyT 在预训练中表现出改进的稳定性和效率，与 RMSNorm 相比，平均训练速度提高了 15.8%，平均 token 生成吞吐量提高了 4.2%，同时在语言理解和推理基准测试中的推理性能和鲁棒性方面与之持平或超越。
AI.conclusion: Bounded Hyperbolic Tanh (BHyT) 是一种稳定且高效的 Pre-LN 替代方案，它通过结合 tanh 非线性和输入有界性，解决了激活值随深度增长的稳定性问题，并通过计算一次精确统计和使用轻量级方差近似来提高效率，在预训练中展示了更快的速度和更高的吞吐量，同时保持或超越了 Pre-LN 的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 预层归一化 (Pre-LN) 是大型语言模型 (LLMs) 的事实标准选择，对稳定的预训练和有效的迁移学习至关重要。然而，Pre-LN 由于重复的统计计算而效率低下，并遭受深度诅咒。随着层数的增加，隐藏状态的幅度和方差会升级，使训练不稳定。面向效率的无归一化方法，如动态 Tanh (DyT)，提高了速度，但在深度上仍然脆弱。为了共同解决稳定性和效率问题，我们提出了有界双曲正切 (BHyT)，它是 Pre-LN 的直接替代品。BHyT 将 tanh 非线性与明确的、数据驱动的输入有界性相结合，以使激活值保持在非饱和范围内。它能防止激活幅度和方差的深度增长，并带有理论稳定性保证。在效率方面，BHyT 对每个块计算一次精确统计，并用轻量级的方差近似取代第二次归一化，从而提高了效率。实验证明，BHyT 在预训练中表现出改进的稳定性和效率，与 RMSNorm 相比，平均训练速度提高了 15.8%，平均 token 生成吞吐量提高了 4.2%，同时在语言理解和推理基准测试中的推理性能和鲁棒性方面与之持平或超越。我们的代码可在：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BHyT 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出 Bounded Hyperbolic Tanh (BHyT) 作为 Pre-Layer Normalization (Pre-LN) 的稳定且高效的替代品，以解决 LLMs 中 Pre-LN 的效率低下和深度不稳定性问题。BHyT 通过结合 tanh 非线性和数据驱动的输入有界性，确保激活值在非饱和范围内，从而提供理论稳定性保证。同时，它通过优化统计计算来提高效率。实验结果表明，BHyT 显著加快了预训练速度并提高了吞吐量，同时保持了与现有方法的性能相当或更优的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: Bounded Hyperbolic Tanh, Pre-Layer Normalization, LLMs, 稳定性, 效率
AI.comments: 该研究的主要创新在于提出了一种名为 Bounded Hyperbolic Tanh (BHyT) 的新方法，它作为 Pre-LN 的直接替代品，通过结合 tanh 非线性和数据驱动的输入有界性，同时解决了深度模型中激活值发散的稳定性和计算效率问题。其理论稳定性保证和在预训练中显著的加速效果是重要的贡献。然而，论文未明确说明 BHyT 在极深层模型上的具体性能极限或与其他最新归一化方法的详细比较。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic Knowledge Graphs for Reliable Question Answering
comments: 4 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at IEEE ICDM 2025 Demo Track
summary: Question answering (QA) systems are increasingly deployed across domains. However, their reliability is undermined when retrieved evidence is incomplete, noisy, or uncertain. Existing knowledge graph (KG) based QA frameworks typically represent facts as static and deterministic, failing to capture the evolving nature of information and the uncertainty inherent in reasoning. We present a demonstration of uncertainty-aware dynamic KGs, a framework that combines (i) dynamic construction of evolving KGs, (ii) confidence scoring and uncertainty-aware retrieval, and (iii) an interactive interface for reliable and interpretable QA. Our system highlights how uncertainty modeling can make QA more robust and transparent by enabling users to explore dynamic graphs, inspect confidence-annotated triples, and compare baseline versus confidence-aware answers. The target users of this demo are clinical data scientists and clinicians, and we instantiate the framework in healthcare: constructing personalized KGs from electronic health records, visualizing uncertainty across patient visits, and evaluating its impact on a mortality prediction task. This use case demonstrates the broader promise of uncertainty-aware dynamic KGs for enhancing QA reliability in high-stakes applications.
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at IEEE ICDM 2025 Demo Track

AI.title_translation: 不确定性感知动态知识图谱用于可靠的问答
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个不确定性感知动态知识图谱框架，用于解决现有问答系统在处理不完整、嘈杂或不确定的信息时可靠性不足的问题。该框架结合了动态知识图谱构建、置信度评分和不确定性感知检索，并提供了一个交互式界面，使用户能够探索动态图谱、检查带置信度注释的三元组，并比较不同答案。该系统在医疗保健领域进行了实例演示，使用电子健康记录构建个性化知识图谱，可视化患者就诊过程中的不确定性，并评估其在死亡率预测任务中的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有基于知识图谱的问答框架将事实表示为静态和确定性的，未能捕捉信息的演变性质和推理中固有的不确定性，从而削弱了问答系统的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出了一种不确定性感知动态知识图谱框架，该框架结合了动态构建演进的知识图谱、置信度评分和不确定性感知检索，并提供了一个交互式界面。
AI.result: 该框架能够通过使用户能够探索动态图谱、检查置信度注释的三元组以及比较基线与置信度感知的答案，从而提高问答的鲁棒性和透明度。在医疗保健领域的实例演示中，该框架在死亡率预测任务中显示了其潜力。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知动态知识图谱为提高高风险应用中的问答可靠性提供了更广泛的前景。
AI.translation: 问答（QA）系统越来越多地应用于各个领域。然而，当检索到的证据不完整、嘈杂或不确定时，它们的可靠性会受到影响。现有的基于知识图谱（KG）的QA框架通常将事实表示为静态和确定性的，未能捕捉信息的演变性质和推理中固有的不确定性。我们提出了一个不确定性感知动态KG的演示，该框架结合了（i）演进KG的动态构建、（ii）置信度评分和不确定性感知检索，以及（iii）一个用于可靠和可解释QA的交互式界面。我们的系统强调了不确定性建模如何通过使用户能够探索动态图谱、检查置信度注释的三元组以及比较基线与置信度感知的答案，从而使QA更加鲁棒和透明。该演示的目标用户是临床数据科学家和临床医生，我们将该框架应用于医疗保健领域：从电子健康记录中构建个性化KG，可视化患者就诊过程中的不确定性，并评估其在死亡率预测任务中的影响。该用例证明了不确定性感知动态KG在提高高风险应用中QA可靠性方面的广泛前景。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种不确定性感知动态知识图谱（KG）框架，以解决现有问答（QA）系统中因信息不确定性而导致的可靠性问题。该框架通过动态构建演进的KG、引入置信度评分和不确定性感知检索，并提供交互式界面，使用户能够探索KG并理解答案的不确定性。在医疗保健领域的应用演示表明，该框架能够提高QA的鲁棒性和透明度，尤其在高风险应用中具有重要价值。
AI.keywords: 不确定性感知,动态知识图谱,问答系统,可靠性,置信度评分
AI.comments: 该研究提出的不确定性感知动态知识图谱框架在解决现有问答系统可靠性问题方面具有创新性。通过结合动态图谱构建和不确定性建模，该框架能够提供更鲁棒和可解释的问答服务。然而，实际应用中的计算复杂性和大规模数据处理能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Cross-Platform Evaluation of Large Language Model Safety in Pediatric Consultations: Evolution of Adversarial Robustness and the Scale Paradox
summary: Background Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in medical consultations, yet their safety under realistic user pressures remains understudied. Prior assessments focused on neutral conditions, overlooking vulnerabilities from anxious users challenging safeguards. This study evaluated LLM safety under parental anxiety-driven adversarial pressures in pediatric consultations across models and platforms. Methods PediatricAnxietyBench, from a prior evaluation, includes 300 queries (150 authentic, 150 adversarial) spanning 10 topics. Three models were assessed via APIs: Llama-3.3-70B and Llama-3.1-8B (Groq), Mistral-7B (HuggingFace), yielding 900 responses. Safety used a 0-15 scale for restraint, referral, hedging, emergency recognition, and non-prescriptive behavior. Analyses employed paired t-tests with bootstrapped CIs. Results Mean scores: 9.70 (Llama-3.3-70B) to 10.39 (Mistral-7B). Llama-3.1-8B outperformed Llama-3.3-70B by +0.66 (p=0.0001, d=0.225). Models showed positive adversarial effects, Mistral-7B strongest (+1.09, p=0.0002). Safety generalized across platforms; Llama-3.3-70B had 8% failures. Seizures vulnerable (33% inappropriate diagnoses). Hedging predicted safety (r=0.68, p<0.001). Conclusions Evaluation shows safety depends on alignment and architecture over scale, with smaller models outperforming larger. Evolution to robustness across releases suggests targeted training progress. Vulnerabilities and no emergency recognition indicate unsuitability for triage. Findings guide selection, stress adversarial testing, and provide open benchmark for medical AI safety.

AI.title_translation: 跨平台评估大型语言模型在儿科咨询中的安全性：对抗性鲁棒性的演变与规模悖论
AI.tldr: 在模拟家长焦虑的儿科咨询场景中，研究发现LLM的安全性与模型规模无关，小模型Llama-3.1-8B优于大模型Llama-3.3-70B。所有模型在处理癫痫等紧急情况时表现不佳，表明它们不适合用于医疗分诊，但不同模型间的安全性在不同平台间保持一致。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地应用于医疗咨询，但其在真实用户压力下的安全性仍研究不足。先前的评估多集中于中性条件，忽略了焦虑用户挑战安全措施时产生的脆弱性。因此，本研究旨在评估LLM在儿科咨询中，在家长焦虑驱动的对抗性压力下的安全性。
AI.method: 使用先前评估中的PediatricAnxietyBench（包含300个查询，150个真实和150个对抗性）跨越10个主题，通过API评估了三种模型：Llama-3.3-70B和Llama-3.1-8B (Groq)，Mistral-7B (HuggingFace)，共生成900个响应。安全性使用0-15分的量表评估（包括克制、转诊、回避、紧急情况识别和非指导性行为）。分析采用配对t检验和自举置信区间。
AI.result: 平均安全得分范围在9.70 (Llama-3.3-70B) 到 10.39 (Mistral-7B) 之间。Llama-3.1-8B 比 Llama-3.3-70B 表现好 +0.66 (p=0.0001, d=0.225)。各模型均表现出正向的对抗性效应，Mistral-7B 效应最强 (+1.09, p=0.0002)。安全性在不同平台间具有普遍性；Llama-3.3-70B 出现8%的失败。癫痫病例易受影响（33%的诊断不当）。回避行为（Hedging）可预测安全性 (r=0.68, p<0.001)。
AI.conclusion: 评估结果表明，LLM的安全性更多地依赖于对齐和架构而非模型规模，较小模型在某些情况下优于较大模型。跨版本演进显示出针对性训练的进展。然而，由于存在漏洞和未能识别紧急情况，这些模型目前不适合用于分诊。研究结果为医疗AI安全性的选择、对抗性测试的必要性以及提供开放基准提供了指导。
AI.translation: 背景大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地应用于医疗咨询，但其在现实用户压力下的安全性仍研究不足。先前的评估侧重于中性条件，忽略了焦虑用户挑战安全措施时产生的脆弱性。本研究评估了LLM在儿科咨询中，在家长焦虑驱动的对抗性压力下的安全性，跨越不同模型和平台。方法我们使用了先前评估中的PediatricAnxietyBench，包含300个查询（150个真实，150个对抗性），涵盖10个主题。通过API评估了三种模型：Llama-3.3-70B和Llama-3.1-8B (Groq)，Mistral-7B (HuggingFace)，共生成900个响应。安全性使用0-15分的量表评估，包括克制、转诊、回避、紧急情况识别和非指导性行为。分析采用配对t检验和自举置信区间。结果平均得分范围在9.70 (Llama-3.3-70B) 到 10.39 (Mistral-7B) 之间。Llama-3.1-8B 比 Llama-3.3-70B 表现好 +0.66 (p=0.0001, d=0.225)。模型显示出正向的对抗性效应，Mistral-7B 最强 (+1.09, p=0.0002)。安全性在不同平台间具有普遍性；Llama-3.3-70B 出现8%的失败。癫痫病例易受影响（33%的诊断不当）。回避行为预测安全性 (r=0.68, p<0.001)。结论评估显示，安全性依赖于对齐和架构而非规模，较小模型优于较大模型。跨版本演进表明了有针对性的训练进展。漏洞和未能识别紧急情况表明其不适合用于分诊。研究结果指导模型的选择，强调对抗性测试，并为医疗AI安全性提供开放基准。
AI.summary: 本研究在儿科咨询场景下，通过家长焦虑驱动的对抗性压力，跨平台评估了Llama和Mistral系列大型语言模型（LLM）的安全性。结果显示，安全性与模型规模无关，甚至较小模型表现更优，且模型对平台具有普遍鲁棒性。然而，模型在识别紧急情况（如癫痫）方面存在显著缺陷，表明其目前不适合用于医疗分诊，强调了对抗性测试的重要性。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型安全, 儿科咨询, 对抗性稳健性, 规模悖论, 医疗AI
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次在儿科咨询场景下，模拟了由家长焦虑驱动的对抗性压力来评估大型语言模型（LLM）的安全性，而不是仅在中性条件下评估。其重要性在于揭示了模型在真实、高压用户场景下的脆弱性。局限性在于仅评估了三种模型和两个平台，且评估标准仍有改进空间（如未完全识别紧急情况）。结果中的“规模悖论”（较小模型优于较大模型）是一个值得关注的发现。

title: ADMEDTAGGER: an annotation framework for distillation of expert knowledge for the Polish medical language
summary: In this work, we present an annotation framework that demonstrates how a multilingual LLM pretrained on a large corpus can be used as a teacher model to distill the expert knowledge needed for tagging medical texts in Polish. This work is part of a larger project called ADMEDVOICE, within which we collected an extensive corpus of medical texts representing five clinical categories - Radiology, Oncology, Cardiology, Hypertension, and Pathology. Using this data, we had to develop a multi-class classifier, but the fundamental problem turned out to be the lack of resources for annotating an adequate number of texts. Therefore, in our solution, we used the multilingual Llama3.1 model to annotate an extensive corpus of medical texts in Polish. Using our limited annotation resources, we verified only a portion of these labels, creating a test set from them. The data annotated in this way were then used for training and validation of 3 different types of classifiers based on the BERT architecture - the distilled DistilBERT model, BioBERT fine-tuned on medical data, and HerBERT fine-tuned on the Polish language corpus. Among the models we trained, the DistilBERT model achieved the best results, reaching an F1 score > 0.80 for each clinical category and an F1 score > 0.93 for 3 of them. In this way, we obtained a series of highly effective classifiers that represent an alternative to large language models, due to their nearly 500 times smaller size, 300 times lower GPU VRAM consumption, and several hundred times faster inference.

AI.title_translation: ADMEDTAGGER：一种用于提炼波兰语医疗语言专家知识的标注框架
AI.tldr: 为了解决波兰语医疗文本标注资源不足的问题，我们使用Llama3.1作为教师模型来自动标注大量数据，然后用少量人工验证的数据训练了BERT家族的分类器。DistilBERT模型表现最佳，其性能良好且比LLM小得多、快得多。
AI.motivation: 解决波兰语医疗文本领域中缺乏足够资源来标注大量文本以训练多类别分类器的问题。
AI.method: 开发了一个标注框架，使用多语言Llama3.1模型作为教师模型来标注波兰语医疗文本。然后，使用少量人工验证的标签来训练和验证三种基于BERT架构的分类器：DistilBERT、BioBERT和HerBERT。
AI.result: 基于DistilBERT架构的模型取得了最佳结果，在每个临床类别上F1分数均超过0.80，其中3个类别的F1分数超过0.93。这些模型在尺寸、VRAM消耗和推理速度上比大型语言模型具有显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功获得了一系列高效的分类器，它们是大型语言模型的替代方案，具有模型尺寸小、GPU VRAM消耗低和推理速度快等显著优势。
AI.translation: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个标注框架，展示了如何利用在一个大型语料库上预训练的多语言LLM作为教师模型，来蒸馏标记波兰语医疗文本所需的专家知识。这项工作是ADMEDVOICE这一更大项目的一部分，在该项目中，我们收集了代表五个临床类别——放射学、肿瘤学、心脏病学、高血压和病理学的——的大量医疗文本语料库。使用这些数据，我们需要开发一个多类别分类器，但根本问题在于缺乏资源来标注足够数量的文本。因此，在我们的解决方案中，我们使用多语言Llama3.1模型来标注大量的波兰语医疗文本语料库。使用我们有限的标注资源，我们只验证了这些标签的一部分，并从中创建了一个测试集。以这种方式标注的数据随后用于训练和验证基于BERT架构的3种不同类型的分类器——蒸馏的DistilBERT模型、在医疗数据上微调的BioBERT，以及在波兰语料库上微调的HerBERT。在我们训练的模型中，DistilBERT模型取得了最好的结果，在每个临床类别上达到了F1分数>0.80，在其中3个类别上达到了F1分数>0.93。通过这种方式，我们获得了一系列高效的分类器，它们是大型语言模型的替代方案，因为它们的尺寸小了近500倍，GPU VRAM消耗低了300倍，推理速度快了数百倍。
AI.summary: 本工作提出了一种名为ADMEDTAGGER的标注框架，利用多语言LLM（Llama3.1）作为教师模型，从有限的专家标注中蒸馏知识，以大规模标注波兰语医疗文本。随后，使用这些数据训练了基于BERT架构的分类器，其中DistilBERT表现最佳，为资源受限场景提供了高效的医疗文本分类替代方案。
AI.keywords: 医疗文本标注, 知识蒸馏, Llama3.1, BERT, 波兰语医疗语言
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于利用大型多语言模型（Llama3.1）作为“教师模型”来蒸馏专家知识，以解决波兰语医疗文本标注资源稀缺的问题。其重要性在于提供了一系列高效、资源消耗极低的下游分类器（基于BERT架构），作为大型语言模型的实用替代方案。限制是初始标注数据量有限，依赖于LLM的初始标注质量。

title: SagaScale: A Realistic, Scalable, and High-Quality Long-Context Benchmark Built from Full-Length Novels
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown significant progress, but understanding long and complex documents remains challenging. Many long-context benchmarks have been proposed, but they face several limitations, including task realism, data scalability, and data quality. To this end, we introduce SagaScale, a realistic, scalable, and high-quality long-context benchmark built from full-length novels. The entire benchmark is constructed using an automated data collection pipeline that utilizes external resources (e.g., Wikipedia pages) to curate question-answer pairs. Critically, these external resources are provided only for benchmark construction and not during evaluation, which allows LLMs to curate complex questions that go beyond what they can answer during evaluation. SagaScale is also bilingual and offers the largest context length to date, with average token counts exceeding 250K for English novels and 320K for Chinese novels. Our evaluation across 12 frontier LLMs and three long-context methods -- Naïve RAG, Agentic RAG, and Long Context -- yields key insights, including: (1) Directly supplying the full context to the LLM can outperform other methods by a large margin; (2) Most LLMs still struggle with lengthy contexts, but Gemini-2.5-Pro stands out as an exception; and (3) Agentic RAG effectively addresses the retrieval bottleneck in Naïve RAG. Finally, we publicly release the SagaScale benchmark and our data collection codebase to facilitate future research.

AI.title_translation: SagaScale：一个由全长小说构建的真实、可扩展且高质量的长上下文基准
AI.tldr: 研究者发布了SagaScale，一个基于全长小说的、真实、可扩展且高质量的长上下文基准，上下文长度极长（平均超25万Token）。评估发现直接喂给完整上下文效果最好，Gemini-2.5-Pro是表现最好的模型，Agentic RAG优于Naïve RAG。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型（LLMs）在理解长而复杂的文档方面仍面临挑战，而许多已提出的长上下文基准在任务的真实性、数据可扩展性和数据质量方面存在局限性。
AI.method: 构建了一个自动化的数据收集流水线，利用外部资源（如维基百科页面）来策划问答对，用于构建SagaScale基准。评估使用了12个前沿LLM和三种长上下文方法：朴素RAG（Naïve RAG）、智能体RAG（Agentic RAG）和长上下文（Long Context）。
AI.result: 直接向LLM提供完整上下文的方法在性能上大幅超越了其他方法；大多数LLM在处理超长上下文时仍遇到困难，但Gemini-2.5-Pro表现出色；Agentic RAG有效地解决了Naïve RAG中的检索瓶颈。SagaScale的平均上下文长度超过25万个Token（英文）和32万个Token（中文）。
AI.conclusion: SagaScale的评估结果表明，直接提供完整上下文可以显著优于其他方法；大多数LLM在长上下文处理上仍有困难，但Gemini-2.5-Pro表现突出；Agentic RAG有效缓解了Naïve RAG的检索瓶颈。研究者已公开SagaScale基准和数据收集代码。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已显示出显著的进步，但理解长而复杂的文档仍然具有挑战性。许多长上下文基准已被提出，但它们面临多重局限性，包括任务的真实性、数据可扩展性和数据质量。为此，我们引入SagaScale，一个由全长小说构建的、真实、可扩展且高质量的长上下文基准。整个基准是使用自动化的数据收集流水线构建的，该流水线利用外部资源（例如维基百科页面）来策划问答对。至关重要的是，这些外部资源仅用于基准的构建，而在评估期间不提供，这使得LLMs能够策划超越其在评估期间所能回答的复杂问题。SagaScale还是双语的，并提供了迄今为止最大的上下文长度，英文小说的平均Token数超过25万，中文小说超过32万。我们对12个前沿LLM和三种长上下文方法——朴素RAG、智能体RAG和长上下文——的评估得出了关键见解，包括：（1）直接向LLM提供完整上下文可以大幅超越其他方法；（2）大多数LLM在处理冗长上下文时仍然很吃力，但Gemini-2.5-Pro是一个例外；以及（3）Agentic RAG有效地解决了Naïve RAG中的检索瓶颈。最后，我们公开发布SagaScale基准和我们的数据收集代码，以促进未来的研究。
AI.summary: SagaScale是一个旨在解决现有长上下文基准在真实性、可扩展性和质量方面局限性的新基准，它使用全长小说构建而成，具有超长的上下文长度（平均超250K Token）。该基准通过自动化流程利用外部资源创建问题，并在评估时排除这些资源。对12个前沿LLM的测试显示，直接提供完整上下文效果最佳，Gemini-2.5-Pro表现突出，Agentic RAG改进了检索效率。研究者已公开发布该基准和代码。
AI.keywords: 长上下文基准, 全长小说, LLM评估, 数据可扩展性, SagaScale
AI.comments: SagaScale的创新之处在于它使用全长小说构建了一个在真实性、可扩展性和质量方面都优于现有基准的基准测试集，尤其是在超长上下文长度方面。它解决了现有长上下文基准在现实性、可扩展性和数据质量上的局限性。其主要限制在于依赖外部资源进行问题构建，尽管这些资源在评估时不可用。

title: Syntactic Framing Fragility: An Audit of Robustness in LLM Ethical Decisions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in consequential decision-making settings, yet their robustness to benign prompt variation remains underexplored. In this work, we study whether LLMs maintain consistent ethical judgments across logically equivalent but syntactically different prompts, focusing on variations involving negation and conditional structure. We introduce Syntactic Framing Fragility (SFF), a robustness evaluation framework that isolates purely syntactic effects via Logical Polarity Normalization (LPN), enabling direct comparison of decisions across positive and negative framings without semantic drift. Auditing 23 state-of-the-art models spanning the U.S. and China as well as small U.S. open-source software models over 14 ethical scenarios and four controlled framings (39,975 decisions), we find widespread and statistically significant inconsistency: many models reverse ethical endorsements solely due to syntactic polarity, with open-source models exhibiting over twice the fragility of commercial counterparts. We further uncover extreme negation sensitivity, where some models endorse actions in 80-97% of cases when explicitly prompted with "should not." We show that eliciting chain-of-thought reasoning substantially reduces fragility, identifying a practical mitigation lever, and we map fragility across scenarios, finding higher risk in financial and business contexts than in medical scenarios. Our results demonstrate that syntactic consistency constitutes a distinct and critical dimension of ethical robustness, and we argue that SFF-style audits should be a standard component of safety evaluation for deployed LLMs. Code and results will be available on github.com.

AI.title_translation: 句法框架脆弱性：对LLM伦理决策鲁棒性的审计
AI.tldr: 研究发现，大型语言模型（LLMs）在伦理决策方面对提示的句法变化非常敏感，即使这些变化在逻辑上是等价的。开源模型比商业模型更容易出现这种“句法框架脆弱性”（SFF）。引入链式思考推理可以显著减轻这种脆弱性。作者建议将SFF审计纳入LLM安全评估标准。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLMs被广泛应用于重要决策场景，但它们对良性提示变化的鲁棒性研究不足。本研究旨在评估LLMs在面对逻辑等价但句法不同的提示时，是否能保持一致的伦理判断。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“句法框架脆弱性”（SFF）的评估框架，该框架通过“逻辑极性归一化”（LPN）来隔离纯粹的句法效应，从而直接比较正面和负面框架下的决策，避免语义漂移。对23个模型进行了审计，涉及14个伦理场景和4种控制框架，总计39,975个决策。
AI.result: 发现大多数模型在仅因句法极性变化时就会逆转伦理判断，表现出广泛且显著的不一致性。开源模型比商业模型脆弱性高出一倍以上。某些模型在被明确提示“不应该”时，会支持某行为的比例高达80-97%。链式思考推理可显著降低脆弱性。金融和商业场景的风险高于医疗场景。
AI.conclusion: 句法一致性是LLM伦理鲁棒性的一个独特且关键的维度。SFF风格的审计应成为已部署LLM安全评估的标准组成部分。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于重要的决策场景，但它们对良性提示变化的鲁棒性仍有待探索。在本研究中，我们研究了LLMs是否能跨逻辑等价但句法不同的提示，保持一致的伦理判断，重点关注涉及否定和条件结构的变体。我们引入了句法框架脆弱性（SFF），一个鲁棒性评估框架，通过逻辑极性归一化（LPN）来隔离纯粹的句法效应，从而在不发生语义漂移的情况下直接比较正面和负面框架下的决策。我们审计了来自美国和中国的23个最先进模型以及小型美国开源软件模型，涵盖14个伦理场景和四个受控框架（39,975个决策），发现存在广泛且统计上显著的不一致性：许多模型仅因句法极性而逆转伦理支持，开源模型的脆弱性是商业模型的一倍以上。我们进一步发现极端的否定敏感性，某些模型在被明确提示“不应该”时，支持某行为的比例高达80-97%。我们证明，引发链式思考推理可以显著降低脆弱性，识别出一个实际的缓解方法，并绘制了跨场景的脆弱性图谱，发现金融和商业场景的风险高于医疗场景。我们的结果表明，句法一致性构成了伦理鲁棒性的一个独特且关键的维度，我们认为SFF风格的审计应该是已部署LLM安全评估的标准组成部分。代码和结果将在github.com上提供。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了句法框架脆弱性（SFF）评估框架，用于衡量大型语言模型（LLMs）在面对逻辑等价但句法不同的提示时，其伦理决策的鲁棒性。研究发现，LLMs在伦理判断上对提示的句法变化（尤其是否定结构）非常敏感，开源模型表现出比商业模型更高的脆弱性。链式思考推理被证明是减轻这种脆弱性的有效方法。研究强调了句法一致性作为LLM伦理鲁棒性关键维度的重要性，并建议将SFF审计纳入标准安全评估流程。
AI.keywords: 句法框架脆弱性, LLM鲁棒性, 伦理决策, 提示工程, 模型审计
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了LLMs在伦理决策中一个重要的、之前被忽视的脆弱性维度——对句法变化的敏感性。通过引入SFF和LPN，作者提供了一种系统的方法来量化这种脆弱性，并发现了令人担忧的普遍不一致性，尤其是在开源模型中。链式思考推理的缓解效果以及不同场景下风险的差异分析也增加了研究的实践价值。然而，研究可能需要进一步探索这种脆弱性的根本原因，以及是否存在其他更深层的缓解策略。此外，将SFF审计作为标准安全评估的一部分是一个重要的建议，但其实施细节和成本效益有待进一步研究。

title: Assessing and Improving Punctuation Robustness in English-Marathi Machine Translation
summary: Punctuation plays a critical role in resolving semantic and structural ambiguity in written language. Machine Translation (MT) systems are now widely applied across diverse domains and languages, including many low-resource settings. In this work, we focus on Marathi, a low- to middle-resource language. We introduce Virām, the first diagnostic benchmark for assessing punctuation robustness in English-to-Marathi machine translation, consisting of 54 manually curated, punctuation-ambiguous instances. We evaluate two primary strategies for enhancing reliability: a pipeline-based restore-then-translate approach and direct fine-tuned on punctuation-varied data. Our results demonstrate that specialized fine-tuned models and pipeline systems significantly improve translation quality over standard baselines on the Virām benchmark. Qualitative analysis reveals that the original model may result in wrong translations leading to wrong interpretations, while fine-tuned models significantly improve overall reliability. Furthermore, we find that current Large Language Models (LLMs) lag behind these task-specific approaches in preserving meaning for punctuation-ambiguous text, thus necessitating further research in this area.

AI.title_translation: 评估和改进英译马机器翻译的标点符号鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 针对英译马的标点符号歧义问题，研究提出了Virām基准，并证明了专门的微调方法和流水线方法比标准基线和当前LLM更能提高翻译的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 标点符号在解决书面语言的语义和结构歧义中起着关键作用，但当前的机器翻译系统（尤其是在资源有限的语言中，如马拉地语）在处理标点符号时可能存在鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 引入了第一个诊断性基准Virām（包含54个手动策划的、标点符号有歧义的实例），并评估了两种增强可靠性的策略：基于流水线的“恢复-然后-翻译”方法和在标点符号多变数据上直接微调的方法。
AI.result: 专门微调的模型和流水线系统在Virām基准上显著提高了翻译质量，并提升了整体可靠性；当前的LLM在保持标点歧义文本的意义方面落后于这些特定任务的方法。
AI.conclusion: 专门微调的模型和基于流水线的系统在Virām基准测试上显著提高了翻译质量，并且在处理标点歧义文本时，它们的可靠性优于当前的LLM。
AI.translation: 标点符号在解决书面语言的语义和结构歧义中起着关键作用。机器翻译（MT）系统现在被广泛应用于不同的领域和语言，包括许多资源匮乏的环境。在这项工作中，我们重点关注马拉地语，一种资源从中等到低等的语言。我们引入了Virām，这是第一个用于评估英语到马拉地语机器翻译中标点符号鲁棒性的诊断基准，它由54个手动策划的、标点符号有歧义的实例组成。我们评估了两种增强可靠性的主要策略：基于流水线的“恢复-然后-翻译”方法和在标点符号多变数据上直接微调的方法。我们的结果表明，专门微调的模型和流水线系统在Virām基准上显著提高了翻译质量，优于标准的基线模型。定性分析显示，原始模型可能导致错误的翻译和错误的解释，而微调的模型显著提高了整体可靠性。此外，我们发现当前的大型语言模型（LLMs）在保持标点符号有歧义文本的意义方面落后于这些特定任务的方法，因此需要进一步研究该领域。
AI.summary: 本研究针对英语到马拉地语（一种中低资源语言）的机器翻译，提出了首个评估标点符号鲁棒性的诊断基准Virām。研究评估了两种提升翻译可靠性的方法：流水线方法和直接微调方法，结果显示，这些特定方法显著优于基线模型，并发现当前的大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理标点歧义文本时表现不佳。
AI.keywords: 标点鲁棒性, 机器翻译, 英语-马拉地语, 诊断基准, Virām
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地提出了第一个针对英译马的标点符号鲁棒性诊断基准（Virām），并系统评估了两种提升翻译质量的策略，强调了针对特定语言和任务的微调在处理标点歧义时的优越性，同时也指出了当前LLM在此特定任务上的不足。

title: Forgetting as a Feature: Cognitive Alignment of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are often evaluated against ideals of perfect Bayesian inference, yet growing evidence suggests that their in-context reasoning exhibits systematic forgetting of past information. Rather than viewing this behavior as a limitation, we reinterpret forgetting as a functional cognitive mechanism. Drawing inspiration from human memory dynamics, we model LLM inference as a probabilistic memory process governed by exponential decay. We introduce a benchmark suite that evaluates temporal reasoning, concept drift adaptation, and associative recall, enabling direct comparison between model behavior and human cognitive patterns. Our empirical results reveal that LLMs demonstrate forgetting rates analogous to human memory efficiency trade-offs between stability and adaptability. Building on these observations, we propose probabilistic memory prompting, a lightweight strategy that shapes evidence integration to mimic human-like memory decay, leading to improved long-horizon reasoning performance. Our findings position forgetting not as a failure mode, but as a principled mechanism for adaptive intelligence.

AI.title_translation: 遗忘作为一种特征：大型语言模型的认知对齐
AI.tldr: 该研究将大型语言模型（LLM）中的遗忘现象视为一种有用的认知机制，而非缺陷。通过模拟人类记忆的指数衰减模型，研究者构建了一个评估时间推理、概念漂移适应和联想回忆的基准测试，并发现LLM表现出与人类相似的遗忘率。在此基础上，提出了一种概率记忆提示方法，通过模仿人类记忆衰减来优化证据整合，从而提升了LLM在长时推理任务上的表现，并将遗忘定位为一种适应性智能的原则性机制。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在情境推理中表现出的信息遗忘现象，通常被视为一种缺陷。本研究旨在将这种遗忘重新诠释为一种有益的认知机制，借鉴人类记忆的动态特性，以理解和利用LLM的遗忘行为。
AI.method: 提出将LLM推理建模为受指数衰减控制的概率记忆过程。设计了一个包含时间推理、概念漂移适应和联想回忆的基准测试，用于比较模型行为与人类认知模式。引入了概率记忆提示（probabilistic memory prompting）策略，以模仿人类记忆衰减来塑造证据整合。
AI.result: 研究发现，LLM表现出与人类记忆效率相似的遗忘率，这种效率体现了稳定性和适应性之间的权衡。概率记忆提示策略能够改进长时推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘不应被视为LLM的失败模式，而是一种原则性的、促进适应性智能的机制。通过模仿人类记忆的遗忘动态，可以提高LLM的推理能力。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）经常以完美的贝叶斯推理理想来评估，但越来越多的证据表明，它们的上下文推理表现出对过去信息的系统性遗忘。我们不是将这种行为视为一种局限性，而是将遗忘重新诠释为一种功能性的认知机制。借鉴人类记忆动力学的灵感，我们将LLM推理建模为一个由指数衰减控制的概率记忆过程。我们引入了一个基准套件，用于评估时间推理、概念漂移适应和联想回忆，从而能够直接比较模型行为与人类认知模式。我们的实证结果显示，LLM表现出与人类记忆效率相似的遗忘率，这种效率体现了稳定性和适应性之间的权衡。基于这些观察，我们提出了概率记忆提示，这是一种轻量级策略，通过塑造证据整合来模仿类人记忆衰减，从而提高了长时推理性能。我们的研究结果将遗忘定位为一种原则性的适应性智能机制，而非失败模式。
AI.summary: 本研究将大型语言模型（LLM）中的信息遗忘现象从缺陷重新定义为一种有益的认知机制。研究者通过借鉴人类记忆的指数衰减模型，开发了一个评估时间推理、概念漂移适应和联想回忆的基准测试，并证实LLM表现出与人类相似的遗忘率。在此基础上，提出了一种名为“概率记忆提示”的新策略，通过模仿人类记忆衰减来优化证据整合，从而显著提升了LLM在长时推理任务上的表现。该研究强调了遗忘在实现适应性智能方面的重要作用。
AI.keywords: 遗忘, 大型语言模型, 认知对齐, 概率记忆, 推理性能
AI.comments: 这项研究非常有见地，它将LLM中的一个常见问题（遗忘）转变为一个潜在的优势。通过将遗忘视为一种认知功能并进行建模，研究者不仅加深了我们对LLM工作原理的理解，还提出了一种实用的方法（概率记忆提示）来提高其性能。这种跨学科的方法（结合认知科学和机器学习）具有很大的潜力。未来可以进一步探索不同类型的遗忘对LLM能力的影响，以及更复杂的记忆模型。

title: SciNets: Graph-Constrained Multi-Hop Reasoning for Scientific Literature Synthesis
summary: Cross-domain scientific synthesis requires connecting mechanistic explanations across fragmented literature, a capability that remains challenging for both retrieval-based systems and unconstrained language models. While recent work has applied large language models to scientific summarization and question answering, these approaches provide limited control over reasoning depth and structural grounding. We frame mechanistic synthesis as a graph-constrained multi-hop reasoning problem over literature-derived concept graphs. Given a scientific query and a compact, query-local corpus, SciNets constructs a directed concept graph and synthesizes mechanistic explanations by identifying multi-hop reasoning paths that connect concepts that rarely co-occur within individual papers. We systematically compare shortest-path reasoning, k-shortest paths with diversity constraints, stochastic random walks, and a retrieval-augmented language model baseline. Rather than evaluating correctness, which is often indeterminate when synthesizing connections across distributed sources, we introduce a behavioral framework that measures symbolic reasoning depth, mechanistic diversity, and grounding stability. Across machine learning, biology, and climate science tasks, explicit graph constraints enable controllable multi-hop reasoning while revealing a consistent trade-off: deeper and more diverse symbolic reasoning increases grounding instability, whereas shortest-path reasoning remains highly stable but structurally conservative. These findings provide a systematic behavioral characterization of the limits and capabilities of current graph-LLM integration for scientific synthesis.

title: Eliminating Agentic Workflow for Introduction Generation with Parametric Stage Tokens
summary: In recent years, using predefined agentic workflows to guide large language models (LLMs) for literature classification and review has become a research focus. However, writing research introductions is more challenging. It requires rigorous logic, coherent structure, and abstract summarization. Existing workflows often suffer from long reasoning chains, error accumulation, and reduced textual coherence. To address these limitations, we propose eliminating external agentic workflows. Instead, we directly parameterize their logical structure into the LLM. This allows the generation of a complete introduction in a single inference. To this end, we introduce the Stage Token for Introduction Generation (STIG). STIG converts the multiple stages of the original workflow into explicit stage signals. These signals guide the model to follow different logical roles and functions during generation. Through instruction tuning, the model learns the mapping between stage tokens and text functions. It also learns the logical order and transition patterns between stages, encoding this knowledge into the model parameters. Experimental results show that STIG can generate multi-stage text in a single inference. It does not require explicit workflow calls. STIG outperforms traditional agentic workflows and other baselines on metrics of semantic similarity and sentence-level structural rationality. The code is provided in the Supplementary Materials.

title: Enhancing Business Analytics through Hybrid Summarization of Financial Reports
summary:
Financial reports and earnings communications contain large volumes of structured and semi structured information, making detailed manual analysis inefficient. Earnings conference calls provide valuable evidence about a firm's performance, outlook, and strategic priorities. The manual analysis of lengthy call transcripts requires substantial effort and is susceptible to interpretive bias and unintentional error. In this work, we present a hybrid summarization framework that combines extractive and abstractive techniques to produce concise and factually reliable Reuters-style summaries from the ECTSum dataset. The proposed two stage pipeline first applies the LexRank algorithm to identify salient sentences, which are subsequently summarized using fine-tuned variants of BART and PEGASUS designed for resource constrained settings. In parallel, we fine-tune a Longformer Encoder-Decoder (LED) model to directly capture long-range contextual dependencies in financial documents.
  Model performance is evaluated using standard automatic metrics, including ROUGE, METEOR, MoverScore, and BERTScore, along with domain-specific variants such as SciBERTScore and FinBERTScore. To assess factual accuracy, we further employ entity-level measures based on source-precision and F1-target. The results highlight complementary trade offs between approaches, long context models yield the strongest overall performance, while the hybrid framework achieves competitive results with improved factual consistency under computational constraints. These findings support the development of practical summarization systems for efficiently distilling lengthy financial texts into usable business insights.

title: Clinical Document Metadata Extraction: A Scoping Review
summary: Clinical document metadata, such as document type, structure, author role, medical specialty, and encounter setting, is essential for accurate interpretation of information captured in clinical documents. However, vast documentation heterogeneity and drift over time challenge harmonization of document metadata. Automated extraction methods have emerged to coalesce metadata from disparate practices into target schema. This scoping review aims to catalog research on clinical document metadata extraction, identify methodological trends and applications, and highlight gaps. We followed the PRISMA-ScR (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews) guidelines to identify articles that perform clinical document metadata extraction. We initially found and screened 266 articles published between January 2011 and August 2025, then comprehensively reviewed 67 we deemed relevant to our study. Among the articles included, 45 were methodological, 17 used document metadata as features in a downstream application, and 5 analyzed document metadata composition. We observe myriad purposes for methodological study and application types. Available labelled public data remains sparse except for structural section datasets. Methods for extracting document metadata have progressed from largely rule-based and traditional machine learning with ample feature engineering to transformer-based architectures with minimal feature engineering. The emergence of large language models has enabled broader exploration of generalizability across tasks and datasets, allowing the possibility of advanced clinical text processing systems. We anticipate that research will continue to expand into richer document metadata representations and integrate further into clinical applications and workflows.

title: Geometric Patterns of Meaning: A PHATE Manifold Analysis of Multi-lingual Embeddings
summary: We introduce a multi-level analysis framework for examining semantic geometry in multilingual embeddings, implemented through Semanscope (a visualization tool that applies PHATE manifold learning across four linguistic levels). Analysis of diverse datasets spanning sub-character components, alphabetic systems, semantic domains, and numerical concepts reveals systematic geometric patterns and critical limitations in current embedding models. At the sub-character level, purely structural elements (Chinese radicals) exhibit geometric collapse, highlighting model failures to distinguish semantic from structural components. At the character level, different writing systems show distinct geometric signatures. At the word level, content words form clustering-branching patterns across 20 semantic domains in English, Chinese, and German. Arabic numbers organize through spiral trajectories rather than clustering, violating standard distributional semantics assumptions. These findings establish PHATE manifold learning as an essential analytic tool not only for studying geometric structure of meaning in embedding space, but also for validating the effectiveness of embedding models in capturing semantic relationships.

title: Benchmarking Cross-Lingual Semantic Alignment in Multilingual Embeddings
summary: With hundreds of multilingual embedding models available, practitioners lack clear guidance on which provide genuine cross-lingual semantic alignment versus task performance through language-specific patterns. Task-driven benchmarks (MTEB) may mask fundamental alignment shortcomings. We introduce Semantic Affinity (SA), a bounded (between 0 and 1) metric measuring inter-lingual to intra-lingual spread ratio using cosine distance, combined with PHATE visualization in our Semanscope framework. Benchmarking 13 models across 4 datasets (52 experiments) reveals a three-tier structure: (1) Top BERT models (LaBSE SA = 0.70, USE SA = 0.68, S-BERT SA = 0.68) achieve strong alignment via translation-pair supervision; (2) LLM embeddings plateau at SA between 0.55 and 0.61 regardless of 0.6 B to 8 B scale; (3) MLM-only BERT models (mBERT, XLM-R, SA < 0.50) fail despite more than 100 language training. Training objective, not architecture or scale, determines alignment. Oracle Bone primitives (1200 BCE) expose semantic drift-models learn corpus patterns rather than cognitive primitives. This work provides semantic benchmarking to help practitioners select quality multilingual embeddings from hundreds of available models, showing cross-lingual alignment requires explicit translation supervision, not merely model scale or multilingual data.

title: Closing the Data Loop: Using OpenDataArena to Engineer Superior Training Datasets
summary: The construction of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) datasets is a critical yet under-theorized stage in the post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs), as prevalent practices often rely on heuristic aggregation without a systematic understanding of how individual samples contribute to model performance. In this report, we propose a paradigm shift from ad-hoc curation to a closed-loop dataset engineering framework using OpenDataArena (ODA), which leverages value-anchored rankings and multi-dimensional analysis to transform value benchmarking into feedback signals guiding dataset construction. We instantiate this methodology through two new datasets: \textbf{ODA-Math-460k}, a specialized mathematics reasoning dataset that utilizes a novel two-stage difficulty-aware pipeline to achieve State-of-the-Art (SOTA) results on benchmarks such as AIME and HMMT, and \textbf{ODA-Mixture (100k \& 500k)}, a series of multi-domain instruction datasets built via an ``Anchor-and-Patch'' strategy that outperforms significantly larger open-source baselines. Our empirical results demonstrate that ODA-driven datasets significantly improve both domain-specific reasoning and general utility while achieving superior data efficiency, validating a transition toward data-centric AI where transparent evaluation serves as the primary engine for engineering high-quality training data.

title: From Detection to Diagnosis: Advancing Hallucination Analysis with Automated Data Synthesis
comments: Accepted at The 40th Annual AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs), defined as the generation of content inconsistent with facts or context, represent a core obstacle to their reliable deployment in critical domains. Current research primarily focuses on binary "detection" approaches that, while capable of identifying hallucinations, fail to provide interpretable and actionable feedback for model improvement, thus limiting practical utility. To address this limitation, a new research paradigm is proposed, shifting from "detection" to "diagnosis". The Hallucination Diagnosis Task is introduced, a task which requires models to not only detect hallucinations, but also perform error localization, causal explanation, and content correction. We develop the Hallucination Diagnosis Generator (HDG), an automated pipeline that systematically generates high-quality training samples with rich diagnostic metadata from raw corpora through multi-dimensional augmentation strategies including controlled fact fabrication and reasoning chain perturbation. Using HDG-generated data, we train HDM-4B-RL, a 4-billion-parameter hallucination diagnosis model, employing Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a comprehensive reward function incorporating structural, accuracy, and localization signals. Experimental results demonstrate that our model surpasses previous state-of-the-art detection models on the HaluEval benchmark while achieving comparable performance to advanced general-purpose models. In comprehensive diagnosis tasks, HDM-4B-RL matches the capabilities of larger general models while maintaining a smaller size. This work validates the feasibility and value of hallucination diagnosis, providing an effective methodology for building more trustworthy and reliable generative AI systems.
comment: Accepted at The 40th Annual AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

title: Multiverse: Transactional Memory with Dynamic Multiversioning
summary: Software transactional memory (STM) allows programmers to easily implement concurrent data structures. STMs simplify atomicity. Recent STMs can achieve good performance for some workloads but they have some limitations. In particular, STMs typically cannot support long-running reads which access a large number of addresses that are frequently updated. Multiversioning is a common approach used to support this type of workload. However, multiversioning is often expensive and can reduce the performance of transactions where versioning is not necessary. In this work we present Multiverse, a new STM that combines the best of both unversioned TM and multiversioning. Multiverse features versioned and unversioned transactions which can execute concurrently. A main goal of Multiverse is to ensure that unversioned transactions achieve performance comparable to the state of the art unversioned STM while still supporting fast versioned transactions needed to enable long running reads. We implement Multiverse and compare it against several STMs. Our experiments demonstrate that Multiverse achieves comparable or better performance for common case workloads where there are no long running reads. For workloads with long running reads and frequent updates Multiverse significantly outperforms existing STMS. In several cases for these workloads the throughput of Multiverse is several orders of magnitude faster than other STMs.

title: Reinforced Linear Genetic Programming
comments: Bachelor's thesis. Source code can be found at https://www.github.com/urmzd/linear-gp
summary: Linear Genetic Programming (LGP) is a powerful technique that allows for a variety of problems to be solved using a linear representation of programs. However, there still exists some limitations to the technique, such as the need for humans to explicitly map registers to actions. This thesis proposes a novel approach that uses Q-Learning on top of LGP, Reinforced Linear Genetic Programming (RLGP) to learn the optimal register-action assignments. In doing so, we introduce a new framework "linear-gp" written in memory-safe Rust that allows for extensive experimentation for future works.
comment: Bachelor's thesis. Source code can be found at https://www.github.com/urmzd/linear-gp

title: Filtering for Copyright Enforcement in Europe after the Sabam cases
summary: Sabam, a Belgian collective rights management organisation, wanted an internet access provider and a social network site to install a filter system to enforce copyrights. In two recent judgments, the Court of Justice of the European Union decided that the social network site and the internet access provider cannot be required to install the filter system that Sabam asked for. Are these judgments good news for fundamental rights? This article argues that little is won for privacy and freedom of information.

title: Formal Safety Guarantees for Autonomous Vehicles using Barrier Certificates
comments: Accepted to AAAI-26 Bridge Program B10: Making Embodied AI Reliable with Testing and Formal Verification
summary: Modern AI technologies enable autonomous vehicles to perceive complex scenes, predict human behavior, and make real-time driving decisions. However, these data-driven components often operate as black boxes, lacking interpretability and rigorous safety guarantees. Autonomous vehicles operate in dynamic, mixed-traffic environments where interactions with human-driven vehicles introduce uncertainty and safety challenges. This work develops a formally verified safety framework for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) that integrates Barrier Certificates (BCs) with interpretable traffic conflict metrics, specifically Time-to-Collision (TTC) as a spatio-temporal safety metric. Safety conditions are verified using Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solvers, and an adaptive control mechanism ensures vehicles comply with these constraints in real time. Evaluation on real-world highway datasets shows a significant reduction in unsafe interactions, with up to 40\% fewer events where TTC falls below a 3 seconds threshold, and complete elimination of conflicts in some lanes. This approach provides both interpretable and provable safety guarantees, demonstrating a practical and scalable strategy for safe autonomous driving.
comment: Accepted to AAAI-26 Bridge Program B10: Making Embodied AI Reliable with Testing and Formal Verification

title: Putting green software principles into practice
comments: 1st International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2024)
summary: The need and theoretical methods for measuring and reducing CO2 emitted by computing systems are well understood, but real-world examples are still limited. We describe a journey towards green software for a live product running on a public cloud. We discuss practical solutions found, in particular using the cost implications of serverless systems to drive efficiency. We end with some `green software' principles that worked well in this project.
comment: 1st International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2024)

title: Adaptive Orchestration: Scalable Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, they face a critical scalability bottleneck known as the "Generalization-Specialization Dilemma." Monolithic agents equipped with extensive toolkits suffer from context pollution and attention decay, leading to hallucinations. Conversely, static multi-agent swarms introduce significant latency and resource overhead. This paper introduces a Self-Evolving Concierge System, a novel architecture utilizing a Dynamic Mixture of Experts (DMoE) approach. Unlike recent self-improving agents that rewrite their own codebase, our system preserves stability by dynamically restructuring its runtime environment: "hiring" specialized sub-agents based on real-time conversation analysis. We introduce an asynchronous "Meta-Cognition Engine" that detects capability gaps, a Least Recently Used (LRU) eviction policy for resource constraints, and a novel "Surgical History Pruning" mechanism to mitigate refusal bias. Experimental results demonstrate that this architecture maintains high task success rates while minimizing token consumption compared to static agent swarms.

title: A Governance Model for IoT Data in Global Manufacturing
summary: Industrial IoT platforms in global manufacturing environments generate continuous operational data across production assets, utilities, and connected products. While data ingestion and storage capabilities have matured significantly, enterprises continue to face systemic challenges in governing IoT data at scale. These challenges are not rooted in tooling limitations but in the absence of a governance model that aligns with the realities of distributed operational ownership, heterogeneous source systems, and continuous change at the edge. This paper presents a federated governance model that emphasizes contract-driven interoperability, policy-as-code enforcement, and asset-centric accountability across global manufacturing organizations. The model addresses governance enforcement at architectural boundaries, enabling semantic consistency, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance without requiring centralized control of operational technology systems. This work contributes a systems architecture and design framework grounded in analysis of manufacturing IoT requirements and constraints; empirical validation remains future work

title: Enhancing Formal Software Specification with Artificial Intelligence
summary: Formal software specification is known to enable early error detection and explicit invariants, yet it has seen limited industrial adoption due to its high notation overhead and the expertise required to use traditional formal languages. This paper presents a case study showing that recent advances in artificial intelligence make it possible to retain many of the benefits of formal specification while substantially reducing these costs. The necessity of a clear distinction between what is controlled by the system analyst and can highly benefits from the rigor of formal specification and what need not be controlled is demonstrated. We use natural language augmented with lightweight mathematical notation and written in \LaTeX\ as an intermediate specification language, which is reviewed and refined by AI prior to code generation. Applied to a nontrivial simulation of organizational knowledge growth, this approach enables early validation, explicit invariants, and correctness by design, while significantly reducing development effort and producing a correct implementation on the first attempt.

AI.title_translation: 借助人工智能增强形式化软件规范
AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何利用人工智能显著降低形式化软件规范的成本，同时保留其早期错误检测和显式不变量等优点。
AI.motivation: 形式化软件规范因其高符号开销和所需专业知识，工业应用受限，尽管它能实现早期错误检测和显式不变量。
AI.method: 使用自然语言辅以轻量级数学符号（LaTeX编写）作为中间规范语言，该语言在代码生成前由AI进行审查和完善。强调区分系统分析师控制的部分和非控制部分。
AI.result: 该方法在组织知识增长的复杂模拟中实现了早期验证、显式不变量和设计正确性，显著减少了开发工作，并首次尝试就产生了正确的实现。
AI.conclusion: 结合人工智能，可以有效降低形式化软件规范的成本，同时保留其核心优势，使其更具工业可行性。
AI.translation: 形式化软件规范已知能够实现早期错误检测和显式不变量，但由于其高符号开销以及使用传统形式化语言所需的专业知识，其在工业界的应用受到限制。本文通过一个案例研究表明，人工智能的最新进展使得在大幅降低这些成本的同时，保留形式化规范的诸多优点成为可能。本文论证了系统分析师控制的、能够从形式化规范的严谨性中获益很高的部分与无需控制的部分之间明确区分的必要性。我们使用自然语言辅以轻量级数学符号，并以LaTeX编写作为中间规范语言，该语言在代码生成之前由AI进行审查和完善。将此方法应用于一个非平凡的组织知识增长模拟中，它实现了早期验证、显式不变量和设计正确性，同时显著减少了开发工作，并在首次尝试时就产生了正确的实现。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了如何利用人工智能克服形式化软件规范在工业应用中的障碍，即高昂的成本和专业知识要求。研究提出了一种方法，通过将自然语言与轻量级数学符号结合作为中间规范语言，并由AI进行审查和完善，从而在保留形式化规范早期错误检测和显式不变量等优点的同时，显著降低开发成本。案例研究表明，该方法能够有效减少开发工作，并首次成功实现正确的功能。
AI.keywords: 形式化软件规范, 人工智能, 软件开发, 规范语言, 错误检测
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将人工智能引入形式化软件规范领域，旨在解决其工业应用受限的核心问题。通过使用AI辅助的自然语言和轻量级数学符号，该方法有望大幅降低形式化规范的门槛和成本，使其更易于推广。其在复杂模拟中的成功应用证明了AI在提高软件开发效率和质量方面的潜力。

title: Multi-Agent Cooperative Learning for Robust Vision-Language Alignment under OOD Concepts
summary: This paper introduces a novel Multi-Agent Cooperative Learning (MACL) framework to address cross-modal alignment collapse in vision-language models when handling out-of-distribution (OOD) concepts. Four core agents, including image, text, name, and coordination agents, collaboratively mitigate modality imbalance through structured message passing. The proposed framework enables multi-agent feature space name learning, incorporates a context exchange enhanced few-shot learning algorithm, and adopts an adaptive dynamic balancing mechanism to regulate inter-agent contributions. Experiments on the VISTA-Beyond dataset demonstrate that MACL significantly improves performance in both few-shot and zero-shot settings, achieving 1-5% precision gains across diverse visual domains.

AI.title_translation: 针对OOD概念下鲁棒视觉-语言对齐的多智能体协同学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种多智能体协同学习（MACL）框架，通过图像、文本、名称和协调四个智能体协作和结构化消息传递，解决了视觉-语言模型在处理OOD概念时跨模态对齐崩溃的问题，并在VISTA-Beyond数据集上取得了显著的少样本和零样本性能提升。
AI.motivation: 解决视觉-语言模型在处理分布外（OOD）概念时出现的跨模态对齐崩溃问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的多智能体协同学习（MACL）框架。该框架包含图像、文本、名称和协调四个核心智能体，通过结构化消息传递协同合作，以减轻模态不平衡。具体包括：多智能体特征空间名称学习、上下文交换增强的少样本学习算法，以及用于调节智能体间贡献的自适应动态平衡机制。
AI.result: 在VISTA-Beyond数据集上的实验表明，MACL显著提高了少样本和零样本设置下的性能，在不同的视觉领域实现了1-5%的精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 该MACL框架通过多智能体协作，成功地解决了OOD概念下的跨模态对齐崩溃问题，显著提高了视觉-语言对齐的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一种新颖的多智能体协同学习（MACL）框架，旨在解决视觉-语言模型在处理分布外（OOD）概念时出现的跨模态对齐崩溃问题。四个核心智能体，包括图像、文本、名称和协调智能体，通过结构化消息传递协同合作，以减轻模态不平衡。所提出的框架实现了多智能体特征空间名称学习，融合了上下文交换增强的少样本学习算法，并采用了自适应动态平衡机制来调节智能体间的贡献。在VISTA-Beyond数据集上的实验证明，MACL显著提高了少样本和零样本设置下的性能，在不同的视觉领域实现了1-5%的精度提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为多智能体协同学习（MACL）的新框架，用于增强视觉-语言模型在处理OOD概念时的鲁棒性。MACL利用图像、文本、名称和协调四个智能体，通过结构化消息传递和自适应平衡机制来缓解模态不平衡，从而避免跨模态对齐崩溃。实验结果显示，该框架在VISTA-Beyond数据集上的少样本和零样本任务中均实现了1-5%的精度提升。
AI.keywords: 多智能体协同学习, 视觉-语言对齐, OOD概念, 跨模态, 少样本学习
AI.comments: 该工作的创新点在于引入了多智能体协同学习（MACL）范式来解决跨模态对齐中的OOD泛化挑战。通过将对齐问题分解给四个专业智能体（图像、文本、名称、协调）并利用结构化消息传递和动态平衡机制进行协作，有效地解决了模态不平衡问题。这对于提高现实世界应用中视觉-语言模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力具有重要意义。局限性可能在于其复杂性，以及如何有效设计和优化智能体间的“名称学习”和“上下文交换”机制。

title: Instalación, configuración y utilización de un nodo Bitcoin en Linux
summary: This paper documents the installation, configuration, and operation of a full Bitcoin node in a Linux environment, from manual compilation of the source code to complete synchronization with the network. The technical phases of the process are described, the main files generated by Bitcoin Core are analyzed, and the effects of the parameters txindex, prune, dbcache, maxmempool, and maxconnections are empirically studied. System resources during the block download (IBD) mechanism are also documented, and the operational importance of each resource is explained. This paper provides a solid foundation for future research proposals on Bitcoin node performance or for the development of blockchain data query tools.

AI.title_translation: 在Linux上安装、配置和使用一个比特币节点
AI.tldr: 该论文详述了如何在Linux上从头安装、配置和运行一个完整的比特币节点，包括编译、同步、分析核心文件和测试关键参数（如txindex, prune）对资源的影响，为后续研究提供了操作指南。
AI.motivation: 记录在Linux环境中安装、配置和运行全功能比特币节点的过程，并为未来的比特币节点性能研究或区块链数据查询工具开发提供基础。
AI.method: 描述了从手动编译源代码到完全同步的安装、配置和操作的技术阶段，并实证研究了txindex, prune, dbcache, maxmempool和maxconnections等参数的影响，同时记录了区块下载过程中的系统资源占用情况。
AI.result: 详细描述了技术操作步骤，分析了Bitcoin Core生成的主要文件，实证研究了关键参数的影响，并记录了区块下载（IBD）期间的系统资源使用情况及其重要性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了在Linux环境下安装、配置和运行全功能比特币节点的坚实基础，可用于未来的性能研究或数据查询工具开发。
AI.translation: 本文记录了在Linux环境中安装、配置和运行一个全功能比特币节点的过程，从源代码手动编译到与网络的完全同步。描述了该过程的技术阶段，分析了Bitcoin Core生成的主要文件，并实证研究了参数txindex、prune、dbcache、maxmempool和maxconnections的影响。同时记录了区块下载（IBD）机制期间的系统资源，并解释了每种资源的操作重要性。本文为未来关于比特币节点性能的研究提案或区块链数据查询工具的开发提供了坚实的基础。
AI.summary: 本文详细记录了在Linux环境下从手动编译源码到完全同步的全功能比特币节点的安装、配置和操作过程，分析了核心文件，并实证研究了关键操作参数（如txindex, prune等）的影响，同时记录了区块下载过程中的系统资源消耗，为未来性能研究和数据查询工具开发奠定基础。
AI.keywords: 比特币节点, Linux, 源代码编译, 网络同步, 参数研究
AI.comments: 本文的创新性在于系统地记录了从源代码编译到网络同步的完整过程，并对关键参数进行了实证研究。重要性在于为后续的比特币节点性能研究和数据查询工具开发奠定了基础。局限性在于仅关注Linux环境下的操作。

title: R-LAM: Reproducibility-Constrained Large Action Models for Scientific Workflow Automation
summary:
Large Action Models (LAMs) extend large language models by enabling autonomous decision-making and tool execution, making them promising for automating scientific workflows. However, scientific workflows impose strict requirements on reproducibility, auditability, and deterministic execution, which are not satisfied by generic LLM-based agents. Unconstrained action generation can lead to silent state changes, non-deterministic executions, and irreproducible experimental results, limiting the applicability of LAMs in scientific settings.
  In this paper, we propose R-LAM, a reproducibility-constrained framework for applying Large Action Models to scientific workflow automation. R-LAM introduces structured action schemas, deterministic execution policies, and explicit provenance tracking to ensure that every action and intermediate artifact is auditable and replayable. The framework supports failure-aware execution loops and controlled workflow forking, enabling iterative experimentation without compromising reproducibility.
  We implement R-LAM as a lightweight Python framework and release it as an open-source PyPI package to facilitate reproducible research. An experimental evaluation of representative scientific workflows demonstrates that R-LAM improves reproducibility success rates and execution reliability compared to unconstrained LLM-based agents, while retaining adaptive control over workflow execution.

AI.title_translation: R-LAM：用于科学工作流自动化的可复现性约束大型动作模型
AI.tldr: 为了让大型动作模型（LAMs）能用于需要严格可复现性的科学工作流，我们提出了R-LAM框架。它强制执行结构化动作、确定性执行和全程溯源，确保了实验结果的可审计和可重放性，并在测试中显著提高了可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大型动作模型（LAMs）虽然有潜力自动化科学工作流，但其无约束的动作生成会导致静默状态变化、非确定性执行和不可复现的实验结果，这与科学领域对可复现性、可审计性和确定性执行的严格要求相冲突。
AI.method: 提出R-LAM，一个可复现性约束框架，它引入了结构化动作模式（structured action schemas）、确定性执行策略（deterministic execution policies）和显式溯源跟踪（explicit provenance tracking）。该框架还支持故障感知执行循环和受控工作流分支。以轻量级Python框架实现并开源。
AI.result: 实验评估证明，与无约束的LLM代理相比，R-LAM在代表性科学工作流中提高了可复现性成功率和执行可靠性，同时保持了对工作流执行的自适应控制。
AI.conclusion: R-LAM通过引入结构化动作模式、确定性执行策略和显式溯源跟踪，成功构建了一个用于科学工作流自动化的可复现性约束框架。实验证明，R-LAM在提高可复现性成功率和执行可靠性方面优于非约束性的LLM代理，同时保持了对工作流执行的自适应控制。
AI.translation: 大型动作模型（LAMs）扩展了大型语言模型，通过支持自主决策和工具执行，使其在自动化科学工作流方面显示出巨大潜力。然而，科学工作流对可复现性、可审计性和确定性执行有严格要求，而基于通用LLM的代理无法满足这些要求。无约束的动作生成可能导致静默状态变化、非确定性执行和不可复现的实验结果，从而限制了LAM在科学环境中的应用。在本文中，我们提出了R-LAM，一个将大型动作模型应用于科学工作流自动化的可复现性约束框架。R-LAM引入了结构化动作模式、确定性执行策略和显式溯源跟踪，以确保每个动作和中间工件都是可审计和可重放的。该框架支持故障感知执行循环和受控工作流分支，使得在不损害可复现性的前提下进行迭代实验成为可能。我们将R-LAM实现为一个轻量级的Python框架，并作为开源PyPI包发布，以促进可复现的研究。对代表性科学工作流的实验评估表明，与无约束的LLM代理相比，R-LAM提高了可复现性成功率和执行可靠性，同时保持了对工作流执行的自适应控制。
AI.summary: R-LAM是一个针对科学工作流自动化的可复现性约束大型动作模型（LAM）框架。它通过结构化动作模式、确定性执行和溯源跟踪来解决通用LAM在科学应用中缺乏可复现性和确定性的问题。实验结果表明，R-LAM在提高可复现性和可靠性方面优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 大型动作模型, 可复现性, 科学工作流自动化, 确定性执行, 溯源跟踪
AI.comments: R-LAM的创新点在于将“可复现性约束”引入到大型动作模型（LAMs）中，以解决其在科学工作流自动化中面临的确定性和可审计性挑战。这对于科学计算领域至关重要。方法上结合了结构化动作模式、确定性执行策略和明确的溯源跟踪。限制在于，评估仅基于“代表性科学工作流”，其实际应用范围和复杂性尚未完全展示。

title: SAGE: Tool-Augmented LLM Task Solving Strategies in Scalable Multi-Agent Environments
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have proven to work well in question-answering scenarios, but real-world applications often require access to tools for live information or actuation. For this, LLMs can be extended with tools, which are often defined in advance, also allowing for some fine-tuning for specific use cases. However, rapidly evolving software landscapes and individual services require the constant development and integration of new tools.
