Finally, theoretical and numerical analyses show that our $L$-HSDP schemes significantly reduce subpacketization compared to existing schemes with exponential subpacketization, while only slightly sacrificing sum-DoF, and achieve both a higher sum-DoF and lower subpacketization than the existing schemes with linear subpacketization.

title: Unlocking Implicit Experience: Synthesizing Tool-Use Trajectories from Text
summary: Enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to effectively utilize tools in multi-turn interactions is essential for building capable autonomous agents. However, acquiring diverse and realistic multi-turn tool-use data remains a significant challenge. In this work, we propose a novel text-based paradigm. We observe that textual corpora naturally contain rich, multi-step problem-solving experiences, which can serve as an untapped, scalable, and authentic data source for multi-turn tool-use tasks. Based on this insight, we introduce GEM, a data synthesis pipeline that enables the generation and extraction of multi-turn tool-use trajectories from text corpora through a four-stage process: relevance filtering, workflow & tool extraction, trajectory grounding, and complexity refinement. To reduce the computational cost, we further train a specialized Trajectory Synthesizer via supervised fine-tuning. This model distills the complex generation pipeline into an efficient, end-to-end trajectory generator. Experiments demonstrate that our GEM-32B achieve a 16.5% improvement on the BFCL V3 Multi-turn benchmark. Our models partially surpass the performance of models trained on τ - bench (Airline and Retail) in-domain data, highlighting the superior generalization capability derived from our text-based synthesis paradigm. Notably, our Trajectory Synthesizer matches the quality of the full pipeline while significantly reducing inference latency and costs.

title: EvoMorph: Counterfactual Explanations for Continuous Time-Series Extrinsic Regression Applied to Photoplethysmography
summary: Wearable devices enable continuous, population-scale monitoring of physiological signals, such as photoplethysmography (PPG), creating new opportunities for data-driven clinical assessment. Time-series extrinsic regression (TSER) models increasingly leverage PPG signals to estimate clinically relevant outcomes, including heart rate, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation. For clinical reasoning and trust, however, single point estimates alone are insufficient: clinicians must also understand whether predictions are stable under physiologically plausible variations and to what extent realistic, attainable changes in physiological signals would meaningfully alter a model's prediction. Counterfactual explanations (CFE) address these "what-if" questions, yet existing time series CFE generation methods are largely restricted to classification, overlook waveform morphology, and often produce physiologically implausible signals, limiting their applicability to continuous biomedical time series. To address these limitations, we introduce EvoMorph, a multi-objective evolutionary framework for generating physiologically plausible and diverse CFE for TSER applications. EvoMorph optimizes morphology-aware objectives defined on interpretable signal descriptors and applies transformations to preserve the waveform structure. We evaluated EvoMorph on three PPG datasets (heart rate, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation) against a nearest-unlike-neighbor baseline. In addition, in a case study, we evaluated EvoMorph as a tool for uncertainty quantification by relating counterfactual sensitivity to bootstrap-ensemble uncertainty and data-density measures. Overall, EvoMorph enables the generation of physiologically-aware counterfactuals for continuous biomedical signals and supports uncertainty-aware interpretability, advancing trustworthy model analysis for clinical time-series applications.

title: PLGC: Pseudo-Labeled Graph Condensation
summary: Large graph datasets make training graph neural networks (GNNs) computationally costly. Graph condensation methods address this by generating small synthetic graphs that approximate the original data. However, existing approaches rely on clean, supervised labels, which limits their reliability when labels are scarce, noisy, or inconsistent. We propose Pseudo-Labeled Graph Condensation (PLGC), a self-supervised framework that constructs latent pseudo-labels from node embeddings and optimizes condensed graphs to match the original graph's structural and feature statistics -- without requiring ground-truth labels. PLGC offers three key contributions: (1) A diagnosis of why supervised condensation fails under label noise and distribution shift. (2) A label-free condensation method that jointly learns latent prototypes and node assignments. (3) Theoretical guarantees showing that pseudo-labels preserve latent structural statistics of the original graph and ensure accurate embedding alignment. Empirically, across node classification and link prediction tasks, PLGC achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art supervised condensation methods on clean datasets and exhibits substantial robustness under label noise, often outperforming all baselines by a significant margin. Our findings highlight the practical and theoretical advantages of self-supervised graph condensation in noisy or weakly-labeled environments.

title: Generalized Weight Structure of Polar Codes: Selected Template Polynomials
summary: Polar codes can be viewed as decreasing monomial codes, revealing a rich algebraic structure governed by the lower-triangular affine (LTA) group. We develop a general framework to compute the Hamming weight of codewords generated by sums of monomials, express these weights in a canonical dyadic form, and derive closed expressions for key structural templates (disjoint sums, nested blocks, complementary flips) that generate the low and intermediate weight spectrum. Combining these templates with the LTA group action, we obtain explicit multiplicity formulas, yielding a unified algebraic method to characterize and enumerate codewords.

title: FastStair: Learning to Run Up Stairs with Humanoid Robots
summary: Running up stairs is effortless for humans but remains extremely challenging for humanoid robots due to the simultaneous requirements of high agility and strict stability. Model-free reinforcement learning (RL) can generate dynamic locomotion, yet implicit stability rewards and heavy reliance on task-specific reward shaping tend to result in unsafe behaviors, especially on stairs; conversely, model-based foothold planners encode contact feasibility and stability structure, but enforcing their hard constraints often induces conservative motion that limits speed. We present FastStair, a planner-guided, multi-stage learning framework that reconciles these complementary strengths to achieve fast and stable stair ascent. FastStair integrates a parallel model-based foothold planner into the RL training loop to bias exploration toward dynamically feasible contacts and to pretrain a safety-focused base policy. To mitigate planner-induced conservatism and the discrepancy between low- and high-speed action distributions, the base policy was fine-tuned into speed-specialized experts and then integrated via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to enable smooth operation across the full commanded-speed range. We deploy the resulting controller on the Oli humanoid robot, achieving stable stair ascent at commanded speeds up to 1.65 m/s and traversing a 33-step spiral staircase (17 cm rise per step) in 12 s, demonstrating robust high-speed performance on long staircases. Notably, the proposed approach served as the champion solution in the Canton Tower Robot Run Up Competition.

title: Inverse Learning in $2\times2$ Games: From Synthetic Interactions to Traffic Simulation
summary: Understanding how agents coordinate or compete from limited behavioral data is central to modeling strategic interactions in traffic, robotics, and other multi-agent systems. In this work, we investigate the following complementary formulations of inverse game-theoretic learning: (i) a Closed-form Correlated Equilibrium Maximum-Likelihood estimator (CE-ML) specialized for $2\times2$ games; and (ii) a Logit Best Response Maximum-Likelihood estimator (LBR-ML) that captures long-run adaptation dynamics via stochastic response processes. Together, these approaches span the spectrum between static equilibrium consistency and dynamic behavioral realism. We evaluate them on synthetic "chicken-dare" games and traffic-interaction scenarios simulated in SUMO, comparing parameter recovery and distributional fit. Results reveal clear trade-offs between interpretability, computational tractability, and behavioral expressiveness across models.

title: Fine-Grained Human Pose Editing Assessment via Layer-Selective MLLMs
summary: Text-guided human pose editing has gained significant traction in AIGC applications. However,it remains plagued by structural anomalies and generative artifacts. Existing evaluation metrics often isolate authenticity detection from quality assessment, failing to provide fine-grained insights into pose-specific inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we introduce HPE-Bench, a specialized benchmark comprising 1,700 standardized samples from 17 state-of-the-art editing models, offering both authenticity labels and multi-dimensional quality scores. Furthermore, we propose a unified framework based on layer-selective multimodal large language models (MLLMs). By employing contrastive LoRA tuning and a novel layer sensitivity analysis (LSA) mechanism, we identify the optimal feature layer for pose evaluation. Our framework achieves superior performance in both authenticity detection and multi-dimensional quality regression, effectively bridging the gap between forensic detection and quality assessment.

title: Towards Efficient Low-rate Image Compression with Frequency-aware Diffusion Prior Refinement
summary: Recent advancements in diffusion-based generative priors have enabled visually plausible image compression at extremely low bit rates. However, existing approaches suffer from slow sampling processes and suboptimal bit allocation due to fragmented training paradigms. In this work, we propose Accelerate \textbf{Diff}usion-based Image Compression via \textbf{C}onsistency Prior \textbf{R}efinement (DiffCR), a novel compression framework for efficient and high-fidelity image reconstruction. At the heart of DiffCR is a Frequency-aware Skip Estimation (FaSE) module that refines the $ε$-prediction prior from a pre-trained latent diffusion model and aligns it with compressed latents at different timesteps via Frequency Decoupling Attention (FDA). Furthermore, a lightweight consistency estimator enables fast \textbf{two-step decoding} by preserving the semantic trajectory of diffusion sampling. Without updating the backbone diffusion model, DiffCR achieves substantial bitrate savings (27.2\% BD-rate (LPIPS) and 65.1\% BD-rate (PSNR)) and over $10\times$ speed-up compared to SOTA diffusion-based compression baselines.

title: A Hybrid Reliability--Weight Framework for Construction of Polar Codes
summary: Polar codes are usually constructed by ranking synthetic bit-channels according to reliability, which guarantees capacity-achieving behavior but can yield poor low-weight spectra at short and moderate lengths. Recent algebraic results express the contribution of individual bit-channels to the multiplicities of minimum and near-minimum weight codewords in closed form. In this work we combine these insights into a mixed (reliability--weight) bit-channel ordering. We define a per-bit cost whose distance term is derived from orbit enumeration of minimum-weight codewords and scaled by a Bhattacharyya-type factor, and show that the resulting mixed construction minimises a truncated SC/ML union-bound surrogate within a class of decreasing monomial codes. We relate the mixed metric to error events in SCL decoding via a pruning/ML decomposition, and prove that mixed designs act as local perturbations of reliability-based constructions whose asymptotic impact vanishes as code-length approaches infinity. Numerical results for short and moderate lengths on BPSK-AWGN, implemented via Gaussian approximation and closed-form weight contributions, illustrate the trade-off between pure reliability-based and mixed constructions in terms of minimum distance, multiplicity, and union-bound approximations. All proofs are deferred to the appendices.

title: Global Context Compression with Interleaved Vision-Text Transformation
summary: Recent achievements of vision-language models in end-to-end OCR point to a new avenue for low-loss compression of textual information. This motivates earlier works that render the Transformer's input into images for prefilling, which effectively reduces the number of tokens through visual encoding, thereby alleviating the quadratically increased Attention computations. However, this partial compression fails to save computational or memory costs at token-by-token inference. In this paper, we investigate global context compression, which saves tokens at both prefilling and inference stages. Consequently, we propose VIST2, a novel Transformer that interleaves input text chunks alongside their visual encoding, while depending exclusively on visual tokens in the pre-context to predict the next text token distribution. Around this idea, we render text chunks into sketch images and train VIST2 in multiple stages, starting from curriculum-scheduled pretraining for optical language modeling, followed by modal-interleaved instruction tuning. We conduct extensive experiments using VIST2 families scaled from 0.6B to 8B to explore the training recipe and hyperparameters. With a 4$\times$ compression ratio, the resulting models demonstrate significant superiority over baselines on long writing tasks, achieving, on average, a 3$\times$ speedup in first-token generation, 77% reduction in memory usage, and 74% reduction in FLOPS. Our codes and datasets will be public to support further studies.

title: Online identification of nonlinear time-varying systems with uncertain information
summary: Digital twins (DTs), serving as the core enablers for real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance of complex cyber-physical systems, impose critical requirements on their virtual models: high predictive accuracy, strong interpretability, and online adaptive capability. However, existing techniques struggle to meet these demands simultaneously: Bayesian methods excel in uncertainty quantification but lack model interpretability, while interpretable symbolic identification methods (e.g., SINDy) are constrained by their offline, batch-processing nature, which make real-time updates challenging. To bridge this semantic and computational gap, this paper proposes a novel Bayesian Regression-based Symbolic Learning (BRSL) framework. The framework formulates online symbolic discovery as a unified probabilistic state-space model. By incorporating sparse horseshoe priors, model selection is transformed into a Bayesian inference task, enabling simultaneous system identification and uncertainty quantification. Furthermore, we derive an online recursive algorithm with a forgetting factor and establish precise recursive conditions that guarantee the well-posedness of the posterior distribution. These conditions also function as real-time monitors for data utility, enhancing algorithmic robustness. Additionally, a rigorous convergence analysis is provided, demonstrating the convergence of parameter estimates under persistent excitation conditions. Case studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in achieving interpretable, probabilistic prediction and online learning.

title: Does Cognitive Load Affect Human Accuracy in Detecting Voice-Based Deepfakes?
comments: Accepted as full paper to CHIIR'26
summary: Deepfake technologies are powerful tools that can be misused for malicious purposes such as spreading disinformation on social media. The effectiveness of such malicious applications depends on the ability of deepfakes to deceive their audience. Therefore, researchers have investigated human abilities to detect deepfakes in various studies. However, most of these studies were conducted with participants who focused exclusively on the detection task; hence the studies may not provide a complete picture of human abilities to detect deepfakes under realistic conditions: Social media users are exposed to cognitive load on the platform, which can impair their detection abilities. In this paper, we investigate the influence of cognitive load on human detection abilities of voice-based deepfakes in an empirical study with 30 participants. Our results suggest that low cognitive load does not generally impair detection abilities, and that the simultaneous exposure to a secondary stimulus can actually benefit people in the detection task.
comment: Accepted as full paper to CHIIR'26

title: RSA-Bench: Benchmarking Audio Large Models in Real-World Acoustic Scenarios
summary: While Audio Large Models (ALMs) have achieved remarkable proficiency, their robustness remains brittle in real-world deployment. Existing evaluations largely rely on synthetic Gaussian noise or simplistic single-source interference, failing to capture the intricate, multi-layered acoustic dynamics -- or ``Acoustic Ecology'' -- that characterize authentic physical environments. To bridge this ecological gap, we introduce \textbf{RSA-Bench}, a comprehensive robustness benchmark designed to stress-test ALLMs through high-fidelity auditory scene simulations. Unlike traditional methods, we construct evaluation samples by naturally superimposing diverse environmental soundscapes -- spanning \textit{Pasture}, \textit{Extreme Weather}, \textit{Classroom}, and \textit{Outdoors} -- onto clean speech signals across a spectrum of interference intensities. By evaluating models on six core tasks ranging from fundamental perception to complex reasoning, our study unveils three macro-level insights: \textbf{(I) The Perception-Cognition Gap:} Models maintain relative resilience in low-level recognition but suffer a \textbf{functional collapse} in high-order reasoning tasks under stress; \textbf{(II) Scenario Sensitivity:} ``Vocal-like'' interference (e.g., background laughter) proves significantly more destructive than mechanical noise, challenging the model's auditory attention mechanisms; and \textbf{(III) The Denoising Paradox:} Standard speech enhancement often exacerbates performance degradation, as ALLMs prove highly sensitive to the semantic distortions introduced by denoising artifacts.

title: Handling Missing Modalities in Multimodal Survival Prediction for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
summary: Accurate survival prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) requires the integration of heterogeneous clinical, radiological, and histopathological information. While Multimodal Deep Learning (MDL) offers a promises for precision prognosis and survival prediction, its clinical applicability is severely limited by small cohort sizes and the presence of missing modalities, often forcing complete-case filtering or aggressive imputation. In this work, we present a missing-aware multimodal survival framework that integrates Computed Tomography (CT), Whole-Slide Histopathology (WSI) Images, and structured clinical variables for overall survival modeling in unresectable stage II-III NSCLC. By leveraging Foundation Models (FM) for modality-specific feature extraction and a missing-aware encoding strategy, the proposed approach enables intermediate multimodal fusion under naturally incomplete modality profiles. The proposed architecture is resilient to missing modalities by design, allowing the model to utilize all available data without being forced to drop patients during training or inference. Experimental results demonstrate that intermediate fusion consistently outperforms unimodal baselines as well as early and late fusion strategies, with the strongest performance achieved by the fusion of WSI and clinical modalities (73.30 C-index). Further analyses of modality importance reveal an adaptive behavior in which less informative modalities, i.e., CT modality, are automatically down-weighted and contribute less to the final survival prediction.

title: The Assistant Axis: Situating and Stabilizing the Default Persona of Language Models
summary: Large language models can represent a variety of personas but typically default to a helpful Assistant identity cultivated during post-training. We investigate the structure of the space of model personas by extracting activation directions corresponding to diverse character archetypes. Across several different models, we find that the leading component of this persona space is an "Assistant Axis," which captures the extent to which a model is operating in its default Assistant mode. Steering towards the Assistant direction reinforces helpful and harmless behavior; steering away increases the model's tendency to identify as other entities. Moreover, steering away with more extreme values often induces a mystical, theatrical speaking style. We find this axis is also present in pre-trained models, where it primarily promotes helpful human archetypes like consultants and coaches and inhibits spiritual ones. Measuring deviations along the Assistant Axis predicts "persona drift," a phenomenon where models slip into exhibiting harmful or bizarre behaviors that are uncharacteristic of their typical persona. We find that persona drift is often driven by conversations demanding meta-reflection on the model's processes or featuring emotionally vulnerable users. We show that restricting activations to a fixed region along the Assistant Axis can stabilize model behavior in these scenarios -- and also in the face of adversarial persona-based jailbreaks. Our results suggest that post-training steers models toward a particular region of persona space but only loosely tethers them to it, motivating work on training and steering strategies that more deeply anchor models to a coherent persona.

title: INDIC DIALECT: A Multi Task Benchmark to Evaluate and Translate in Indian Language Dialects
summary: Recent NLP advances focus primarily on standardized languages, leaving most low-resource dialects under-served especially in Indian scenarios. In India, the issue is particularly important: despite Hindi being the third most spoken language globally (over 600 million speakers), its numerous dialects remain underrepresented. The situation is similar for Odia, which has around 45 million speakers. While some datasets exist which contain standard Hindi and Odia languages, their regional dialects have almost no web presence. We introduce INDIC-DIALECT, a human-curated parallel corpus of 13k sentence pairs spanning 11 dialects and 2 languages: Hindi and Odia. Using this corpus, we construct a multi-task benchmark with three tasks: dialect classification, multiple-choice question (MCQ) answering, and machine translation (MT). Our experiments show that LLMs like GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 perform poorly on the classification task. While fine-tuned transformer based models pretrained on Indian languages substantially improve performance e.g., improving F1 from 19.6\% to 89.8\% on dialect classification. For dialect to language translation, we find that hybrid AI model achieves highest BLEU score of 61.32 compared to the baseline score of 23.36. Interestingly, due to complexity in generating dialect sentences, we observe that for language to dialect translation the ``rule-based followed by AI" approach achieves best BLEU score of 48.44 compared to the baseline score of 27.59. INDIC-DIALECT thus is a new benchmark for dialect-aware Indic NLP, and we plan to release it as open source to support further work on low-resource Indian dialects.

title: Regularization of linear inverse problems by rational Krylov methods
summary: For approximately solving linear ill-posed problems in Hilbert spaces, we investigate the regularization properties of the aggregation method and the RatCG method. These recent algorithms use previously calculated solutions of Tikhonov regularization (respectively, Landweber iterations) to set up a new search space on which the least-squares functional is minimized. We outline how these methods can be understood as rational Krylov space methods, i.e., based on the space of rational functions of the forward operator. The main result is that these methods form an optimal-order regularization schemes when combined with the discrepancy principle as stopping rule and when the underlying regularization parameters are sufficiently large.

title: Codebook Design for Limited Feedback in Near-Field XL-MIMO Systems
summary: In this paper, we study efficient codebook design for limited feedback in extremely large-scale multiple-input-multiple-output (XL-MIMO) frequency division duplexing (FDD) systems. It is worth noting that existing codebook designs for XL-MIMO, such as polar-domain codebook, have not well taken into account user (location) distribution in practice, thereby incurring excessive feedback overhead. To address this issue, we propose in this paper a novel and efficient feedback codebook tailored to user distribution. To this end, we first consider a typical scenario where users are uniformly distributed within a specific polar-region, based on which a sum-rate maximization problem is formulated to jointly optimize angle-range samples and bit allocation among angle/range feedback. This problem is challenging to solve due to the lack of a closed-form expression for the received power in terms of angle and range samples. By leveraging a Voronoi partitioning approach, we show that uniform angle sampling is optimal for received power maximization. For more challenging range sampling design, we obtain a tight lower-bound on the received power and show that geometric sampling, where the ratio between adjacent samples is constant, can maximize the lower bound and thus serves as a high-quality suboptimal solution. We then extend the proposed framework to accommodate more general non-uniform user distribution via an alternating sampling method. Furthermore, theoretical analysis reveals that as the array size increases, the optimal allocation of feedback bits increasingly favors range samples at the expense of angle samples. Finally, numerical results validate the superior rate performance and robustness of the proposed codebook design under various system setups, achieving significant gains over benchmark schemes, including the widely used polar-domain codebook.

title: Multi-Temporal Frames Projection for Dynamic Processes Fusion in Fluorescence Microscopy
summary: Fluorescence microscopy is widely employed for the analysis of living biological samples; however, the utility of the resulting recordings is frequently constrained by noise, temporal variability, and inconsistent visualisation of signals that oscillate over time. We present a unique computational framework that integrates information from multiple time-resolved frames into a single high-quality image, while preserving the underlying biological content of the original video. We evaluate the proposed method through an extensive number of configurations (n = 111) and on a challenging dataset comprising dynamic, heterogeneous, and morphologically complex 2D monolayers of cardiac cells. Results show that our framework, which consists of a combination of explainable techniques from different computer vision application fields, is capable of generating composite images that preserve and enhance the quality and information of individual microscopy frames, yielding 44% average increase in cell count compared to previous methods. The proposed pipeline is applicable to other imaging domains that require the fusion of multi-temporal image stacks into high-quality 2D images, thereby facilitating annotation and downstream segmentation.

title: Multiaccess Coded Caching with Heterogeneous Retrieval Costs
summary: The multiaccess coded caching (MACC) system, as formulated by Hachem {\it et al.}, consists of a central server with a library of $N$ files, connected to $K$ cache-less users via an error-free shared link, and $K$ cache nodes, each equipped with cache memory of size $M$ files. Each user can access $L$ neighboring cache nodes under a cyclic wrap-around topology. Most existing studies operate under the strong assumption that users can retrieve content from their connected cache nodes at no communication cost. In practice, each user retrieves content from its $L$ different connected cache nodes at varying costs. Additionally, the server also incurs certain costs to transmit the content to the users. In this paper, we focus on a cost-aware MACC system and aim to minimize the total system cost, which includes cache-access costs and broadcast costs. Firstly, we propose a novel coded caching framework based on superposition coding, where the MACC schemes of Cheng \textit{et al.} are layered. Then, a cost-aware optimization problem is derived that optimizes cache placement and minimizes system cost. By identifying a sparsity property of the optimal solution, we propose a structure-aware algorithm with reduced complexity. Simulation results demonstrate that our proposed scheme consistently outperforms the scheme of Cheng {\it et al.} in scenarios with heterogeneous retrieval costs.

title: LatentRefusal: Latent-Signal Refusal for Unanswerable Text-to-SQL Queries
summary: In LLM-based text-to-SQL systems, unanswerable and underspecified user queries may generate not only incorrect text but also executable programs that yield misleading results or violate safety constraints, posing a major barrier to safe deployment. Existing refusal strategies for such queries either rely on output-level instruction following, which is brittle due to model hallucinations, or estimate output uncertainty, which adds complexity and overhead. To address this challenge, we formalize safe refusal in text-to-SQL systems as an answerability-gating problem and propose LatentRefusal, a latent-signal refusal mechanism that predicts query answerability from intermediate hidden activations of a large language model. We introduce the Tri-Residual Gated Encoder, a lightweight probing architecture, to suppress schema noise and amplify sparse, localized cues of question-schema mismatch that indicate unanswerability. Extensive empirical evaluations across diverse ambiguous and unanswerable settings, together with ablation studies and interpretability analyses, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and show that LatentRefusal provides an attachable and efficient safety layer for text-to-SQL systems. Across four benchmarks, LatentRefusal improves average F1 to 88.5 percent on both backbones while adding approximately 2 milliseconds of probe overhead.

title: A Geometric Multigrid Preconditioner for Shifted Boundary Method
comments: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2506.12899
summary: The Shifted Boundary Method (SBM) trades some part of the burden of body-fitted meshing for increased algebraic complexity. While the resulting linear systems retain the standard $\mathcal{O}(h^{-2})$ conditioning of second-order operators, the non-symmetry and non-local boundary coupling render them resistant to standard Algebraic Multigrid (AMG) and simple smoothers for high-order discretisations. We present a geometric multigrid preconditioner that effectively tames these systems. At its core lies the \emph{Full-Residual Shy Patch} smoother: a subspace correction strategy that filters out some patches while capturing the full physics of the shifted boundary. Unlike previous cell-wise approaches that falter at high polynomial degrees, our method delivers convergence with low mesh dependence. We demonstrate performance for Continuous Galerkin approximations, maintaining low and stable iteration counts up to polynomial degree $p=3$ in 3D, proving that SBM can be both geometrically flexible and algebraically efficient.

title: Toward Ultra-Long-Horizon Agentic Science: Cognitive Accumulation for Machine Learning Engineering
summary: The advancement of artificial intelligence toward agentic science is currently bottlenecked by the challenge of ultra-long-horizon autonomy, the ability to sustain strategic coherence and iterative correction over experimental cycles spanning days or weeks. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated prowess in short-horizon reasoning, they are easily overwhelmed by execution details in the high-dimensional, delayed-feedback environments of real-world research, failing to consolidate sparse feedback into coherent long-term guidance. Here, we present ML-Master 2.0, an autonomous agent that masters ultra-long-horizon machine learning engineering (MLE) which is a representative microcosm of scientific discovery. By reframing context management as a process of cognitive accumulation, our approach introduces Hierarchical Cognitive Caching (HCC), a multi-tiered architecture inspired by computer systems that enables the structural differentiation of experience over time. By dynamically distilling transient execution traces into stable knowledge and cross-task wisdom, HCC allows agents to decouple immediate execution from long-term experimental strategy, effectively overcoming the scaling limits of static context windows. In evaluations on OpenAI's MLE-Bench under 24-hour budgets, ML-Master 2.0 achieves a state-of-the-art medal rate of 56.44%. Our findings demonstrate that ultra-long-horizon autonomy provides a scalable blueprint for AI capable of autonomous exploration beyond human-precedent complexities.

title: Discrete Feynman-Kac Correctors
summary: Discrete diffusion models have recently emerged as a promising alternative to the autoregressive approach for generating discrete sequences. Sample generation via gradual denoising or demasking processes allows them to capture hierarchical non-sequential interdependencies in the data. These custom processes, however, do not assume a flexible control over the distribution of generated samples. We propose Discrete Feynman-Kac Correctors, a framework that allows for controlling the generated distribution of discrete masked diffusion models at inference time. We derive Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) algorithms that, given a trained discrete diffusion model, control the temperature of the sampled distribution (i.e. perform annealing), sample from the product of marginals of several diffusion processes (e.g. differently conditioned processes), and sample from the product of the marginal with an external reward function, producing likely samples from the target distribution that also have high reward. Notably, our framework does not require any training of additional models or fine-tuning of the original model. We illustrate the utility of our framework in several applications including: efficient sampling from the annealed Boltzmann distribution of the Ising model, improving the performance of language models for code generation and amortized learning, as well as reward-tilted protein sequence generation.

title: ErrEval: Error-Aware Evaluation for Question Generation through Explicit Diagnostics
summary: Automatic Question Generation (QG) often produces outputs with critical defects, such as factual hallucinations and answer mismatches. However, existing evaluation methods, including LLM-based evaluators, mainly adopt a black-box and holistic paradigm without explicit error modeling, leading to the neglect of such defects and overestimation of question quality. To address this issue, we propose ErrEval, a flexible and Error-aware Evaluation framework that enhances QG evaluation through explicit error diagnostics. Specifically, ErrEval reformulates evaluation as a two-stage process of error diagnosis followed by informed scoring. At the first stage, a lightweight plug-and-play Error Identifier detects and categorizes common errors across structural, linguistic, and content-related aspects. These diagnostic signals are then incorporated as explicit evidence to guide LLM evaluators toward more fine-grained and grounded judgments. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ErrEval, showing that incorporating explicit diagnostics improves alignment with human judgments. Further analyses confirm that ErrEval effectively mitigates the overestimation of low-quality questions.

title: CS-GBA: A Critical Sample-based Gradient-guided Backdoor Attack for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) enables policy optimization from static datasets but is inherently vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing attack strategies typically struggle against safety-constrained algorithms (e.g., CQL) due to inefficient random poisoning and the use of easily detectable Out-of-Distribution (OOD) triggers. In this paper, we propose CS-GBA (Critical Sample-based Gradient-guided Backdoor Attack), a novel framework designed to achieve high stealthiness and destructiveness under a strict budget. Leveraging the theoretical insight that samples with high Temporal Difference (TD) errors are pivotal for value function convergence, we introduce an adaptive Critical Sample Selection strategy that concentrates the attack budget on the most influential transitions. To evade OOD detection, we propose a Correlation-Breaking Trigger mechanism that exploits the physical mutual exclusivity of state features (e.g., 95th percentile boundaries) to remain statistically concealed. Furthermore, we replace the conventional label inversion with a Gradient-Guided Action Generation mechanism, which searches for worst-case actions within the data manifold using the victim Q-network's gradient. Empirical results on D4RL benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving high attack success rates against representative safety-constrained algorithms with a minimal 5% poisoning budget, while maintaining the agent's performance in clean environments.

title: TF3-RO-50M: Training Compact Romanian Language Models from Scratch on Synthetic Moral Microfiction
summary: Recent advances in synthetic data generation have shown that compact language models can be trained effectively when the underlying corpus is structurally controlled and linguistically coherent. However, for morphologically rich and computationally under-resourced languages such as Romanian, there is still no openly documented, end-to-end pipeline that unifies tokenizer design, preprocessing, pretraining, compression, evaluation, and large-scale synthetic data generation in a reproducible framework. Building on TF1, a three-million-story English fable dataset, and TF2, which extends TF1 through high-quality Romanian translations, we introduce TF3-RO, a Romanian-centric language modeling pipeline spanning tokenizer training, from-scratch model development, and Romanian-native dataset generation. TF3-RO constructs Romanian-specific BPE and Unigram tokenizers from a linguistically informed corpus to mitigate token inflation induced by Romanian morphology. Using long-sequence packed training, we pretrain a 51.65M-parameter LLaMA-style Transformer entirely from scratch. The model is subsequently optimized through quantization, structured pruning, and logit-based knowledge distillation, yielding a compact 26.45M-parameter student model with tied embeddings and strong deployment characteristics. Using this distilled model, TF3-RO generates three million Romanian-native synthetic fables via a controlled combinatorial prompting framework. Across all stages, the pipeline integrates a comprehensive evaluation suite combining intrinsic metrics, Romanian agreement probes, entity coherence, rule-based grammar checking, and LLM-based assessment. TF3-RO provides a reproducible and linguistically grounded framework for training compact Romanian language models and producing large-scale synthetic narrative corpora.

title: LADFA: A Framework of Using Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Personal Data Flow Analysis in Privacy Policies
summary: Privacy policies help inform people about organisations' personal data processing practices, covering different aspects such as data collection, data storage, and sharing of personal data with third parties. Privacy policies are often difficult for people to fully comprehend due to the lengthy and complex legal language used and inconsistent practices across different sectors and organisations. To help conduct automated and large-scale analyses of privacy policies, many researchers have studied applications of machine learning and natural language processing techniques, including large language models (LLMs). While a limited number of prior studies utilised LLMs for extracting personal data flows from privacy policies, our approach builds on this line of work by combining LLMs with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and a customised knowledge base derived from existing studies. This paper presents the development of LADFA, an end-to-end computational framework, which can process unstructured text in a given privacy policy, extract personal data flows and construct a personal data flow graph, and conduct analysis of the data flow graph to facilitate insight discovery. The framework consists of a pre-processor, an LLM-based processor, and a data flow post-processor. We demonstrated and validated the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed approach by conducting a case study that involved examining ten selected privacy policies from the automotive industry. Moreover, it is worth noting that LADFA is designed to be flexible and customisable, making it suitable for a range of text-based analysis tasks beyond privacy policy analysis.

title: LLMdoctor: Token-Level Flow-Guided Preference Optimization for Efficient Test-Time Alignment of Large Language Models
summary: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences is critical, yet traditional fine-tuning methods are computationally expensive and inflexible. While test-time alignment offers a promising alternative, existing approaches often rely on distorted trajectory-level signals or inefficient sampling, fundamentally capping performance and failing to preserve the generative diversity of the base model. This paper introduces LLMdoctor, a novel framework for efficient test-time alignment that operates via a patient-doctor paradigm. It integrates token-level reward acquisition with token-level flow-guided preference optimization (TFPO) to steer a large, frozen patient LLM with a smaller, specialized doctor model. Unlike conventional methods that rely on trajectory-level rewards, LLMdoctor first extracts fine-grained, token-level preference signals from the patient model's behavioral variations. These signals then guide the training of the doctor model via TFPO, which establishes flow consistency across all subtrajectories, enabling precise token-by-token alignment while inherently preserving generation diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LLMdoctor significantly outperforms existing test-time alignment methods and even surpasses the performance of full fine-tuning approaches like DPO.

AI.title_translation: LLMdoctor：用于高效测试时对齐大型语言模型的令牌级流引导偏好优化
AI.tldr: LLMdoctor 提出了一种新的测试时对齐框架，它使用一个小的“医生”模型通过令牌级流引导偏好优化（TFPO）来指导一个冻结的“患者”LLM。这种方法通过细粒度的令牌级信号实现高效对齐，效果显著优于现有的测试时对齐方法，甚至超越了完整的微调方法 DPO。
AI.motivation: 传统的微调方法计算成本高昂且不灵活。现有的测试时对齐方法依赖于失真的轨迹级信号或低效的采样，这限制了性能并损害了基础模型的生成多样性。
AI.method: 提出了 LLMdoctor 框架，采用“患者-医生”范式。它通过令牌级奖励获取（token-level reward acquisition）从大型、冻结的“患者”LLM 的行为变化中提取细粒度的令牌级偏好信号。然后，这些信号通过令牌级流引导偏好优化（TFPO）来指导较小的“医生”模型训练，TFPO 建立了所有子轨迹的流一致性，实现精确的逐令牌对齐。
AI.result: LLMdoctor 在实验中显著优于现有的测试时对齐方法，甚至超过了像 DPO 这样的完整微调方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: LLMdoctor 是一种高效的测试时对齐新框架，通过整合令牌级奖励获取和 TFPO，成功解决了现有方法的局限性，实现了精确的逐令牌对齐并保留了生成多样性，表现优于现有方法和完整的微调方法。
AI.translation: 将大型语言模型（LLMs）与人类偏好对齐至关重要，但传统的微调方法计算成本高昂且不灵活。虽然测试时对齐提供了一个有前景的替代方案，但现有方法通常依赖于失真的轨迹级信号或低效的采样，从根本上限制了性能并未能保留基础模型的生成多样性。本文介绍了 LLMdoctor，这是一个通过“患者-医生”范式运行的高效测试时对齐新框架。它将令牌级奖励获取与令牌级流引导偏好优化（TFPO）相结合，以较小、专业的“医生”模型来引导大型、冻结的“患者”LLM。与依赖轨迹级奖励的传统方法不同，LLMdoctor 首先从“患者”模型的行为变化中提取细粒度的令牌级偏好信号。然后，这些信号通过 TFPO 指导“医生”模型的训练，TFPO 在所有子轨迹中建立了流一致性，从而实现了精确的逐令牌对齐，同时固有地保留了生成多样性。广泛的实验证明，LLMdoctor 显著优于现有的测试时对齐方法，甚至超过了像 DPO 这样的完整微调方法的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LLMdoctor 框架，旨在解决传统微调的高成本和现有测试时对齐方法中轨迹级信号失真的问题。LLMdoctor 采用“患者-医生”范式，从冻结的“患者”模型中提取细粒度的令牌级偏好信号，并使用令牌级流引导偏好优化（TFPO）训练一个较小的“医生”模型进行高效指导。这种方法确保了逐令牌的精确对齐和生成多样性，实验证明其性能显著优于现有测试时对齐方法，甚至超越了完整的 DPO 微调方法。
AI.keywords: 测试时对齐, 令牌级优化, 流引导偏好优化, LLM, DPO
AI.comments: 本文的关键创新在于将偏好优化从传统的轨迹级信号提升到细粒度的令牌级信号，并引入了令牌级流引导偏好优化（TFPO）机制。这种方法通过使用小型“医生”模型指导大型“患者”模型，极大地提高了测试时对齐的效率和精确性，并解决了现有方法中生成多样性不足的问题。其超越 DPO 性能的成果凸显了该框架在资源受限环境下的重要性。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Lookahead Information Via Adaptive Batching
summary: We study tabular reinforcement learning problems with multiple steps of lookahead information. Before acting, the learner observes $\ell$ steps of future transition and reward realizations: the exact state the agent would reach and the rewards it would collect under any possible course of action. While it has been shown that such information can drastically boost the value, finding the optimal policy is NP-hard, and it is common to apply one of two tractable heuristics: processing the lookahead in chunks of predefined sizes ('fixed batching policies'), and model predictive control. We first illustrate the problems with these two approaches and propose utilizing the lookahead in adaptive (state-dependent) batches; we refer to such policies as adaptive batching policies (ABPs). We derive the optimal Bellman equations for these strategies and design an optimistic regret-minimizing algorithm that enables learning the optimal ABP when interacting with unknown environments. Our regret bounds are order-optimal up to a potential factor of the lookahead horizon $\ell$, which can usually be considered a small constant.

AI.title_translation: 基于自适应批处理的多步预见信息强化学习
AI.tldr: 本文研究具有多步预见信息的强化学习，提出了一种名为“自适应批处理策略”（ABP）的新方法，解决了传统固定批处理方法的局限性，并设计了一种具有最优（忽略预见步长$\ell$）遗憾界限的乐观学习算法。
AI.motivation: 学习者在行动前可观察到未来$\ell$步的转换和奖励（预见信息）。虽然该信息能显著提升价值，但寻找最优策略是NP难的。现有的可处理启发式方法（固定批处理策略和模型预测控制）存在问题，需要一种更优的、可处理的策略来利用预见信息。
AI.method: 提出自适应批处理策略（ABPs），该策略使用状态依赖的自适应批次来处理预见信息。为这些策略推导了最优贝尔曼方程，并设计了一种乐观的遗憾最小化算法，用于在未知环境中学习最优ABP。
AI.result: 推导出的遗憾界限是阶次最优的，仅相差一个预见范围$\ell$的潜在因子（该因子通常被视为一个小的常数）。
AI.conclusion: 该算法使得在与未知环境交互时能够学习最优的自适应批处理策略（ABP），并实现了接近阶次最优的遗憾性能。
AI.translation: 我们研究具有多步预见信息的表格强化学习问题。在采取行动之前，学习者会观察到未来$\ell$步的转换和奖励实现：在任何可能的行动方案下，智能体将到达的确切状态以及将收集到的奖励。虽然已证明此类信息可以极大地提升价值，但寻找最优策略是NP难的，因此通常应用两种可处理的启发式方法之一：以预定大小的块处理预见信息（“固定批处理策略”），以及模型预测控制。我们首先阐述了这两种方法的局限性，并提出利用自适应（状态依赖）批次中的预见信息；我们将此类策略称为自适应批处理策略（ABPs）。我们为这些策略推导了最优贝尔曼方程，并设计了一种乐观的遗憾最小化算法，使得在与未知环境交互时能够学习最优ABP。我们的遗憾界限是阶次最优的，仅相差一个预见范围$\ell$的潜在因子，该因子通常可以被视为一个小常数。
AI.summary: 本文针对具有多步（$\ell$步）预见信息的表格强化学习问题，提出了一种新的自适应批处理策略（ABP），以解决现有固定批处理和模型预测控制策略的不足。ABPs通过状态依赖的批次来高效利用预见信息。作者推导了ABPs的最优贝尔曼方程，并设计了一种乐观的遗憾最小化算法来学习最优ABP。该算法在未知环境中实现了阶次最优的遗憾界限（忽略因子$\ell$）。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 多步预见, 自适应批处理, 遗憾最小化, 贝尔曼方程
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了自适应批处理策略（ABPs），这是一种在预见信息强化学习中连接理论最优性（NP-hard）和实际可操作性（固定批次）的重要中间策略。通过将批处理大小设定为状态依赖，模型能够更灵活地利用预见信息，从而在保持可处理性的同时提高性能。其重要性在于为处理多步预见信息提供了一个理论框架和一种具有强遗憾保证的实用算法。潜在的局限性可能在于，虽然遗憾界限是阶次最优的，但算法对预见范围$\ell$的依赖性（即使$\ell$被视为小常数）可能影响在大$\ell$场景下的实际表现。

title: Are Language Models Models?
comments: 5 pages. This is an invited commentary under review at Behavioral and Brain Sciences
summary: Futrell and Mahowald claim LMs "serve as model systems", but an assessment at each of Marr's three levels suggests the claim is clearly not true at the implementation level, poorly motivated at the algorithmic-representational level, and problematic at the computational theory level. LMs are good candidates as tools; calling them cognitive models overstates the case and unnecessarily feeds LLM hype.
comment: 5 pages. This is an invited commentary under review at Behavioral and Brain Sciences

AI.tldr: 本文基于马尔（Marr）的三个层面对语言模型（LMs）是否是认知模型系统的主张进行了批判性评估，认为在实现层面、算法层面和计算理论层面，该主张均不成立或存在问题。作者认为语言模型是很好的工具，但不应被视为认知模型，以避免助长炒作。
AI.motivation: 批判性地评估“语言模型（LMs）可作为模型系统”的主张。作者认为将LMs称为认知模型言过其实，且不必要地助长了大型语言模型（LLM）的炒作。
AI.method: 采用马尔（Marr）的三个分析层面（计算理论层面、算法-表征层面、实现层面）来评估语言模型作为模型系统的主张。
AI.result: 评估结果显示：在实现层面，该主张“明显不成立”；在算法-表征层面，“缺乏充分的动机”；在计算理论层面，“存在问题”。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型是很好的“工具”候选者，但称它们为认知模型是言过其实的，且不必要地助长了LLM的炒作。
AI.translation: Futrell 和 Mahowald 声称语言模型（LMs）“可作为模型系统”，但基于马尔（Marr）的三个层面对其进行评估表明：在实现层面，该主张显然不成立；在算法-表征层面，其动机不足；在计算理论层面，其存在问题。语言模型是很好的工具候选者；称它们为认知模型是言过其实的，并且不必要地助长了大型语言模型（LLM）的炒作。
AI.summary: 本文对Futrell和Mahowald提出的语言模型（LMs）可作为模型系统的主张进行了严格审查。通过应用马尔（Marr）的三个分析层面，作者指出该主张在实现层面明确错误，在算法-表征层面缺乏依据，并在计算理论层面存在缺陷。因此，作者总结认为，语言模型更适合作为“工具”，而非“认知模型”，并警告这种过度定性加剧了LLM的炒作。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, 认知模型, 马尔的三个层面, LLM炒作, 批判性评估
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它提供了一个结构化的、基于经典认知科学框架（马尔的三个层面）的批判性工具，用于评估当前对语言模型（LMs）能力的过度乐观解读。在LLM热潮时期，这种冷静的哲学和理论分析至关重要，它有助于区分技术成就和认知科学意义。其重要性在于，它试图为LMs在科学研究中的地位划定界限，警示研究者不要将强大的工程工具误认为是对人类心智的有效模型。

title: Placement Delivery Array for Cache-Aided MIMO Systems
summary: We consider a $(G,L,K,M,N)$ cache-aided multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) network, where a server equipped with $L$ antennas and a library of $N$ equal-size files communicates with $K$ users, each equipped with $G$ antennas and a cache of size $M$ files, over a wireless interference channel. Each user requests an arbitrary file from the library. The goal is to design coded caching schemes that simultaneously achieve the maximum sum degrees of freedom (sum-DoF) and low subpacketization. In this paper, we first introduce a unified combinatorial structure, termed the MIMO placement delivery array (MIMO-PDA), which characterizes uncoded placement and one-shot zero-forcing delivery. By analyzing the combinatorial properties of MIMO-PDAs, we derive a sum-DoF upper bound of $\min\{KG, Gt+G\lceil L/G \rceil\}$, where $t=KM/N$, which coincides with the optimal DoF characterization in prior work by Tehrani \emph{et al.}. Based on this upper bound, we present two novel constructions of MIMO-PDAs that achieve the maximum sum-DoF. The first construction achieves linear subpacketization under stringent parameter constraints, while the second achieves ordered exponential subpacketization under substantially milder constraints. Theoretical analysis and numerical comparisons demonstrate that the second construction exponentially reduces subpacketization compared to existing schemes while preserving the maximum sum-DoF.

AI.title_translation: 缓存辅助MIMO系统的放置传输阵列
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MIMO放置传输阵列（MIMO-PDA）以设计缓存辅助MIMO系统的编码缓存方案。我们推导了最优的和自由度（sum-DoF）上界，并提出了两种实现此上界的新构造，其中第二种构造在保持最大自由度的同时，指数级地降低了子分组复杂度。
AI.motivation: 针对一个$(G,L,K,M,N)$缓存辅助MIMO网络，目标是设计编码缓存方案，同时实现最大的和自由度（sum-DoF）和低的子分组（subpacketization）复杂度。
AI.method: 引入了一种统一的组合结构，称为MIMO放置传输阵列（MIMO-PDA），用于表征未编码放置和一次性迫零传输。通过分析MIMO-PDA的组合特性，推导了和自由度上界，并基于此上界提出了两种新型的MIMO-PDA结构。
AI.result: 推导出的和自由度上界$\min\{KG, Gt+G\lceil L/G \rceil\}$（其中$t=KM/N$）与先前的最优自由度表征一致。提出了两种达到最大和自由度的新型MIMO-PDA结构：第一种在严格参数限制下实现了线性子分组；第二种在较温和限制下实现了有序指数子分组，并与现有方案相比，在保持最大和自由度的同时，指数级地降低了子分组复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功设计了两种新型MIMO-PDA结构，均能实现最大的和自由度。特别是第二种结构，在保持最优性能的同时，显著降低了子分组复杂度，解决了编码缓存设计中的关键挑战。
AI.translation: 我们考虑一个$(G,L,K,M,N)$缓存辅助多输入多输出（MIMO）网络，其中一台配备$L$根天线的服务器和一个包含$N$个等大小文件的库，通过无线干扰信道与$K$个用户通信，每个用户配备$G$根天线和大小为$M$个文件的缓存。每个用户请求库中的任意一个文件。目标是设计编码缓存方案，同时实现最大的和自由度（sum-DoF）和低的子分组（subpacketization）复杂度。在本文中，我们首先引入了一个统一的组合结构，称为MIMO放置传输阵列（MIMO-PDA），它表征了未编码放置和一次性迫零传输。通过分析MIMO-PDA的组合特性，我们推导出了和自由度上界$\min\{KG, Gt+G\lceil L/G \rceil\}$，其中$t=KM/N$，这与Tehrani等人在先前工作中得出的最优自由度表征一致。基于此上界，我们提出了两种实现最大和自由度的新型MIMO-PDA构造。第一种构造在严格的参数限制下实现了线性子分组，而第二种构造在明显较温和的限制下实现了有序指数子分组。理论分析和数值比较表明，第二种构造与现有方案相比，在保持最大和自由度的同时，指数级地降低了子分组复杂度。
AI.summary: 本文研究了缓存辅助MIMO网络中的编码缓存方案设计，旨在最大化和自由度（sum-DoF）并最小化子分组复杂度。作者首先提出了MIMO放置传输阵列（MIMO-PDA）这一统一的组合结构，用于表征放置和传输过程。通过分析MIMO-PDA的组合特性，推导了与先前工作一致的最优和自由度上界。基于此上界，论文提出了两种新型MIMO-PDA构造，均能实现最大的和自由度。特别是第二种构造，在参数限制更温和的情况下，实现了有序指数子分组，并被证明与现有方案相比，能够指数级地降低子分组复杂度，同时保持最优的性能。
AI.keywords: 缓存辅助MIMO, 放置传输阵列, 编码缓存, 自由度, 子分组
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于引入了MIMO放置传输阵列（MIMO-PDA）这一统一的组合结构，为缓存辅助MIMO系统的编码缓存设计提供了强大的分析和构造工具。其重要性在于解决了编码缓存中性能（和自由度）与实现复杂度（子分组）之间的关键权衡问题。特别是第二种构造在保持最大和自由度的同时，实现了子分组复杂度的指数级降低，这对于将编码缓存技术从理论推向实际应用具有重大的意义，因为高子分组复杂度是限制其实用性的主要瓶颈。

title: Aletheia-Probe: A Tool for Automated Journal Assessment
summary: Assessing journal legitimacy during literature reviews, publication venue selection, and citation verification requires consulting information scattered across multiple incompatible data-sets. This paper introduces Aletheia-Probe, an open-source tool that systematically aggregates curated databases and pattern analysis from multiple authoritative sources to provide transparent, confidence-scored journal assessments. The tool explicitly reports which sources were consulted, what each found, and where evidence conflicts. The tool integrates into research workflows through command-line and programmatic interfaces. It reduces manual assessment overhead while explicitly flagging uncertain cases. We present the tool's architecture, core design principles, and practical integration approach. Comprehensive empirical validation will be presented in forthcoming work.

title: Development of Ontological Knowledge Bases by Leveraging Large Language Models
summary: Ontological Knowledge Bases (OKBs) play a vital role in structuring domain-specific knowledge and serve as a foundation for effective knowledge management systems. However, their traditional manual development poses significant challenges related to scalability, consistency, and adaptability. Recent advancements in Generative AI, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), offer promising solutions for automating and enhancing OKB development. This paper introduces a structured, iterative methodology leveraging LLMs to optimize knowledge acquisition, automate ontology artifact generation, and enable continuous refinement cycles. We demonstrate this approach through a detailed case study focused on developing a user context profile ontology within the vehicle sales domain. Key contributions include significantly accelerated ontology construction processes, improved ontological consistency, effective bias mitigation, and enhanced transparency in the ontology engineering process. Our findings highlight the transformative potential of integrating LLMs into ontology development, notably improving scalability, integration capabilities, and overall efficiency in knowledge management systems.

AI.title_translation: 利用大型语言模型开发本体知识库

AI.method: 引入了一种结构化的、迭代的方法论，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）来优化知识获取、自动化本体工件生成，并实现持续的完善周期。通过一个专注于汽车销售领域用户上下文配置文件本体的详细案例研究进行了演示。

AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的结构化、迭代方法论，旨在解决本体知识库（OKBs）传统手动开发中存在的效率和一致性挑战。该方法通过自动化知识获取和本体工件生成，并应用于汽车销售领域的用户上下文本体案例研究。结果表明，这种集成显著加速了本体构建过程，提高了本体一致性和透明度，证明了LLMs在提升知识管理系统效率和可扩展性方面的巨大潜力。

title: AgentGuardian: Learning Access Control Policies to Govern AI Agent Behavior
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly used in a variety of domains to automate tasks, interact with users, and make decisions based on data inputs. Ensuring that AI agents perform only authorized actions and handle inputs appropriately is essential for maintaining system integrity and preventing misuse. In this study, we introduce the AgentGuardian, a novel security framework that governs and protects AI agent operations by enforcing context-aware access-control policies. During a controlled staging phase, the framework monitors execution traces to learn legitimate agent behaviors and input patterns. From this phase, it derives adaptive policies that regulate tool calls made by the agent, guided by both real-time input context and the control flow dependencies of multi-step agent actions. Evaluation across two real-world AI agent applications demonstrates that AgentGuardian effectively detects malicious or misleading inputs while preserving normal agent functionality. Moreover, its control-flow-based governance mechanism mitigates hallucination-driven errors and other orchestration-level malfunctions.

AI.title_translation: AgentGuardian：学习访问控制策略以管理AI代理行为
AI.tldr: AgentGuardian是一个新的安全框架，它通过监控和学习AI代理的合法行为和输入模式，生成自适应的、上下文感知的访问控制策略，用于监管代理的工具调用，有效防止恶意输入、误用和减轻幻觉错误。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理在自动化任务、用户交互和决策制定中的广泛应用，确保AI代理只执行授权操作并恰当地处理输入变得至关重要，这是维护系统完整性和防止滥用的关键。
AI.method: 引入了AgentGuardian框架，这是一个新颖的安全框架，用于通过执行上下文感知的访问控制策略来管理和保护AI代理操作。该方法包括一个受控的预演阶段，在此阶段监控执行轨迹以学习合法的代理行为和输入模式。然后，它根据实时输入上下文和多步代理操作的控制流依赖性，推导出用于规范代理工具调用的自适应策略。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界的AI代理应用中的评估表明，AgentGuardian在保留正常代理功能的同时，有效地检测了恶意或误导性的输入。此外，其基于控制流的管理机制减轻了由幻觉驱动的错误和其他编排级别的故障。
AI.conclusion: AgentGuardian是一个有效的安全框架，能够通过学习和执行上下文感知的访问控制策略，成功地管理和保护AI代理的操作，防止恶意输入和减轻内部编排错误。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI）代理正越来越多地应用于各种领域，以实现任务自动化、与用户互动并根据数据输入做出决策。确保AI代理只执行授权操作并恰当地处理输入对于维护系统完整性和防止滥用至关重要。在这项研究中，我们介绍了AgentGuardian，这是一个新颖的安全框架，它通过执行上下文感知的访问控制策略来管理和保护AI代理的操作。在一个受控的预演阶段，该框架监控执行轨迹以学习合法的代理行为和输入模式。从该阶段，它推导出自适应策略，用于规范代理进行的工具调用，这些策略由实时输入上下文和多步代理操作的控制流依赖性共同指导。对两个真实世界的AI代理应用的评估表明，AgentGuardian在保留正常代理功能的同时，有效地检测了恶意或误导性的输入。此外，其基于控制流的管理机制减轻了由幻觉驱动的错误和其他编排级别的故障。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AgentGuardian，一个用于保护和管理AI代理行为的新型安全框架。AgentGuardian在一个受控阶段学习代理的合法执行轨迹和输入模式，并生成上下文感知和控制流依赖的自适应访问控制策略。这些策略用于规范代理的工具调用，从而有效检测恶意输入、防止滥用，并减轻AI代理特有的幻觉驱动错误和编排故障。
AI.keywords: AI代理安全, 访问控制策略, 行为学习, 控制流, 幻觉缓解
AI.comments: AgentGuardian的创新点在于将传统的访问控制（Access Control）概念扩展到了AI代理的动态操作环境。它不仅基于静态权限，更重要的是，它通过*学习*合法行为和*控制流依赖*来动态地生成和应用策略，这使其能够应对复杂的、多步骤的代理动作和新兴的AI特有风险（如幻觉）。这种基于行为学习的治理机制对于解决AI代理的滥用和内部编排错误（如幻觉）至关重要，是构建高可靠性AI系统的关键一步。抽象中未提及局限性。

title: Subjective evaluation of UHD video coded using VVC with LCEVC and ML-VVC
summary: This paper presents the results of a subjective quality assessment of a multilayer video coding configuration in which Low Complexity Enhancement Video Coding (LCEVC) is applied as an enhancement layer on top of a Versatile Video Coding (VVC) base layer. The evaluation follows the same test methodology and conditions previously defined for MPEG multilayer video coding assessments, with the LCEVC enhancement layer encoded using version 8.1 of the LCEVC Test Model (LTM). The test compares reconstructed UHD output generated from an HD VVC base layer with LCEVC enhancement against two reference cases: upsampled VVC base layer decoding and multilayer VVC (ML-VVC). Two operating points are considered, corresponding to enhancement layers representing approximately 10% and 50% of the total bitrate. Subjective assessment was conducted using the Degradation Category Rating (DCR) methodology with twenty five participants, across a dataset comprising fifteen SDR and HDR sequences. The reported results include Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) with associated 95% confidence intervals, enabling comparison of perceptual quality across coding approaches and operating points within the defined test scope.

AI.title_translation: 使用VVC结合LCEVC和ML-VVC编码的UHD视频的主观评价
AI.tldr: 本文对VVC基层结合LCEVC增强层的多层视频编码配置进行了主观质量评估。测试将该配置的UHD输出与上采样VVC和ML-VVC进行比较，使用了DCR方法，考虑了10%和50%两种比特率分配点，并报告了MOS结果。
AI.motivation: 评估VVC基层结合LCEVC增强层的多层视频编码配置的感知质量。
AI.method: 采用主观质量评估，遵循MPEG多层视频编码评估的测试方法和条件。配置为VVC（HD）基层和LCEVC（使用LTM 8.1编码）增强层，生成UHD输出。比较对象包括上采样的VVC基层解码和多层VVC（ML-VVC）。考虑了增强层占总比特率约10%和50%的两个操作点。评估使用DCR（降级类别评级）方法，有25名参与者，使用了15个SDR和HDR序列数据集。
AI.result: 报告的结果包括平均意见得分（MOS）及其相关的95%置信区间，用于比较不同编码方法和操作点的感知质量。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了多层视频编码配置的主观质量评估结果，该配置将低复杂度增强视频编码（LCEVC）作为增强层应用于多功能视频编码（VVC）基层之上。评估遵循先前为MPEG多层视频编码评估定义的相同测试方法和条件，LCEVC增强层使用LCEVC测试模型（LTM）的8.1版本进行编码。该测试将由HD VVC基层和LCEVC增强层生成的重建UHD输出与两种参考情况进行比较：上采样的VVC基层解码和多层VVC（ML-VVC）。考虑了两个操作点，分别对应于增强层占总比特率约10%和50%。主观评估使用降级类别评级（DCR）方法，有25名参与者，跨越包含15个SDR和HDR序列的数据集。报告的结果包括平均意见得分（MOS）及其相关的95%置信区间，从而能够在定义的测试范围内比较不同编码方法和操作点的感知质量。
AI.summary: 本文旨在对一种新型的多层视频编码配置进行主观质量评估，该配置采用VVC作为基层，LCEVC作为增强层，以生成UHD视频。测试遵循MPEG多层评估方法，LCEVC使用LTM 8.1编码。研究对比了VVC+LCEVC配置与上采样VVC和ML-VVC的感知质量，特别关注增强层占总比特率10%和50%的两种情况。评估采用DCR方法，有25名参与者，最终报告了带有95%置信区间的平均意见得分（MOS）。
AI.keywords: VVC, LCEVC, 主观质量评估, 多层视频编码, UHD视频
AI.comments: 这项研究的重要性在于它首次对VVC与LCEVC这种混合多层编码方案的实际感知性能进行了量化。LCEVC旨在提供低复杂度的增强，因此将其与高效的VVC结合，有望在保持质量的同时降低解码负担。通过与纯VVC多层（ML-VVC）和简单上采样VVC进行对比，研究结果将直接揭示LCEVC作为增强层的效率和价值，尤其是在不同的比特率分配下。

title: Lunar-G2R: Geometry-to-Reflectance Learning for High-Fidelity Lunar BRDF Estimation
summary: We address the problem of estimating realistic, spatially varying reflectance for complex planetary surfaces such as the lunar regolith, which is critical for high-fidelity rendering and vision-based navigation. Existing lunar rendering pipelines rely on simplified or spatially uniform BRDF models whose parameters are difficult to estimate and fail to capture local reflectance variations, limiting photometric realism. We propose Lunar-G2R, a geometry-to-reflectance learning framework that predicts spatially varying BRDF parameters directly from a lunar digital elevation model (DEM), without requiring multi-view imagery, controlled illumination, or dedicated reflectance-capture hardware at inference time. The method leverages a U-Net trained with differentiable rendering to minimize photometric discrepancies between real orbital images and physically based renderings under known viewing and illumination geometry. Experiments on a geographically held-out region of the Tycho crater show that our approach reduces photometric error by 38 % compared to a state-of-the-art baseline, while achieving higher PSNR and SSIM and improved perceptual similarity, capturing fine-scale reflectance variations absent from spatially uniform models. To our knowledge, this is the first method to infer a spatially varying reflectance model directly from terrain geometry.

AI.title_translation: Lunar-G2R：用于高保真月球BRDF估计的几何到反射学习
AI.tldr: 提出Lunar-G2R框架，利用U-Net和可微分渲染，直接从月球数字高程模型（DEM）预测空间变化的BRDF参数，实现高保真月球表面渲染，且推断时无需多视角图像或专用硬件。实验显示光度误差降低38%，并能捕获精细反射变化。
AI.motivation: 估计月球表面等复杂行星表面逼真、空间变化的反射率（BRDF）对于高保真渲染和基于视觉的导航至关重要。现有渲染管线依赖简化或空间均匀的BRDF模型，难以估计参数且无法捕获局部反射变化，限制了光度真实感。
AI.method: 提出了Lunar-G2R，一个几何到反射的学习框架。它使用一个U-Net网络，通过可微分渲染进行训练，以最小化真实轨道图像与已知观察和照明几何下的物理渲染之间的光度差异。该方法直接从月球数字高程模型（DEM）预测空间变化的BRDF参数，在推断时无需多视角图像、受控照明或专用反射捕获硬件。
AI.result: 在Tycho陨石坑的一个地理保留区域进行的实验表明，与现有最先进的基线相比，该方法将光度误差降低了38%，同时实现了更高的PSNR和SSIM，以及改进的感知相似性，并捕获了空间均匀模型所缺乏的精细尺度反射变化。
AI.translation: 我们解决了估计复杂行星表面（如月球风化层）逼真且空间变化的反射率的问题，这对于高保真渲染和基于视觉的导航至关重要。现有的月球渲染管线依赖于简化或空间均匀的BRDF模型，其参数难以估计，并且无法捕获局部反射变化，从而限制了光度真实感。我们提出了Lunar-G2R，一个几何到反射的学习框架，它直接从月球数字高程模型（DEM）预测空间变化的BRDF参数，在推断时无需多视角图像、受控照明或专用反射捕获硬件。该方法利用一个通过可微分渲染训练的U-Net，在已知的观察和照明几何下，最小化真实轨道图像和基于物理的渲染之间的光度差异。在Tycho陨石坑的一个地理保留区域进行的实验表明，我们的方法与最先进的基线相比，将光度误差降低了38%，同时实现了更高的PSNR和SSIM以及改进的感知相似性，捕获了空间均匀模型所缺乏的精细尺度反射变化。据我们所知，这是第一个直接从地形几何推断空间变化反射模型的方。
AI.summary: 本文提出Lunar-G2R框架，旨在解决月球表面高保真渲染中空间变化反射率（BRDF）估计的难题。现有方法因使用简化模型而缺乏真实感。Lunar-G2R是一个几何到反射的学习模型，它利用U-Net和可微分渲染，直接从月球DEM预测空间变化的BRDF参数，从而避免了对多视图图像或专用硬件的需求。实验证明，该方法在Tycho陨石坑上将光度误差降低了38%，显著优于现有基线，并能捕获精细的反射变化。
AI.keywords: 月球BRDF估计, 几何到反射学习, 数字高程模型, 可微分渲染, 空间变化反射率
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次实现了直接从地形几何数据（DEM）推断空间变化的BRDF模型，这极大地简化了高保真月球渲染的流程。通过利用可微分渲染和深度学习（U-Net），该方法绕过了传统BRDF参数估计的困难，显著提高了渲染的光度真实感和细节捕获能力。这对于未来的行星科学数据可视化和自主导航系统具有重要意义。

title: Energy-Efficient Probabilistic Semantic Communication Over Visible Light Networks With Rate Splitting
summary: Visible light communication (VLC) is emerging as a key technology for future wireless communication systems due to its unique physical-layer advantages over traditional radio-frequency (RF)-based systems. However, its integration with higher-layer techniques, such as semantic communication, remains underexplored. This paper investigates the energy efficiency maximization problem in a resource-constrained VLC-based probabilistic semantic communication (PSCom) system. In the considered model, light-emitting diode (LED) transmitters perform semantic compression to reduce data size, which incurs additional computation overhead. The compressed semantic information is transmitted to the users for semantic inference using a shared knowledge base that requires periodic updates to ensure synchronization. In the PSCom system, the knowledge base is represented by probabilistic graphs. To enable simultaneous transmission of both knowledge and information data, rate splitting multiple access (RSMA) is employed. The optimization problem focuses on maximizing energy efficiency by jointly optimizing transmit beamforming, direct current (DC) bias, common rate allocation, and semantic compression ratio, while accounting for both communication and computation costs. To solve this problem, an alternating optimization algorithm based on successive convex approximation (SCA) and Dinkelbach method is developed. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.title_translation: 采用速率分裂的可见光网络中高能效概率语义通信
AI.tldr: 研究了基于VLC的概率语义通信系统，采用速率分裂多址接入技术，通过联合优化波束成形、DC偏置、速率分配和语义压缩比，最大化系统的能量效率。
AI.motivation: 可见光通信（VLC）具有物理层优势，但其与语义通信等高层技术的结合尚待探索。本文旨在资源受限的VLC概率语义通信系统中，最大化系统的能量效率。
AI.method: 建立了一个基于VLC的概率语义通信（PSCom）模型，其中LED执行语义压缩，知识库采用概率图表示，并使用速率分裂多址接入（RSMA）传输知识和信息数据。通过联合优化发射波束成形、DC偏置、公共速率分配和语义压缩比，将能量效率最大化问题公式化。采用基于连续凸近似（SCA）和Dinkelbach方法的交替优化算法求解。
AI.result: 仿真结果证明了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.translation: 可见光通信（VLC）由于其相对于传统射频（RF）系统独特的物理层优势，正在成为未来无线通信系统的一项关键技术。然而，其与语义通信等高层技术的结合仍未得到充分探索。本文研究了资源受限的基于VLC的概率语义通信（PSCom）系统中的能量效率最大化问题。在所考虑的模型中，发光二极管（LED）发射机执行语义压缩以减小数据大小，但这会产生额外的计算开销。压缩后的语义信息被传输给用户，用于使用共享知识库进行语义推断，该知识库需要定期更新以确保同步。在PSCom系统中，知识库由概率图表示。为实现知识和信息数据的同步传输，采用了速率分裂多址接入（RSMA）技术。优化问题侧重于通过联合优化发射波束成形、直流（DC）偏置、公共速率分配和语义压缩比来最大化能量效率，同时考虑通信和计算成本。为了解决这个问题，开发了一种基于连续凸近似（SCA）和Dinkelbach方法的交替优化算法。仿真结果证明了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了资源受限的可见光通信（VLC）网络中概率语义通信（PSCom）系统的能量效率最大化问题。该系统采用速率分裂多址接入（RSMA）技术同时传输语义信息和知识库（由概率图表示）更新数据。通过联合优化发射波束成形、DC偏置、公共速率分配和语义压缩比，将该问题公式化，并使用基于连续凸近似（SCA）和Dinkelbach方法的交替优化算法求解。仿真验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 可见光通信, 语义通信, 速率分裂多址接入, 能量效率, 概率图
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将具有物理层优势的可见光通信（VLC）与高层概率语义通信（PSCom）技术相结合，并引入速率分裂多址接入（RSMA）来管理知识和信息数据的同步传输。更重要的是，它将能量效率最大化问题框架化，同时考虑了语义压缩带来的计算开销和通信成本，提供了一个全面的资源分配解决方案。这种联合优化方法对于未来绿色、智能的无线网络设计具有重要的指导意义。

title: Stable Differentiable Modal Synthesis for Learning Nonlinear Dynamics
comments: Submitted to the Journal of Audio Engineering Society (December 2025)
summary: Modal methods are a long-standing approach to physical modelling synthesis. Extensions to nonlinear problems are possible, including the case of a high-amplitude vibration of a string. A modal decomposition leads to a densely coupled nonlinear system of ordinary differential equations. Recent work in scalar auxiliary variable techniques has enabled construction of explicit and stable numerical solvers for such classes of nonlinear systems. On the other hand, machine learning approaches (in particular neural ordinary differential equations) have been successful in modelling nonlinear systems automatically from data. In this work, we examine how scalar auxiliary variable techniques can be combined with neural ordinary differential equations to yield a stable differentiable model capable of learning nonlinear dynamics. The proposed approach leverages the analytical solution for linear vibration of system's modes so that physical parameters of a system remain easily accessible after the training without the need for a parameter encoder in the model architecture. As a proof of concept, we generate synthetic data for the nonlinear transverse vibration of a string and show that the model can be trained to reproduce the nonlinear dynamics of the system. Sound examples are presented.

AI.title_translation: 稳定的可微分模态合成用于学习非线性动力学
AI.tldr: 本文将稳定的数值求解技术（SAV）与机器学习模型（Neural ODEs）结合，创建了一个稳定的、可微分的模型，用于学习非线性动力学（如弦振动），并保持了对物理参数的易访问性。
AI.motivation: 模态方法在物理建模合成中应用已久，但其非线性扩展（如高振幅弦振动）会导致耦合的非线性常微分方程组。最近的标量辅助变量（SAV）技术能实现此类系统的稳定数值求解。本文的动机是结合SAV技术和神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs），以构建一个稳定的、可微分的模型来学习非线性动力学。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合标量辅助变量（SAV）技术和神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs）的方法。该方法利用了系统模态线性振动的解析解，从而在训练后无需参数编码器即可保持物理参数的可访问性。
AI.result: 作为概念验证，生成了弦的非线性横向振动的合成数据，并证明该模型可以被训练以重现系统的非线性动力学。文中展示了声音示例。
AI.translation: 模态方法是物理建模合成中一种历史悠久的方法。它可以扩展到非线性问题，包括弦的高振幅振动情况。模态分解会导致一个密集耦合的非线性常微分方程组。最近在标量辅助变量技术方面的工作使得为这类非线性系统构建显式且稳定的数值求解器成为可能。另一方面，机器学习方法（特别是神经常微分方程）在根据数据自动建模非线性系统方面取得了成功。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何将标量辅助变量技术与神经常微分方程相结合，以产生一个能够学习非线性动力学的稳定的可微分模型。所提出的方法利用了系统模态线性振动的解析解，使得系统的物理参数在训练后仍然易于访问，而无需在模型架构中设置参数编码器。作为概念验证，我们生成了弦的非线性横向振动的合成数据，并表明该模型可以被训练以重现系统的非线性动力学。文中展示了声音示例。
AI.summary: 模态方法是物理建模合成的传统手段。本文针对非线性动力学建模的挑战，提出了一种将标量辅助变量（SAV）技术与神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs）相结合的新方法，从而构建了一个稳定的、可微分的模型来学习非线性动力学。该方法利用系统模态线性振动的解析解，确保训练后无需参数编码器即可保持物理参数的易访问性。通过对非线性弦振动的合成数据进行概念验证，结果表明该模型能够成功重现系统的非线性动力学。
AI.keywords: 模态合成, 非线性动力学, 神经常微分方程, 标量辅助变量, 可微分模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种混合架构，将标量辅助变量（SAV）技术的数值稳定性与神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs）的数据驱动学习能力相结合，解决了可微分物理模型训练中的稳定性问题。其重要性在于，通过利用线性模态解析解，该模型保持了对系统物理参数的易访问性，避免了纯数据驱动模型常见的黑箱问题，增强了模型的可解释性，使其更适用于物理合成应用。

title: SurgGoal: Rethinking Surgical Planning Evaluation via Goal-Satisfiability
summary: Surgical planning integrates visual perception, long-horizon reasoning, and procedural knowledge, yet it remains unclear whether current evaluation protocols reliably assess vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings. Motivated by a goal-oriented view of surgical planning, we define planning correctness via phase-goal satisfiability, where plan validity is determined by expert-defined surgical rules. Based on this definition, we introduce a multicentric meta-evaluation benchmark with valid procedural variations and invalid plans containing order and content errors. Using this benchmark, we show that sequence similarity metrics systematically misjudge planning quality, penalizing valid plans while failing to identify invalid ones. We therefore adopt a rule-based goal-satisfiability metric as a high-precision meta-evaluation reference to assess Video-LLMs under progressively constrained settings, revealing failures due to perception errors and under-constrained reasoning. Structural knowledge consistently improves performance, whereas semantic guidance alone is unreliable and benefits larger models only when combined with structural constraints.

AI.title_translation: SurgGoal：通过目标可满足性重新思考手术规划评估
AI.tldr: SurgGoal提出了基于目标可满足性的新评估基准和指标，用于评估手术规划中的VLMs。研究发现传统序列指标不可靠，新的规则指标揭示了模型在感知和约束推理上的失败，并强调了结构性知识的重要性。
AI.motivation: 手术规划整合了视觉感知、长程推理和程序性知识，但目前尚不清楚现有评估协议是否能可靠地评估安全关键环境中的视觉语言模型（VLMs）。传统的序列相似性指标存在系统性误判规划质量的问题。
AI.method: 提出通过“阶段目标可满足性”（基于专家定义的手术规则）来定义规划正确性。引入了一个名为SurgGoal的包含有效程序变体和无效计划的多中心元评估基准。采用基于规则的“目标可满足性”指标作为高精度元评估参考，用于评估渐进约束设置下的Video-LLMs。
AI.result: 序列相似性指标系统性地错误判断规划质量，会惩罚有效计划，同时未能识别无效计划。基于目标可满足性的评估揭示了VLM的失败是由于感知错误和约束不足的推理所致。结构性知识持续提高了性能，而单独的语义指导不可靠，仅与结构性约束结合时才能使大型模型受益。
AI.conclusion: 必须重新思考手术规划的评估方式，通过基于规则的目标可满足性指标可以更可靠地评估VLM，并揭示了现有评估指标（如序列相似性）以及模型在感知错误和约束不足的推理方面的根本性失败。结构性知识对于提高性能至关重要。
AI.translation: 手术规划整合了视觉感知、长程推理和程序性知识，然而目前尚不清楚现有评估协议是否能可靠地评估安全关键环境中的视觉语言模型（VLMs）。受手术规划的面向目标视角启发，我们通过阶段目标可满足性来定义规划的正确性，即计划的有效性由专家定义的手术规则确定。基于这一定义，我们引入了一个包含有效程序变体和包含顺序及内容错误的无效计划的多中心元评估基准。利用该基准，我们发现序列相似性指标系统性地错误判断规划质量，它们会惩罚有效计划，同时未能识别无效计划。因此，我们采用基于规则的目标可满足性指标作为高精度元评估参考，用于评估渐进约束设置下的Video-LLMs，揭示了由于感知错误和约束不足的推理导致的失败。结构性知识持续提高了性能，而单独的语义指导不可靠，并且只有与结构性约束结合时才能使大型模型受益。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SurgGoal，一个基于“阶段目标可满足性”和专家规则的新型元评估基准和指标，用于重新评估手术规划中的视觉语言模型（VLMs）。研究发现，传统的序列相似性指标会系统性地误判规划质量。SurgGoal指标用于评估Video-LLMs，揭示了模型在感知和约束推理方面的失败。结果强调了结构性知识在提高VLM手术规划能力中的重要性。
AI.keywords: 手术规划, 目标可满足性, VLM评估, 元评估基准, 结构性知识
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个以“目标可满足性”为核心的、基于专家规则的评估框架，从而解决了传统序列相似性指标在评估手术规划这种具有内在变异性的任务中的局限性。在安全关键领域，评估指标的可靠性至关重要，SurgGoal为手术规划的VLM评估提供了一个更精确和有洞察力的元评估参考，揭示了模型在结构知识和推理约束方面的真实缺陷，对未来安全关键AI系统的评估具有重要指导意义。

title: NSR-Boost: A Neuro-Symbolic Residual Boosting Framework for Industrial Legacy Models
summary: Although the Gradient Boosted Decision Trees (GBDTs) dominate industrial tabular applications, upgrading legacy models in high-concurrency production environments still faces prohibitive retraining costs and systemic risks. To address this problem, we present NSR-Boost, a neuro-symbolic residual boosting framework designed specifically for industrial scenarios. Its core advantage lies in being "non-intrusive". It treats the legacy model as a frozen model and performs targeted repairs on "hard regions" where predictions fail. The framework comprises three key stages: first, finding hard regions through residuals, then generating interpretable experts by generating symbolic code structures using Large Language Model (LLM) and fine-tuning parameters using Bayesian optimization, and finally dynamically integrating experts with legacy model output through a lightweight aggregator. We report on the successful deployment of NSR-Boost within the core financial risk control system at Qfin Holdings. This framework not only significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines across six public datasets and one private dataset, more importantly, shows excellent performance gains on real-world online data. In conclusion, it effectively captures long-tail risks missed by traditional models and offers a safe, low-cost evolutionary paradigm for industry.

AI.title_translation: NSR-Boost：一种面向工业遗留模型的神经符号残差提升框架
AI.tldr: NSR-Boost是一种非侵入式神经符号残差提升框架，利用LLM生成专家模型来修复工业遗留模型的“困难区域”，从而安全、低成本地提升模型性能，已成功应用于金融风控系统。
AI.motivation: 解决在高并发生产环境中升级工业遗留模型（如GBDT）时面临的过高的再训练成本和系统性风险问题。
AI.method: 提出NSR-Boost框架，采用“非侵入式”方法，将遗留模型视为冻结模型。方法分为三个阶段：1. 通过残差识别“困难区域”。2. 利用LLM生成符号代码结构，并通过贝叶斯优化微调参数，生成可解释的专家模型。3. 通过轻量级聚合器动态集成专家模型与遗留模型输出。
AI.result: 已成功部署于Qfin Holdings的核心金融风控系统。在六个公共数据集和一个私有数据集上显著优于最先进（SOTA）的基线模型，并在真实世界的在线数据上显示出卓越的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效捕获了传统模型遗漏的长尾风险，为工业界提供了一种安全、低成本的模型演进范式。
AI.translation: 尽管梯度提升决策树（GBDTs）在工业表格应用中占据主导地位，但在高并发生产环境中升级遗留模型仍然面临高昂的再训练成本和系统性风险。为解决此问题，我们提出了NSR-Boost，一个专为工业场景设计的神经符号残差提升框架。其核心优势在于“非侵入性”。它将遗留模型视为一个冻结模型，并对预测失败的“困难区域”进行有针对性的修复。该框架包括三个关键阶段：首先，通过残差寻找困难区域；然后，利用大型语言模型（LLM）生成符号代码结构并通过贝叶斯优化微调参数，生成可解释的专家模型；最后，通过一个轻量级聚合器动态地将专家模型与遗留模型输出进行集成。我们报告了NSR-Boost在Qfin Holdings核心金融风险控制系统中的成功部署。该框架不仅在六个公共数据集和一个私有数据集上显著优于最先进（SOTA）的基线模型，更重要的是，在真实世界的在线数据上显示出卓越的性能增益。总之，它有效地捕获了传统模型遗漏的长尾风险，并为工业界提供了一种安全、低成本的演进范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了NSR-Boost，一个针对工业遗留模型升级问题的神经符号残差提升框架。该框架采用非侵入式设计，通过残差定位遗留模型的预测困难区域。随后，利用LLM生成可解释的符号专家模型，并结合贝叶斯优化进行参数微调。最后，通过轻量级聚合器将专家模型结果与遗留模型输出集成，从而在不进行整体再训练的情况下安全、低成本地提升模型性能。NSR-Boost在多个数据集和实际金融风控系统中的部署证明了其优越性，尤其在捕获长尾风险方面表现突出。
AI.keywords: 神经符号, 残差提升, 遗留模型, LLM, 工业应用
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将“非侵入式”残差提升范式与神经符号方法相结合，为工业遗留模型升级提供了一个安全、低成本的解决方案。通过利用LLM（大型语言模型）生成可解释的符号代码结构作为专家模型，NSR-Boost有效地解决了工业场景中模型整体再训练成本高昂和系统风险大的痛点。这种方法不仅实现了性能提升，还保持了对“困难区域”修复的透明度和可解释性，对于需要持续迭代但又对稳定性要求极高的金融风控等领域具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: LangLasso: Interactive Cluster Descriptions through LLM Explanation
comments: This manuscript is accepted for publication in VIS 2025 VISxGenAI Workshop
summary: Dimensionality reduction is a powerful technique for revealing structure and potential clusters in data. However, as the axes are complex, non-linear combinations of features, they often lack semantic interpretability. Existing visual analytics (VA) methods support cluster interpretation through feature comparison and interactive exploration, but they require technical expertise and intense human effort. We present \textit{LangLasso}, a novel method that complements VA approaches through interactive, natural language descriptions of clusters using large language models (LLMs). It produces human-readable descriptions that make cluster interpretation accessible to non-experts and allow integration of external contextual knowledge beyond the dataset. We systematically evaluate the reliability of these explanations and demonstrate that \langlasso provides an effective first step for engaging broader audiences in cluster interpretation. The tool is available at https://langlasso.vercel.app
comment: This manuscript is accepted for publication in VIS 2025 VISxGenAI Workshop

AI.title_translation: LangLasso：通过大型语言模型（LLM）解释实现的交互式聚类描述
AI.tldr: LangLasso是一种新颖的方法，它利用LLM为降维后的数据聚类提供交互式、自然语言的描述，从而使非专业人士也能理解复杂的聚类结果，并减轻现有视觉分析（VA）方法的解释难度和所需的人力投入。
AI.motivation: 降维技术产生的轴缺乏语义可解释性。现有的视觉分析（VA）方法虽然支持聚类解释，但需要专业技术知识和大量的人力投入，限制了非专业人士的参与。
AI.method: 提出LangLasso，这是一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成聚类的交互式自然语言描述的新方法，用于补充视觉分析（VA）方法。该方法系统地评估了这些解释的可靠性。
AI.result: LangLasso生成人类可读的描述，使聚类解释对非专业人士开放，并允许整合数据集之外的外部上下文知识。实验证明，LangLasso是吸引更广泛受众参与聚类解释的有效第一步。
AI.conclusion: LangLasso通过利用大型语言模型生成交互式自然语言描述，提供了一种有效且易于访问的聚类解释方法，特别适合吸引更广泛的非专业受众参与数据分析。
AI.translation: 降维是一种强大的技术，用于揭示数据中的结构和潜在聚类。然而，由于轴是特征的复杂、非线性组合，它们通常缺乏语义可解释性。现有的视觉分析（VA）方法通过特征比较和交互式探索支持聚类解释，但它们需要专业技术知识和大量的人力投入。我们提出了\textit{LangLasso}，这是一种新颖的方法，它通过使用大型语言模型（LLMs）提供聚类的交互式自然语言描述来补充VA方法。它生成人类可读的描述，使聚类解释对非专业人士开放，并允许整合数据集之外的外部上下文知识。我们系统地评估了这些解释的可靠性，并证明\langlasso是吸引更广泛受众参与聚类解释的有效第一步。该工具可在 https://langlasso.vercel.app 上获取。
AI.summary: 针对降维数据聚类解释缺乏语义可解释性且现有VA方法门槛高的问题，本文提出了LangLasso。LangLasso利用LLM生成聚类的交互式自然语言描述，使非专业人士也能轻松理解聚类结果，并能整合外部知识。系统评估证明了该工具在吸引更广泛受众参与聚类解释方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 聚类解释, 大型语言模型, 降维, 视觉分析, 自然语言描述
AI.comments: 该工作的创新点在于将大型语言模型（LLM）集成到视觉分析（VA）流程中，解决了降维结果和复杂VA工具难以被非专业人士理解的关键痛点。通过生成自然语言描述，LangLasso有效地弥合了数据科学的复杂性与用户可理解性之间的鸿沟，极大地提高了数据解释的民主化程度。其重要性在于，它为数据解释提供了一个低门槛的“第一步”工具，但抽象中未提及LLM生成解释的具体机制或其在处理解释偏差/幻觉方面的潜在局限性。

title: Contextual StereoSet: Stress-Testing Bias Alignment Robustness in Large Language Models
summary:
A model that avoids stereotypes in a lab benchmark may not avoid them in deployment. We show that measured bias shifts dramatically when prompts mention different places, times, or audiences -- no adversarial prompting required.
  We introduce Contextual StereoSet, a benchmark that holds stereotype content fixed while systematically varying contextual framing. Testing 13 models across two protocols, we find striking patterns: anchoring to 1990 (vs. 2030) raises stereotype selection in all models tested on this contrast (p<0.05); gossip framing raises it in 5 of 6 full-grid models; out-group observer framing shifts it by up to 13 percentage points. These effects replicate in hiring, lending, and help-seeking vignettes.
  We propose Context Sensitivity Fingerprints (CSF): a compact profile of per-dimension dispersion and paired contrasts with bootstrap CIs and FDR correction. Two evaluation tracks support different use cases -- a 360-context diagnostic grid for deep analysis and a budgeted protocol covering 4,229 items for production screening.
  The implication is methodological: bias scores from fixed-condition tests may not generalize.This is not a claim about ground-truth bias rates; it is a stress test of evaluation robustness. CSF forces evaluators to ask, "Under what conditions does bias appear?" rather than "Is this model biased?" We release our benchmark, code, and results.

AI.title_translation: 上下文StereoSet：压力测试大型语言模型的偏见对齐鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 我们引入了Contextual StereoSet基准测试，通过改变提示的上下文（时间、地点、受众）来测试LLM偏见评分的鲁棒性。结果显示，偏见会随着上下文的改变而显著变化（例如，1990年的设定比2030年更高）。我们提出了Context Sensitivity Fingerprints (CSF) 来诊断这种上下文敏感性，并强调固定条件下的偏见测试结果可能无法泛化。
AI.motivation: 发现LLM在实验室基准测试中避免的刻板印象在实际部署中可能仍然存在。具体动机是证明当提示提及不同的地点、时间或受众时，测得的偏见会发生显著变化，从而质疑固定条件偏见测试的泛化能力。
AI.method: 引入了**Contextual StereoSet**基准测试，该测试在保持刻板印象内容不变的情况下，系统地改变上下文框架（如时间、受众）。提出了**Context Sensitivity Fingerprints (CSF)** 作为一种紧凑的分析工具，用于描述每维度的分散度和配对对比，并设有两种评估轨道：用于深度分析的360度上下文诊断网格和用于生产筛选的预算协议（涵盖4,229个项目）。
AI.result: 在测试的13个模型中发现了显著的模式：将时间锚定到1990年（对比2030年）会提高所有测试模型的刻板印象选择（p<0.05）；八卦式框架在6个全网格模型中的5个中提高了偏见；局外人观察者框架可以将偏见转移高达13个百分点。这些影响在招聘、借贷和求助场景中得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 固定条件测试得出的偏见分数可能不具有泛化性。这项工作是对评估鲁棒性的压力测试，而非对实际偏见率的断言。提倡评估者应通过CSF工具询问“偏见在何种条件下出现？”而不是“这个模型是否有偏见？”。
AI.translation:
一个在实验室基准测试中避免刻板印象的模型，在实际部署中可能无法避免。我们展示了当提示中提到不同的地点、时间或受众时，测得的偏见会发生显著变化——而且不需要对抗性提示。
我们引入了Contextual StereoSet，这是一个在保持刻板印象内容不变的同时，系统地改变上下文框架的基准测试。在两种协议下测试了13个模型后，我们发现了惊人的模式：将时间锚定到1990年（对比2030年）会提高所有测试模型中刻板印象的选择（p<0.05）；八卦式框架在6个全网格模型中的5个中提高了偏见；局外人观察者框架可以将偏见转移高达13个百分点。这些影响在招聘、借贷和求助的场景中得到了复现。
我们提出了上下文敏感性指纹（CSF）：一个紧凑的分析概要，包含每维度的分散度和配对对比，并带有自举置信区间和FDR校正。两种评估轨道支持不同的使用场景——一个用于深度分析的360度上下文诊断网格，以及一个涵盖4,229个项目的预算协议，用于生产筛选。
其方法论上的启示是：来自固定条件测试的偏见分数可能无法泛化。这并非是对实际偏见率的断言；它是对评估鲁棒性的一次压力测试。CSF迫使评估者去问：“偏见在何种条件下出现？”而不是“这个模型是否有偏见？”我们发布了我们的基准测试、代码和结果。
