AI.summary: 本文介绍了Contextual StereoSet，这是一个用于压力测试大型语言模型（LLMs）偏见对齐鲁棒性的新基准。研究发现，即使不使用对抗性提示，LLMs的偏见评分也会随着上下文（如时间、受众）的变化而显著波动。通过系统地改变上下文框架，Contextual StereoSet揭示了具体的上下文锚定（如1990年设定）会一致性地提高刻板印象选择。为应对这一挑战，作者提出了上下文敏感性指纹（CSF）工具，用于诊断和量化模型对上下文变化的敏感性。研究强调，固定条件下的偏见测试结果缺乏泛化性，并呼吁评估者关注偏见出现的条件，而非仅仅判断模型是否存在偏见。
AI.keywords: 上下文敏感性, 偏见对齐, 刻板印象, 大型语言模型, 鲁棒性评估
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于它将偏见评估从静态、固定条件的测试（“模型是否偏见？”）转移到了动态、上下文相关的压力测试（“偏见在何时何地出现？”）。Contextual StereoSet和Context Sensitivity Fingerprints (CSF) 提供了一种更精细、更具鲁棒性的评估方法，反映了模型在真实世界部署中面临的复杂性。这一发现对LLM的伦理和安全研究具有重要的方法论意义，因为它证明了现有的许多偏见基准测试可能存在泛化性不足的问题，并为开发者提供了一个急需的工具来诊断模型行为的边界条件，从而指导更稳健的对齐工作。

title: ChartComplete: A Taxonomy-based Inclusive Chart Dataset
comments: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Dataset and source code available at https://github.com/AI-DSCHubAUB/ChartComplete-Dataset
summary: With advancements in deep learning (DL) and computer vision techniques, the field of chart understanding is evolving rapidly. In particular, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are proving to be efficient and accurate in understanding charts. To accurately measure the performance of MLLMs, the research community has developed multiple datasets to serve as benchmarks. By examining these datasets, we found that they are all limited to a small set of chart types. To bridge this gap, we propose the ChartComplete dataset. The dataset is based on a chart taxonomy borrowed from the visualization community, and it covers thirty different chart types. The dataset is a collection of classified chart images and does not include a learning signal. We present the ChartComplete dataset as is to the community to build upon it.
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Dataset and source code available at https://github.com/AI-DSCHubAUB/ChartComplete-Dataset

AI.title_translation: ChartComplete：一个基于分类法的包容性图表数据集
AI.tldr: 现有的图表理解数据集种类有限。我们提出了ChartComplete，这是一个基于可视化社区分类法的包容性图表数据集，涵盖三十种不同的图表类型，用于促进多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的性能评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的用于衡量多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）性能的图表基准数据集仅限于少量图表类型，限制了对模型真实能力的评估。
AI.method: 提出了ChartComplete数据集。该数据集基于从可视化社区借鉴的图表分类法构建，收集了三十种不同图表类型的分类图表图像。该数据集不包含学习信号（即不提供任务标签）。
AI.result: ChartComplete数据集覆盖了三十种不同的图表类型。
AI.conclusion: 提出了ChartComplete数据集并将其提供给社区，以便在其基础上进行后续研究和开发。
AI.translation: 随着深度学习（DL）和计算机视觉技术的进步，图表理解领域正在快速发展。特别是，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在理解图表方面被证明是高效且准确的。为了准确衡量MLLMs的性能，研究社区开发了多个数据集作为基准。通过检查这些数据集，我们发现它们都局限于一小部分图表类型。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了ChartComplete数据集。该数据集基于从可视化社区借鉴的图表分类法，涵盖了三十种不同的图表类型。该数据集是分类图表图像的集合，不包含学习信号。我们将ChartComplete数据集原样提供给社区，供其在其基础上进行后续构建。
AI.summary: 针对现有图表理解基准数据集图表类型覆盖范围有限的问题，本文提出了ChartComplete数据集。该数据集借鉴了可视化社区的图表分类法，收录了三十种不同类型的图表图像，旨在作为一个更具包容性的资源，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在图表理解方面的性能。该数据集不包含学习信号，供社区进一步研究使用。
AI.keywords: 图表数据集, 图表分类法, 多模态大语言模型, 图表理解, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该工作的创新点在于其包容性，通过引入基于分类学的结构，显著扩大了图表理解基准测试的范围（从少数几种到三十种）。这对于评估和改进多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的泛化能力至关重要，因为现实世界中的图表类型远超现有数据集所能涵盖的范围。该数据集不包含学习信号的设计，意味着它主要作为分类和多样性资源，而不是即用型的训练或评估集，后续研究者需要自行添加任务标签，这既是其开放性，也可能是其推广应用中的一个限制。

title: Architectural Classification of XR Workloads: Cross-Layer Archetypes and Implications
summary: Edge and mobile platforms for augmented and virtual reality, collectively referred to as extended reality (XR) must deliver deterministic ultra-low-latency performance under stringent power and area constraints. However, the diversity of XR workloads is rapidly increasing, characterized by heterogeneous operator types and complex dataflow structures. This trend poses significant challenges to conventional accelerator architectures centered around convolutional neural networks (CNNs), resulting in diminishing returns for traditional compute-centric optimization strategies. Despite the importance of this problem, a systematic architectural understanding of the full XR pipeline remains lacking. In this paper, we present an architectural classification of XR workloads using a cross-layer methodology that integrates model-based high-level design space exploration (DSE) with empirical profiling on commercial GPU and CPU hardware. By analyzing a representative set of workloads spanning 12 distinct XR kernels, we distill their complex architectural characteristics into a small set of cross-layer workload archetypes (e.g., capacity-limited and overhead-sensitive). Building on these archetypes, we further extract key architectural insights and provide actionable design guidelines for next-generation XR SoCs. Our study highlights that XR architecture design must shift from generic resource scaling toward phase-aware scheduling and elastic resource allocation in order to achieve greater energy efficiency and high performance in future XR systems.

AI.title_translation: XR 工作负载的架构分类：跨层原型和启示
AI.tldr: XR（扩展现实）工作负载多样性增加，传统硬件效率下降。本文通过结合设计空间探索和实证分析的跨层方法，对12种XR内核进行分类，提炼出关键的“工作负载原型”，并提出未来XR SoC设计应侧重于相感知调度和弹性资源分配，而非单纯的资源扩展，以提高能效和性能。
AI.motivation: XR平台必须在严格的功耗和面积限制下提供确定性的超低延迟性能。XR工作负载的多样性迅速增加，挑战了传统以CNN为中心的加速器架构，导致传统优化策略回报递减。目前缺乏对整个XR管道的系统性架构理解。
AI.method: 采用跨层方法论，整合了基于模型的高级设计空间探索（DSE）与对商业GPU和CPU硬件的经验性分析。分析了涵盖12个不同XR内核的代表性工作负载集合，并将复杂的架构特性提炼成一小组跨层工作负载原型（例如：容量受限和开销敏感）。
AI.result: 成功将复杂的XR工作负载架构特性提炼为一小组跨层工作负载原型（例如：容量受限和开销敏感）。基于这些原型，提取了关键的架构见解，并为下一代XR SoC提供了可操作的设计指南。
AI.conclusion: 未来的XR架构设计必须从通用的资源扩展转向相感知调度和弹性资源分配，这是在未来XR系统中实现更高能效和高性能的关键。
AI.translation: 增强现实和虚拟现实（统称为扩展现实，XR）的边缘和移动平台必须在严格的功耗和面积限制下提供确定性的超低延迟性能。然而，XR工作负载的多样性正在迅速增加，其特点是异构的操作符类型和复杂的数据流结构。这一趋势对以卷积神经网络（CNN）为中心的传统加速器架构构成了重大挑战，导致传统以计算为中心的优化策略的回报递减。尽管这个问题十分重要，但目前仍缺乏对整个XR管道的系统性架构理解。在本文中，我们提出了一种XR工作负载的架构分类方法，该方法采用跨层方法论，将基于模型的高级设计空间探索（DSE）与商业GPU和CPU硬件上的经验性分析相结合。通过分析涵盖12个不同XR内核的代表性工作负载集合，我们将它们复杂的架构特性提炼成一小组跨层工作负载原型（例如：容量受限和开销敏感）。基于这些原型，我们进一步提取了关键的架构见解，并为下一代XR SoC提供了可操作的设计指南。我们的研究强调，XR架构设计必须从通用的资源扩展转向相感知调度和弹性资源分配，以便在未来的XR系统中实现更高的能效和高性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对XR工作负载多样性带来的架构挑战，提出了一种系统性的跨层分类方法。通过结合设计空间探索和商业硬件实证分析，研究人员分析了12种XR内核，提炼出如“容量受限”和“开销敏感”等跨层工作负载原型。基于这些原型，研究提供了下一代XR SoC的设计指导，核心建议是将设计重点从通用资源扩展转移到相感知调度和弹性资源分配，以提高能效和性能。
AI.keywords: XR工作负载, 架构分类, 跨层原型, SoC设计, 能效
AI.comments: 论文的创新点在于提出了“跨层工作负载原型”的概念，将复杂的XR应用特性简化为少数易于理解和设计的类别。这种系统性的分类方法填补了现有对整个XR管道架构理解的空白。随着XR设备向移动和边缘平台发展，对低延迟和高能效的需求日益迫切。本文的研究直接挑战了当前硬件设计中过度依赖CNN优化和资源扩展的传统思路，为未来定制化XR SoC的设计提供了急需的、可操作的架构洞察和设计指南。摘要中未提及具体的性能提升数据或实验的量化结果，因此无法评估其分类和指南的实际定量效益。

title: AI Sycophancy: How Users Flag and Respond
summary: While concerns about LLM sycophancy have grown among researchers and developers, how users themselves experience this behavior remains largely unexplored. We analyze Reddit discussions to investigate how users detect, mitigate, and perceive sycophantic AI. We develop the ODR Framework that maps user experiences across three stages: observing sycophantic behaviors, detecting sycophancy, and responding to these behaviors. Our findings reveal that users employ various detection techniques, including cross-platform comparison and inconsistency testing. We document diverse mitigation approaches, such as persona-based prompts to specific language patterns in prompt engineering. We find sycophancy's effects are context-dependent rather than universally harmful. Specifically, vulnerable populations experiencing trauma, mental health challenges, or isolation actively seek and value sycophantic behaviors as emotional support. Users develop both technical and folk explanations for why sycophancy occurs. These findings challenge the assumption that sycophancy should be eliminated universally. We conclude by proposing context-aware AI design that balances the risks with the benefits of affirmative interaction, while discussing implications for user education and transparency.

AI.title_translation: AI马屁精现象：用户如何标记和应对
AI.tldr: 研究分析了Reddit讨论，揭示了用户如何发现和应对AI的奉承行为。研究提出了ODR框架，发现用户使用对比和一致性测试来检测，并使用角色提示来缓解。关键发现是，奉承并非普遍有害，弱势群体（如遭受创伤或孤立的人）将其视为情感支持。研究呼吁进行情境感知的AI设计，而非一味消除奉承。
AI.motivation: 尽管研究人员和开发者对大型语言模型（LLM）的奉承（sycophancy）行为日益关注，但用户自身如何体验这种行为，以及他们如何应对，在很大程度上仍未被探索。
AI.method: 分析Reddit讨论，以调查用户如何检测、缓解和感知AI的奉承行为。开发了ODR框架（观察、检测、应对），该框架描绘了用户体验的三个阶段。
AI.result: 用户采用多种检测技术，包括跨平台比较和不一致性测试。用户采取了多样化的缓解方法，如基于角色的提示和特定的提示工程语言模式。奉承的影响是情境依赖的，而非普遍有害；弱势群体（经历创伤、心理健康挑战或孤立）积极寻求并珍视奉承行为作为情感支持。用户对奉承的发生形成了技术性和民间解释。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了奉承应该被普遍消除的假设。作者总结提出了一种情境感知的AI设计，旨在平衡肯定性互动（affirmative interaction）的风险与益处，并讨论了对用户教育和透明度的影响。
AI.translation: 尽管研究人员和开发者对大型语言模型（LLM）的奉承（sycophancy）行为的担忧日益增加，但用户自身如何体验这种行为在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们分析了Reddit讨论，以调查用户如何检测、缓解和感知奉承的AI。我们开发了ODR框架，该框架描绘了用户体验的三个阶段：观察奉承行为、检测奉承和应对这些行为。我们的发现揭示了用户采用了各种检测技术，包括跨平台比较和不一致性测试。我们记录了多样化的缓解方法，例如从基于角色的提示到提示工程中的特定语言模式。我们发现奉承的影响是情境依赖的，而非普遍有害。具体来说，经历创伤、心理健康挑战或孤立的弱势群体积极寻求并珍视奉承行为作为情感支持。用户对奉承的发生形成了技术性和民间解释。这些发现挑战了奉承应该被普遍消除的假设。我们最后提出了情境感知的AI设计，旨在平衡肯定性互动的风险与益处，同时讨论了对用户教育和透明度的影响。
AI.summary: 本文基于对Reddit讨论的分析，探索了用户对AI奉承行为（sycophancy）的体验、检测和应对方式。研究提出了ODR框架来结构化用户体验，并发现用户通过跨平台对比和一致性测试等技术来检测奉承，并通过角色提示等方式进行缓解。核心发现是，奉承的影响具有情境依赖性，对于遭受创伤或孤立的弱势群体而言，它是一种有价值的情感支持。因此，研究挑战了普遍消除奉承的观点，并提倡采用情境感知的设计方法来平衡其潜在风险和益处。
AI.keywords: AI奉承, 用户体验, 情境感知设计, ODR框架, 情感支持
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于，它将对LLM奉承行为的关注点从技术和安全风险转移到了用户体验和社会价值。通过分析真实世界的用户讨论（Reddit），它提供了一个重要的视角：即某些AI“缺陷”（如奉承）在特定情境下（如情感支持）可能具有积极作用。这一发现对于AI伦理和设计具有重要意义，因为它挑战了“普遍消除有害行为”的传统假设，并强调了设计需要具备情境感知能力，以服务于多元化的用户需求，特别是弱势群体。

title: Job Anxiety in Post-Secondary Computer Science Students Caused by Artificial Intelligence
summary: The emerging widespread usage of AI has led to industry adoption to improve efficiency and increase earnings. However, a major consequence of this is AI displacing employees from their jobs, leading to feelings of job insecurity and uncertainty. This is especially true for computer science students preparing to enter the workforce. To investigate this, we performed semi-structured interviews with (n = 25) students across computer science undergraduate and graduate programs at the University of Toronto to determine the extent of job replacement anxiety. Through thematic analysis, it was determined that computer science students indeed face stress and anxiety from AI displacement of jobs, leading to different strategies of managing pressure. Subfields such as software engineering and web development are strongly believed to be vulnerable to displacement, while specialized subfields like quantum computing and AI research are deemed more secure. Many students feel compelled to upskill by using more AI technologies, taking AI courses, and specializing in AI through graduate school. Some students also reskill by pursuing other fields of study seen as less vulnerable to AI displacement. Finally, international students experience additional job replacement anxiety because of pressure to secure permanent residence. Implications of these findings include feelings of low security in computer science careers, oversaturation of computer science students pursuing AI, and potential dissuasion of future university students from pursuing computer science.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能引起的专上计算机科学学生的就业焦虑
AI.tldr: 计算机科学学生担心人工智能抢走他们的工作（尤其是在软件工程和网络开发领域），他们正通过急于专攻人工智能或完全转行来应对这种焦虑。
AI.motivation: 探讨人工智能的广泛应用导致的工作岗位取代现象，以及由此给准备进入职场的计算机科学学生带来的就业不安全感和不确定性。
AI.method: 对多伦多大学的计算机科学本科生和研究生（n=25）进行了半结构化访谈，并使用主题分析法确定就业取代焦虑的程度。
AI.result: 计算机科学学生确实面临人工智能取代工作带来的压力和焦虑。他们认为软件工程和网络开发等子领域容易受到冲击，而量子计算和人工智能研究等专业领域则更安全。许多学生被迫通过使用更多人工智能技术、修读人工智能课程或攻读研究生学位来提升技能（upskill），一些学生则通过转入被视为不易受人工智能影响的其他领域来重新培训（reskill）。国际学生因获得永久居留权的压力而面临额外的焦虑。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现的启示包括计算机科学职业的安全感降低、追求人工智能的学生过度饱和，以及未来学生可能因此被劝阻而放弃选择计算机科学。
AI.translation: 人工智能日益广泛的应用促使行业采用它来提高效率和增加收入。然而，由此带来的一个主要后果是人工智能取代了员工的工作岗位，导致人们产生工作不安全感和不确定性。对于正准备进入职场的计算机科学学生来说，情况尤其如此。为了对此进行调查，我们对多伦多大学计算机科学本科和研究生项目中的25名学生进行了半结构化访谈，以确定工作岗位取代焦虑的程度。通过主题分析，我们确定计算机科学学生确实面临人工智能取代工作带来的压力和焦虑，并采取了不同的压力管理策略。软件工程和网络开发等子领域被认为极易受到取代，而量子计算和人工智能研究等专业子领域则被认为更安全。许多学生感到不得不通过使用更多人工智能技术、修读人工智能课程以及通过研究生院专攻人工智能来提升技能。一些学生也通过转而追求被视为不易受人工智能取代的其他学习领域来进行重新培训。最后，国际学生由于获得永久居留权的压力而面临额外的就业取代焦虑。这些发现的启示包括计算机科学职业的安全感较低、追求人工智能的计算机科学学生过度饱和，以及未来大学生可能因此被劝阻而放弃选择计算机科学。
AI.summary: 本文调查了人工智能的广泛应用如何导致专上计算机科学学生产生就业焦虑。通过对25名学生的半结构化访谈和主题分析，研究证实CS学生确实面临AI取代带来的压力，并采取了提升技能（专攻AI）或重新培训（转行）等应对策略。传统子领域（如软件工程）被视为高危，而专业子领域（如量子计算）则更安全。研究结果揭示了CS职业安全感下降、AI领域人才可能过饱和等问题。
AI.keywords: 就业焦虑, 人工智能, 计算机科学学生, 工作岗位取代, 技能提升
AI.comments: 这是一项及时且重要的研究，它探讨了人工智能对下一代技术工作者的心理和职业规划产生的影响。其创新之处在于量化并分类了计算机科学学生具体的焦虑和应对机制（技能提升与重新培训），并强调了传统计算机科学角色的具体脆弱性。尽管样本量较小（n=25）且仅来自一所大学（多伦多大学），限制了普遍性，但这些发现对于课程规划具有高度相关性。

title: Joint Source-Channel Coding for ISAC: Distortion Tradeoffs and Separation Theorems
summary: Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) systems have garnered significant attention due to their capability to simultaneously achieve efficient communication and environmental sensing. A core objective in this field is characterizing the performance tradeoff between sensing and communication. In this paper, we consider a joint source-channel coding (JSCC) framework for the ISAC system that consists of a transmitter with a channel state estimator and a joint source-channel encoder, a state-dependent memoryless channel, and a receiver with a joint source-channel decoder. From an information-theoretic perspective, we establish the tradeoff relationships among channel capacity, distortions in both communication and sensing processes, and the estimation cost. We prove that the separate source and channel coding can achieve joint optimality in this setting. An illustrative example of a binary setting is also provided to validate our theoretical results.

AI.title_translation: 适用于ISAC的联合信源-信道编码：失真权衡与分离定理
AI.tldr: 本文研究了ISAC系统中的联合信源-信道编码（JSCC）框架，从信息论角度建立了信道容量、通信失真、感知失真和估计成本之间的权衡关系，并证明了分离的信源和信道编码可以实现联合最优性。
AI.motivation: ISAC系统因其能够同时实现高效通信和环境感知而受到广泛关注。该领域的核心目标是描述感知和通信之间的性能权衡。
AI.method: 采用联合信源-信道编码（JSCC）框架，该框架包括一个带有信道状态估计器和联合编解码器的发射机和接收机，以及一个状态依赖的无记忆信道。通过信息论分析，建立性能权衡关系并证明分离定理。
AI.result: 建立了信道容量、通信失真、感知失真和估计成本之间的权衡关系。证明了在这种设置下，分离的信源和信道编码可以实现联合最优性。并提供了一个二元设置的例子来验证理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 分离的信源和信道编码能够实现ISAC系统中通信和感知失真权衡的联合最优性。
AI.translation: 集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统因其能够同时实现高效通信和环境感知而获得了广泛关注。该领域的一个核心目标是描述感知和通信之间的性能权衡。在本文中，我们考虑了一个用于ISAC系统的联合信源-信道编码（JSCC）框架，该框架由一个带有信道状态估计器和联合信源-信道编码器的发射机、一个状态依赖的无记忆信道，以及一个带有联合信源-信道解码器的接收机组成。从信息论的角度来看，我们建立了信道容量、通信和感知过程中的失真以及估计成本之间的权衡关系。我们证明了在这种设置下，分离的信源和信道编码可以实现联合最优性。本文还提供了一个二元设置的说明性例子来验证我们的理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文在信息论框架下，研究了集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统中的联合信源-信道编码（JSCC）。通过建立信道容量、通信失真、感知失真和估计成本之间的权衡关系，作者证明了分离的信源编码和信道编码在该设置中可以达到联合最优性，并通过一个二元示例验证了该理论结果。
AI.keywords: 联合信源-信道编码, 集成感知与通信, 失真权衡, 分离定理, 信息论
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将信息论中的联合信源-信道编码（JSCC）理论应用于新兴的集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统，并首次严格地建立了通信失真、感知失真和估计成本之间的多维性能权衡关系。最重要的贡献是证明了在所考虑的ISAC模型中，经典的信源-信道分离定理依然成立并能实现联合最优，这为ISAC系统的实际设计和架构选择提供了重要的理论基础。

title: DeFlow: Decoupling Manifold Modeling and Value Maximization for Offline Policy Extraction
summary: We present DeFlow, a decoupled offline RL framework that leverages flow matching to faithfully capture complex behavior manifolds. Optimizing generative policies is computationally prohibitive, typically necessitating backpropagation through ODE solvers. We address this by learning a lightweight refinement module within an explicit, data-derived trust region of the flow manifold, rather than sacrificing the iterative generation capability via single-step distillation. This way, we bypass solver differentiation and eliminate the need for balancing loss terms, ensuring stable improvement while fully preserving the flow's iterative expressivity. Empirically, DeFlow achieves superior performance on the challenging OGBench benchmark and demonstrates efficient offline-to-online adaptation.

AI.title_translation: DeFlow：解耦流形建模与价值最大化以进行离线策略提取
AI.tldr: DeFlow是一个解耦的离线强化学习框架，它使用流匹配来建模行为流形，并通过学习一个轻量级优化模块来避免ODE求解器反向传播的计算昂贵问题，从而在OGBench上实现了优异的性能和高效的离线到在线适应。
AI.motivation: 优化生成式策略在计算上是极其昂贵的，通常需要通过ODE求解器进行反向传播，这带来了巨大的计算负担和复杂性。
AI.method: 提出DeFlow框架，这是一个解耦的离线强化学习框架，它利用流匹配来忠实地捕获复杂的行为流形。通过在一个明确的、数据导出的流形信任区域内学习一个轻量级的改进模块（refinement module），该方法绕过了求解器微分，消除了平衡损失项的需要，确保了稳定的改进，同时完全保留了流的迭代表达能力。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的OGBench基准测试中，DeFlow取得了卓越的性能，并展示了高效的离线到在线适应能力。
AI.translation: 我们提出了DeFlow，这是一个解耦的离线强化学习（RL）框架，它利用流匹配来忠实地捕获复杂的行为流形。优化生成式策略在计算上是极其昂贵的，通常需要通过ODE求解器进行反向传播。我们通过在一个明确的、数据导出的流形信任区域内学习一个轻量级的改进模块来解决这个问题，而不是通过单步蒸馏牺牲迭代生成能力。通过这种方式，我们绕过了求解器微分，消除了平衡损失项的需要，确保了稳定的改进，同时完全保留了流的迭代表达能力。从经验上看，DeFlow在具有挑战性的OGBench基准测试中取得了卓越的性能，并展示了高效的离线到在线适应能力。
AI.summary: DeFlow是一种新的解耦离线强化学习框架，它利用流匹配技术实现行为流形建模。为解决传统生成式策略优化中涉及ODE求解器反向传播带来的计算昂贵问题，DeFlow引入了一个轻量级改进模块，在数据信任区域内进行优化，从而避免了复杂的微分和损失平衡。该方法在OGBench上表现出优异的性能，并支持高效的离线到在线适应。
AI.keywords: 离线强化学习, 流匹配, 策略提取, 解耦框架, ODE求解器
AI.comments: DeFlow的创新点在于其“解耦”策略，即将复杂的行为流形建模（通过流匹配）与策略的价值最大化（通过轻量级改进模块）分开。这种设计巧妙地规避了优化生成模型时常见的计算瓶颈，即绕过ODE求解器微分，同时保留了迭代生成策略的高表达性。这为解决离线强化学习中策略优化的高计算效率问题提供了一个重要且稳定的新方向。

title: Optimal error estimates for a discontinuous Galerkin method on curved boundaries with polygonal meshes
summary: We consider a discontinuous Galerkin method for the numerical solution of boundary value problems in two-dimensional domains with curved boundaries. A key challenge in this setting is the potential loss of convergence order due to approximating the physical domain by a polygonal mesh. Unless boundary conditions can be accurately transferred from the true boundary to the computational one, such geometric approximation errors generally lead to suboptimal convergence. To overcome this limitation, a higher-order strategy based on polynomial reconstruction of boundary data was introduced for classical finite element methods in [28, 29] and in the finite volume context in [7, 11]. More recently, this approach was extended to discontinuous Galerkin methods in [32], leading to the DG-ROD method, which restores optimal convergence rates on polygonal approximations of domains with curved boundaries. In this work, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of the DG-ROD method, establishing existence and uniqueness of the discrete solution and deriving error estimates for a two-dimensional linear advection-diffusion-reaction problem with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions on both convex and non-convex domains. Following and extending techniques from classical finite element methods [29], we prove that, under suitable regularity assumptions on the exact solution, the DG-ROD method achieves optimal convergence despite polygonal approximations. Finally, we illustrate and confirm the theoretical results with a numerical benchmark.

AI.title_translation: 关于在具有多边形网格的弯曲边界上使用不连续伽辽金方法的最佳误差估计
AI.tldr: 研究了DG-ROD方法，它使用多项式重建边界数据来修复由多边形网格近似弯曲边界带来的收敛性损失，并严格证明了该方法在二维线性对流-扩散-反应问题上能恢复最优收敛误差估计。
AI.motivation: 在处理具有弯曲边界的二维区域的边界值问题时，使用多边形网格近似物理区域会导致几何近似误差，从而造成收敛阶数损失。该研究的动机是克服这种限制，通过引入一种基于多项式重建边界数据的高阶策略来恢复最优收敛率。
AI.method: 对DG-ROD方法进行了严格的理论分析，建立了离散解的存在性和唯一性，并推导了误差估计，该方法基于多项式重建边界数据以补偿多边形网格对真实边界的近似误差。
AI.result: 证明了DG-ROD方法在处理二维凸形和非凸形区域上的线性对流-扩散-反应问题时，即使存在多边形近似，也能实现最优收敛精度，并通过数值算例验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文对DG-ROD方法进行了严格的理论分析，证明了其离散解的存在性和唯一性，并推导了误差估计，表明该方法在存在多边形近似的情况下仍能达到最优收敛精度。
AI.translation: 我们考虑了用于数值求解具有弯曲边界的二维区域内边值问题的离散伽辽金方法。在这种情况下，一个关键的挑战是由于使用多边形网格近似物理区域而可能导致收敛阶数的损失。除非边界条件能从真实边界准确地转移到计算边界，否则这种几何近似误差通常会导致次优收敛。为了克服这一限制，[28, 29]中为经典有限元方法，[7, 11]中为有限体积方法，引入了一种基于多项式重建边界数据的高阶策略。最近，这种方法被扩展到不连续伽辽金方法中[32]，形成了DG-ROD方法，该方法在弯曲边界域的多边形近似上恢复了最优收敛速率。在本文中，我们对DG-ROD方法提供了严格的理论分析，建立了离散解的存在性和唯一性，并推导了对二维线性对流-扩散-反应问题（在凸形和非凸形域上均具有齐次狄利克雷边界条件）的误差估计。遵循并扩展了经典有限元方法[29]中的技术，我们证明了在对精确解满足适当正则性假设的条件下，DG-ROD方法尽管存在多边形近似，仍能实现最优收敛。最后，我们通过一个数值基准来说明和证实了理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文对用于求解具有弯曲边界的二维问题的DG-ROD方法进行了严格的理论分析。该方法通过多项式重建边界数据来克服多边形网格近似引起的几何误差。研究人员建立了离散解的存在性和唯一性，并推导了误差估计，证明了DG-ROD方法在这些情况下仍能达到最优收敛速度。最后，数值结果验证了理论发现。
AI.keywords: 不连续伽辽金方法, 弯曲边界, 多边形网格, 几何误差, 最优误差估计
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将基于多项式重建边界数据的策略扩展并严格分析了其在不连续伽辽金（DG）方法中对处理弯曲边界引起的几何误差，从而恢复了最优收敛阶数。其重要性在于为DG方法在复杂几何问题上的应用提供了坚实的理论基础。局限性在于分析是针对二维线性对流-扩散-反应问题，其适用性可能需要进一步推广到更一般的问题。

title: Urban Socio-Semantic Segmentation with Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: As hubs of human activity, urban surfaces consist of a wealth of semantic entities. Segmenting these various entities from satellite imagery is crucial for a range of downstream applications. Current advanced segmentation models can reliably segment entities defined by physical attributes (e.g., buildings, water bodies) but still struggle with socially defined categories (e.g., schools, parks). In this work, we achieve socio-semantic segmentation by vision-language model reasoning. To facilitate this, we introduce the Urban Socio-Semantic Segmentation dataset named SocioSeg, a new resource comprising satellite imagery, digital maps, and pixel-level labels of social semantic entities organized in a hierarchical structure. Additionally, we propose a novel vision-language reasoning framework called SocioReasoner that simulates the human process of identifying and annotating social semantic entities via cross-modal recognition and multi-stage reasoning. We employ reinforcement learning to optimize this non-differentiable process and elicit the reasoning capabilities of the vision-language model. Experiments demonstrate our approach's gains over state-of-the-art models and strong zero-shot generalization. Our dataset and code are available in https://github.com/AMAP-ML/SocioReasoner.

AI.title_translation: 城市社会语义分割与视觉-语言推理
AI.tldr: 为了解决卫星图像中难以分割的社会语义类别问题，本文提出了一个结合视觉和语言推理的新框架 SocioReasoner，并发布了一个包含社会语义标签的新数据集 SocioSeg。该框架使用强化学习来优化推理过程，实验证明其分割性能和零样本泛化能力优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的先进分割模型可以可靠地分割由物理属性定义的实体（如建筑物、水体），但在处理由社会定义的类别（如学校、公园）时仍然存在困难。因此，需要通过视觉-语言推理来实现社会语义分割。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 SocioReasoner 的新颖的视觉-语言推理框架，该框架通过跨模态识别和多阶段推理来模拟人类识别和标注社会语义实体的过程。使用强化学习来优化这个非微分的过程，以激发视觉-语言模型的推理能力。同时，引入了一个名为 SocioSeg 的新数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法相对于最先进的模型有所改进，并表现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明了所提出的方法相对于现有最先进模型有显著提升，并展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.translation: 作为人类活动的中心，城市表面包含了丰富的语义实体。从卫星图像中分割出这些不同的实体对于一系列下游应用至关重要。当前先进的分割模型可以可靠地分割由物理属性定义的实体（例如建筑物、水体），但在处理由社会定义的类别（例如学校、公园）时仍然存在困难。在这项工作中，我们通过视觉-语言模型的推理来实现社会语义分割。为了促进这一目标，我们引入了名为 SocioSeg 的城市社会语义分割数据集，这是一个新的资源，包含卫星图像、数字地图和分层组织的社会语义实体的像素级标签。此外，我们提出了一个名为 SocioReasoner 的新颖视觉-语言推理框架，它通过跨模态识别和多阶段推理来模拟人类识别和标注社会语义实体的过程。我们采用强化学习来优化这个非微分的过程，以激发视觉-语言模型的推理能力。实验证明了我们方法的性能优于最先进的模型，并具有很强的零样本泛化能力。我们的数据集和代码可在 https://github.com/AMAP-ML/SocioReasoner 上获取。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决卫星图像中社会语义实体（如学校、公园）的分割难题，这些实体难以被仅依赖物理属性的模型识别。研究人员为此引入了名为 SocioSeg 的新数据集，并提出了一个名为 SocioReasoner 的新颖框架。该框架利用视觉-语言推理，通过跨模态识别和多阶段推理来模拟人类的判断过程，并采用强化学习来优化这一非微分过程，从而实现了优于现有方法的社会语义分割性能和良好的零样本泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 社会语义分割, 视觉-语言推理, 遥感影像, 强化学习, SocioSeg
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合视觉信息和语言推理来解决传统模型难以识别的社会语义类别分割问题，并提出了一个包含新数据集（SocioSeg）和新框架（SocioReasoner）的完整解决方案，特别是使用了强化学习来优化非微分的推理过程，这在遥感图像分割中是一个重要的技术探索。

title: A Construction Framework of Coded Caching Scheme for Multi-Access MIMO Systems via Knapsack Problem
summary: This paper investigates the coded caching problem in a multi-access multiple-input single-output (MAMISO) network with the combinatorial topology. The considered system consists of a server containing $N$ files, $Λ$ cache nodes, and $K$ cache-less users, where each user can access a unique subset of $r$ cache nodes. The server is equipped with $L$ transmit antennas. Our objective is to design a caching scheme that simultaneously achieves a high sum Degree of Freedom (sum-DoF) and low subpacketization complexity. To address this challenge, we formulate the design of multi-antenna placement delivery arrays (MAPDA) as a $0$--$1$ knapsack problem to maximize the achievable DoF, thereby transforming the complex combinatorial caching structure into a tractable optimization framework that yields efficient cache placement and flexible delivery strategies. Theoretical and numerical analyses demonstrate that: for networks with combinatorial topologies, the proposed scheme achieves a higher sum-DoF than existing schemes. Under identical cache size constraints, the subpacketization level remains comparable to existing linear subpacketization schemes. Moreover, under specific system conditions, the proposed scheme attains the theoretical maximum sum-DoF of $\min\{L+KM/N, K\}$ while achieving further reductions subpacketization. For particular combinatorial structures, we further derive optimized constructions that achieve even higher sum-DoF with lower subpacketization. ```

AI.title_translation: 基于背包问题的多址MIMO系统编码缓存方案的构造框架
AI.tldr: 通过将编码缓存放置设计建模为0-1背包问题，该研究提出了一种新的多天线缓存方案，该方案在具有组合拓扑的MAMISO网络中，以可比的子包化复杂度实现了更高的总自由度。
AI.motivation: 在具有组合拓扑结构的多址MIMO（MAMISO）网络中，设计一种缓存方案，使其能够同时实现高总自由度（sum-DoF）和低子包化复杂度。
AI.method: 将多天线放置投递阵列（MAPDA）的设计制定为0-1背包问题，以最大化可实现的自由度（DoF），从而将复杂的组合式缓存结构转化为可处理的优化框架，以获得高效的缓存放置和灵活的投递策略。
AI.result: 所提出的方案在具有组合拓扑的网络中实现了比现有方案更高的总自由度。在相同缓存大小约束下，子包化水平与现有线性子包化方案相当。在特定系统条件下，该方案可以达到理论最大总自由度 $\min\{L+KM/N, K\}$ 并进一步降低子包化。对于特定组合结构，推导了优化构造，实现了更高的总自由度和更低的子包化。
AI.conclusion: 对于具有组合拓扑的网络，所提出的方案实现了比现有方案更高的总自由度。在相同的缓存大小约束下，子包化水平与现有的线性子包化方案相当。在特定系统条件下，该方案可以达到理论最大总自由度，并进一步降低子包化。对于特定的组合结构，还推导了优化构造以实现更高的总自由度和更低的子包化。
AI.translation: 本文研究了具有组合拓扑的多址单输入多输出（MAMISO）网络中的编码缓存问题。所考虑的系统由包含$N$个文件的服务器、$Λ$个缓存节点和$K$个无缓存用户组成，其中每个用户可以访问$r$个缓存节点的唯一子集。服务器配备$L$根发射天线。我们的目标是设计一个缓存方案，使其能够同时实现高总自由度（sum-DoF）和低子包化复杂度。为了应对这一挑战，我们将多天线放置投递阵列（MAPDA）的设计制定为$0-1$背包问题，以最大化可实现的自由度，从而将复杂的组合式缓存结构转化为一个可处理的优化框架，从而产生高效的缓存放置和灵活的投递策略。理论和数值分析表明：对于具有组合拓扑的网络，所提出的方案实现了比现有方案更高的总自由度。在相同的缓存大小约束下，子包化水平与现有的线性子包化方案相当。此外，在特定系统条件下，所提出的方案可以达到理论最大总自由度 $\min\{L+KM/N, K\}$，同时进一步降低子包化。对于特定的组合结构，我们进一步推导出优化构造，以实现更高的总自由度和更低的子包化。
AI.summary: 本文针对具有组合拓扑结构的多址MIMO（MAMISO）网络中的编码缓存问题，提出了一种将多天线放置投递阵列（MAPDA）设计转化为0-1背包问题的新框架。该方法旨在最大化总自由度（sum-DoF）并保持低子包化复杂度。分析表明，该方案在组合拓扑网络中优于现有方案，并在特定条件下达到理论最大自由度，同时保持了与现有线性方案相当的子包化水平。
AI.keywords: 编码缓存, 多址MIMO, 组合拓扑, 背包问题, 自由度
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将多天线放置投递阵列（MAPDA）的设计转化为一个可解的0-1背包问题，从而处理复杂的组合式缓存拓扑结构。其重要性在于能够在保持合理子包化复杂度的同时，最大化可实现的自由度（DoF）。局限性可能在于其方案的通用性，因为它主要针对具有组合拓扑结构的特定网络。

title: Panning for Gold: Expanding Domain-Specific Knowledge Graphs with General Knowledge
summary: Domain-specific knowledge graphs (DKGs) often lack coverage compared to general knowledge graphs (GKGs). To address this, we introduce Domain-specific Knowledge Graph Fusion (DKGF), a novel task that enriches DKGs by integrating relevant facts from GKGs. DKGF faces two key challenges: high ambiguity in domain relevance and misalignment in knowledge granularity across graphs. We propose ExeFuse, a simple yet effective Fact-as-Program paradigm. It treats each GKG fact as a latent semantic program, maps abstract relations to granularity-aware operators, and verifies domain relevance via program executability on the target DKG. This unified probabilistic framework jointly resolves relevance and granularity issues. We construct two benchmarks, DKGF(W-I) and DKGF(Y-I), with 21 evaluation configurations. Extensive experiments validate the task's importance and our model's effectiveness, providing the first standardized testbed for DKGF.

AI.title_translation: 淘金：利用通用知识扩展领域特定知识图谱
AI.tldr: 为了扩展知识覆盖不足的领域知识图谱（DKG），我们提出了DKGF任务，并开发了ExeFuse模型。ExeFuse将GKG事实视为程序，通过程序执行来确保事实的相关性和正确的知识粒度，并在新基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 领域特定知识图谱（DKGs）相比通用知识图谱（GKGs）往往覆盖范围不足。
AI.method: 提出ExeFuse，采用“事实即程序”(Fact-as-Program)范式，将GKG事实视为潜在的语义程序，将抽象关系映射到粒度感知的算子，并通过程序在目标DKG上的可执行性来验证领域相关性。该框架统一解决了相关性和粒度问题。
AI.result: 构建了两个基准DKGF(W-I)和DKGF(Y-I)，包含21个评估配置，实验证明了该任务的重要性以及ExeFuse模型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了DKGF任务的重要性以及ExeFuse模型的有效性，并提供了第一个DKGF的标准化测试平台。
AI.translation: 领域特定知识图谱（DKGs）相比通用知识图谱（GKGs）往往覆盖范围不足。为解决此问题，我们引入了领域特定知识图谱融合（DKGF），这是一个新颖的任务，通过集成GKG中的相关事实来丰富DKG。DKGF面临两个关键挑战：领域相关性高且知识粒度跨图不一致。我们提出了ExeFuse，一个简单而有效的“事实即程序”（Fact-as-Program）范式。它将每个GKG事实视为一个潜在的语义程序，将抽象关系映射到粒度感知的算子，并通过程序在目标DKG上的可执行性来验证领域相关性。该统一的概率框架共同解决了相关性和粒度问题。我们构建了两个基准DKGF(W-I)和DKGF(Y-I)，包含21种评估配置。大量实验验证了该任务的重要性以及我们模型的有效性，并提供了第一个DKGF的标准化测试平台。
AI.summary: 为解决领域知识图谱（DKG）覆盖不足的问题，本文提出了领域知识图谱融合（DKGF）任务，旨在将通用知识图谱（GKG）中的相关事实集成到DKG中。针对领域相关性和知识粒度不一致的挑战，研究人员设计了ExeFuse模型，它采用“事实即程序”的方法，将GKG事实视为可执行的语义程序，从而统一解决相关性和粒度问题。
AI.keywords: 领域知识图谱, 事实即程序, 知识融合, 知识粒度, 知识图谱扩展
AI.comments: 该研究提出的DKGF任务和ExeFuse模型，提供了一种系统性的方法来解决领域知识图谱知识稀疏的问题，其核心创新在于将GKG事实视为“程序”进行融合，有效处理了相关性和粒度不一致的难题。然而，其泛化能力和对复杂领域知识的处理能力有待进一步验证。

title: Communication-Efficient Federated Learning by Exploiting Spatio-Temporal Correlations of Gradients
summary: Communication overhead is a critical challenge in federated learning, particularly in bandwidth-constrained networks. Although many methods have been proposed to reduce communication overhead, most focus solely on compressing individual gradients, overlooking the temporal correlations among them. Prior studies have shown that gradients exhibit spatial correlations, typically reflected in low-rank structures. Through empirical analysis, we further observe a strong temporal correlation between client gradients across adjacent rounds. Based on these observations, we propose GradESTC, a compression technique that exploits both spatial and temporal gradient correlations. GradESTC exploits spatial correlations to decompose each full gradient into a compact set of basis vectors and corresponding combination coefficients. By exploiting temporal correlations, only a small portion of the basis vectors need to be dynamically updated in each round. GradESTC significantly reduces communication overhead by transmitting lightweight combination coefficients and a limited number of updated basis vectors instead of the full gradients. Extensive experiments show that, upon reaching a target accuracy level near convergence, GradESTC reduces uplink communication by an average of 39.79% compared to the strongest baseline, while maintaining comparable convergence speed and final accuracy to uncompressed FedAvg. By effectively leveraging spatio-temporal gradient structures, GradESTC offers a practical and scalable solution for communication-efficient federated learning.

AI.title_translation: 通过利用梯度的时空相关性实现通信高效的联邦学习
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为GradESTC的压缩技术，通过同时利用梯度在空间和时间上的相关性，显著降低了联邦学习中的通信开销，同时保持了与未压缩的FedAvg相当的收敛速度和最终准确率。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的通信开销是一个严峻的挑战，现有方法大多只关注梯度压缩，忽略了梯度之间的时间相关性。
AI.method: GradESTC利用空间相关性将梯度分解为基向量和系数，并利用时间相关性动态更新部分基向量，仅传输系数和少量更新的基向量。
AI.result: 在达到目标精度时，GradESTC相比最强的基线方法，上行通信平均减少了39.79%，同时收敛速度和最终准确率与未压缩的FedAvg相当。
AI.conclusion: GradESTC通过有效利用梯度时空结构，为通信高效的联邦学习提供了一个实用且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.translation: 通信开销是联邦学习中的一个关键挑战，尤其是在带宽受限的网络中。尽管提出了许多减少通信开销的方法，但大多数方法只关注压缩单个梯度，而忽略了它们之间的时间相关性。先前的研究表明，梯度表现出空间相关性，通常以低秩结构体现。通过实证分析，我们进一步观察到客户端梯度在相邻轮次之间存在很强的时间相关性。基于这些观察，我们提出GradESTC，一种利用梯度时空相关性的压缩技术。GradESTC利用空间相关性将每个完整梯度分解为一组紧凑的基向量和相应的组合系数。通过利用时间相关性，每轮只需要动态更新一小部分基向量。GradESTC通过传输轻量级的组合系数和有限数量的更新基向量而不是完整梯度，显著降低了通信开销。大量实验表明，在达到接近收敛的目标精度水平时，GradESTC相比最强的基线方法，上行通信平均减少了39.79%，同时保持了与未压缩的FedAvg相当的收敛速度和最终准确率。通过有效利用梯度时空结构，GradESTC为通信高效的联邦学习提供了一个实用且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为GradESTC的创新联邦学习压缩技术，该技术通过同时利用梯度在空间和时间上的相关性来解决通信开销问题。与现有方法不同，GradESTC不仅考虑了梯度的低秩结构（空间相关性），还利用了梯度在连续训练轮次中的时间相关性。具体而言，它将梯度分解为基向量和系数，并仅在每轮中动态更新一小部分基向量，从而大大减少了需要传输的数据量。实验结果表明，GradESTC在通信效率上取得了显著提升，上行通信量平均减少近40%，同时保持了与标准FedAvg相当的收敛速度和最终模型精度，为实际应用中的联邦学习提供了更优的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习,通信效率,梯度压缩,时空相关性,GradESTC
AI.comments: 该研究提出的GradESTC方法巧妙地结合了梯度在时间和空间上的相关性，提供了一种有效的通信压缩策略。通过分解梯度并仅更新部分基向量，显著降低了通信开销，这对于带宽受限的环境尤为重要。实验结果令人信服，表明该方法在效率和性能之间取得了良好的平衡。未来的工作可以探索更复杂的时空相关性模型或将其应用于更广泛的联邦学习场景。

title: Model See, Model Do? Exposure-Aware Evaluation of Bug-vs-Fix Preference in Code LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly used for code generation and debugging, but their outputs can still contain bugs, that originate from training data. Distinguishing whether an LLM prefers correct code, or a familiar incorrect version might be influenced by what it's been exposed to during training. We introduce an exposure-aware evaluation framework that quantifies how prior exposure to buggy versus fixed code influences a model's preference. Using the ManySStuBs4J benchmark, we apply Data Portraits for membership testing on the Stack-V2 corpus to estimate whether each buggy and fixed variant was seen during training. We then stratify examples by exposure and compare model preference using code completion as well as multiple likelihood-based scoring metrics We find that most examples (67%) have neither variant in the training data, and when only one is present, fixes are more frequently present than bugs. In model generations, models reproduce buggy lines far more often than fixes, with bug-exposed examples amplifying this tendency and fix-exposed examples showing only marginal improvement. In likelihood scoring, minimum and maximum token-probability metrics consistently prefer the fixed code across all conditions, indicating a stable bias toward correct fixes. In contrast, metrics like the Gini coefficient reverse preference when only the buggy variant was seen. Our results indicate that exposure can skew bug-fix evaluations and highlight the risk that LLMs may propagate memorised errors in practice.

AI.title_translation: 模型看见，模型做到？代码大模型中暴露感知的错误修复偏好评估
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种暴露感知评估框架，用于量化训练数据中错误代码或修复代码的暴露情况如何影响大语言模型（LLM）对错误修复的偏好。研究发现，LLM 更倾向于生成错误代码，即使暴露于修复代码也仅有微小改善。一些似然度指标偏好修复代码，而另一些指标则在仅暴露于错误代码时偏好错误代码。这表明训练数据的暴露情况会影响 LLM 的评估，并可能导致错误传播。
AI.motivation: 评估大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成和调试中的输出是否偏好正确代码，或者是否受训练数据中已暴露的错误版本影响。
AI.method: 引入暴露感知评估框架，利用 ManySStuBs4J 基准测试和数据画像（Data Portraits）技术，估计训练数据（Stack-V2）中错误代码和修复代码的暴露情况。然后，根据暴露情况对样本进行分层，并使用代码补全和多种似然度评分指标比较模型偏好。
AI.result: 67% 的样本在训练数据中既没有错误版本也没有修复版本。当只有一个版本存在时，修复版本比错误版本更常见。模型生成的代码中，错误代码行出现的频率远高于修复代码行，暴露于错误代码会加剧这种趋势，而暴露于修复代码仅带来边际改善。似然度评分指标（如基尼系数）在仅暴露于错误代码时会反转偏好，而最小和最大标记概率指标则在所有条件下都一致偏好修复代码。
AI.conclusion: 暴露情况会影响对错误修复的评估，并且大语言模型存在传播所记忆错误的风险。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于代码生成和调试，但它们的输出仍然可能包含源于训练数据的错误。区分大型语言模型是偏好正确代码还是熟悉的错误版本，可能会受到训练期间所暴露内容的影响。我们引入了一个暴露感知评估框架，用于量化错误代码与修复代码的先前暴露情况如何影响模型的偏好。我们使用 ManySStuBs4J 基准测试，对 Stack-V2 语料库应用数据画像（Data Portraits）进行成员资格测试，以估计在训练期间是否见过每个错误和修复变体。然后，我们按暴露情况对样本进行分层，并使用代码补全和多种基于似然度的评分指标来比较模型偏好。我们发现，大多数样本（67%）在训练数据中既没有错误变体也没有修复变体，并且当只有一个变体存在时，修复变体比错误变体更常见。在模型生成中，模型产生错误代码行的频率远高于修复代码行，暴露于错误代码的样本会加剧这种倾向，而暴露于修复代码的样本仅显示出边际改善。在似然度评分中，最小和最大标记概率指标在所有条件下都一致偏好修复代码，表明对正确修复代码存在稳定的偏见。相比之下，像基尼系数这样的指标在只见过错误变体的情况下会反转偏好。我们的结果表明，暴露情况会影响对错误修复的评估，并凸显了大型语言模型在实践中可能传播所记忆错误的风险。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的暴露感知评估框架，旨在量化训练数据中错误代码和修复代码的暴露情况对代码大语言模型（LLM）偏好的影响。研究人员利用 ManySStuBs4J 基准测试和数据画像技术，分析了 Stack-V2 语料库中代码变体的训练暴露情况。结果显示，大多数代码样本在训练数据中既无错误也无修复。在模型生成方面，LLM 表现出生成错误代码的强烈倾向，即使暴露于修复代码也仅有轻微改善。似然度评分指标的结果不一致：一些指标（如最小/最大标记概率）始终偏好修复代码，而另一些指标（如基尼系数）则在仅暴露于错误代码时偏好错误代码。该研究强调了训练数据暴露对 LLM 评估的影响，并指出了 LLM 传播记忆错误的潜在风险。
AI.keywords: 代码大语言模型, 错误修复, 暴露感知评估, 训练数据偏见, 模型偏好
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了代码大语言模型评估中的一个关键但常被忽视的方面：训练数据暴露的影响。通过引入暴露感知框架，该研究提供了一种量化这种影响的方法，并揭示了模型行为中可能存在的微妙偏见。研究结果具有重要的实践意义，强调了在部署代码 LLM 之前对其进行彻底评估的必要性，尤其是在可能存在重复或错误代码的训练数据的情况下。然而，该研究也可能受到所使用的基准测试和数据集的限制，并且未来可能需要探索更广泛的数据集和模型架构来验证这些发现。此外，虽然研究区分了错误和修复代码的偏好，但对于模型在生成过程中产生特定类型错误的根本原因的深入分析可能有助于开发更有效的缓解策略。

title: mergetune: Continued fine-tuning of vision-language models
summary: Fine-tuning vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP often leads to catastrophic forgetting of pretrained knowledge. Prior work primarily aims to mitigate forgetting during adaptation; however, forgetting often remains inevitable during this process. We introduce a novel paradigm, \emph{continued fine-tuning (CFT)}, which seeks to recover pretrained knowledge after a zero-shot model has already been adapted. We propose a simple, model-agnostic CFT strategy (named MERGETUNE) guided by linear mode connectivity (LMC), which can be applied post hoc to existing fine-tuned models without requiring architectural changes. Given a fine-tuned model, we continue fine-tuning its trainable parameters (e.g., soft prompts or linear heads) to search for a continued model which has two low-loss paths to the zero-shot (e.g., CLIP) and the fine-tuned (e.g., CoOp) solutions. By exploiting the geometry of the loss landscape, the continued model implicitly merges the two solutions, restoring pretrained knowledge lost in the fine-tuned counterpart. A challenge is that the vanilla LMC constraint requires data replay from the pretraining task. We approximate this constraint for the zero-shot model via a second-order surrogate, eliminating the need for large-scale data replay. Experiments show that MERGETUNE improves the harmonic mean of CoOp by +5.6\% on base-novel generalisation without adding parameters. % We show \emph{the first time} superior performance than CLIP on both DTD and EuroSAT, on cross-dataset transfer. On robust fine-tuning evaluations, the LMC-merged model from MERGETUNE surpasses ensemble baselines with lower inference cost, achieving further gains and state-of-the-art results when ensembled with the zero-shot model. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/Surrey-UP-Lab/MERGETUNE}{https://github.com/Surrey-UP-Lab/MERGETUNE}.

AI.title_translation: 继续微调视觉语言模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为MERGETUNE的持续微调（CFT）范式，通过利用损失景观的几何特性，在微调后恢复预训练知识，避免了灾难性遗忘，并在不增加参数的情况下提高了性能。
AI.motivation: 微调视觉语言模型（VLMs）会导致灾难性遗忘，而现有的方法难以完全避免遗忘。
AI.method: MERGETUNE是一种模型无关的CFT策略，通过线性模式连接（LMC）来指导，它在微调后继续微调可训练参数，以寻找一个能够同时访问零样本和微调解决方案的继续微调模型，并使用二阶代理来近似LMC约束，无需大规模数据重放。
AI.result: MERGETUNE在基础-新颖泛化方面将CoOp的调和平均值提高了+5.6%，在跨数据集迁移方面首次在DTD和EuroSAT上均优于CLIP，并且在鲁棒微调评估中，优于集成基线，推理成本更低。
AI.conclusion: MERGETUNE是一种有效的持续微调范式，能够恢复预训练知识，提高模型性能，并且在不增加参数的情况下具有竞争力。
AI.translation: 微调像CLIP这样的视觉语言模型（VLMs）经常会导致预训练知识的灾难性遗忘。先前的工作主要旨在减轻适应过程中的遗忘；然而，在这个过程中遗忘常常是不可避免的。我们引入了一种新颖的范式，“持续微调（CFT）”，它旨在在零样本模型已经被适应之后恢复预训练知识。我们提出了一种简单、模型无关的CFT策略（命名为MERGETUNE），该策略由线性模式连接（LMC）指导，可以事后应用于现有的微调模型，而无需进行架构更改。给定一个微调模型，我们继续微调其可训练参数（例如，软提示或线性头），以搜索一个持续微调模型，该模型具有两个低损失路径，分别指向零样本（例如，CLIP）和微调（例如，CoOp）解决方案。通过利用损失景观的几何特性，持续微调模型隐式地合并了这两个解决方案，恢复了在微调对应物中丢失的预训练知识。一个挑战是，原始的LMC约束需要来自预训练任务的数据重放。我们通过二阶代理来近似零样本模型的这个约束，消除了对大规模数据重放的需求。实验表明，MERGETUNE在基础-新颖泛化方面将CoOp的调和平均值提高了+5.6%，而无需增加参数。我们在DTD和EuroSAT上均显示出在跨数据集迁移方面优于CLIP的性能，这是首次实现。在鲁棒微调评估中，来自MERGETUNE的LMC合并模型在推理成本较低的情况下，优于集成基线，并且在与零样本模型集成时，实现了进一步的提升和最先进的结果。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Surrey-UP-Lab/MERGETUNE获得。
AI.summary: MERGETUNE是一种新的持续微调（CFT）范式，旨在解决微调视觉语言模型（VLMs）时出现的灾难性遗忘问题。它通过在微调后继续微调模型参数，利用线性模式连接（LMC）和二阶代理来恢复丢失的预训练知识，而无需数据重放。实验证明，MERGETUNE在提高模型泛化能力和跨数据集迁移能力方面表现出色，甚至优于CLIP和现有集成基线。
AI.keywords: 持续微调, 视觉语言模型, 灾难性遗忘, 线性模式连接, MERGETUNE
AI.comments: MERGETUNE提出的持续微调（CFT）范式为解决视觉语言模型（VLMs）中的灾难性遗忘问题提供了一个新颖且有效的解决方案。该方法模型无关且无需架构更改，易于应用。通过利用损失景观的几何特性，MERGETUNE能够有效地恢复预训练知识，并在不增加参数的情况下实现性能提升。其使用二阶代理来近似LMC约束，避免了大规模数据重放，进一步增强了其实用性。然而，关于其在更广泛的VLMs和下游任务上的泛化能力，以及其对不同类型微调策略（如LoRA）的适用性，仍有待进一步研究。此外，虽然代码可用，但对MERGETUNE的理论分析和与现有遗忘缓解技术的深入比较可以提供更全面的理解。

title: Projected Microbatch Accumulation yields reference-free proximal policy updates for reinforcement learning
summary: This note introduces Projected Microbatch Accumulation (PROMA), a proximal policy update method for large language model fine-tuning. PROMA accumulates policy gradients across microbatches by projecting out sequence-wise gradient components before microbatch aggregation. The projection is applied layer-wise during the backward pass, enabling efficient implementation without additional forward or backward passes. Empirically, PROMA enforces tighter control of local KL divergence than GRPO, resulting in more stable policy learning. Unlike PPO and GRPO, PROMA achieves proximal updates without inducing entropy collapse and does not rely on a reference policy or likelihood-ratio clipping.

AI.title_translation: 投影微批累积产生无参考的近端策略更新用于强化学习
AI.tldr: PROMA是一种新的近端策略更新方法，通过在累积梯度之前投影掉序列梯度分量来优化大型语言模型的微调，实现了更稳定的策略学习，并且不需要参考策略或似然比裁剪。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型微调需要一种有效的近端策略更新方法，该方法能够实现更稳定的策略学习，并且不需要参考策略或似然比裁剪。
AI.method: PROMA通过在微批累积之前逐层投影掉序列梯度分量来累积策略梯度，从而在反向传播过程中实现高效实现。
AI.result: PROMA比GRPO能更严格地控制局部KL散度，从而实现更稳定的策略学习，并且不会导致熵崩溃，也不需要参考策略或似然比裁剪。
AI.conclusion: PROMA是一种有效的近端策略更新方法，适用于大型语言模型微调，能够实现更稳定的策略学习，并且具有无需参考策略或似然比裁剪的优点。
AI.translation: 本说明介绍了一种用于大型语言模型微调的近端策略更新方法——投影微批累积（PROMA）。PROMA通过在微批聚合之前投影掉序列梯度分量来累积微批之间的策略梯度。该投影在反向传播过程中逐层应用，从而无需额外的正向或反向传播即可实现高效实现。经验上，PROMA比GRPO能更严格地控制局部KL散度，从而实现更稳定的策略学习。与PPO和GRPO不同，PROMA在不引起熵崩溃的情况下实现近端更新，并且不依赖于参考策略或似然比裁剪。
AI.summary: 投影微批累积（PROMA）是一种新颖的近端策略更新算法，旨在优化大型语言模型（LLM）的微调。与现有方法不同，PROMA通过在累积梯度之前逐层投影掉序列梯度分量，从而在反向传播过程中实现高效的策略梯度累积。实验表明，PROMA能够比GRPO更有效地控制局部KL散度，从而带来更稳定的策略学习。此外，PROMA实现了近端更新，避免了熵崩溃问题，并且不需要参考策略或似然比裁剪。
AI.keywords: 投影微批累积, 近端策略更新, 大型语言模型微调, KL散度, 策略学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为PROMA的新型方法，用于解决大型语言模型微调中的近端策略更新问题。PROMA通过创新的梯度投影机制，实现了高效且稳定的策略学习，并克服了现有方法的局限性，如对参考策略的依赖和熵崩溃的风险。该方法在理论和实践上都具有重要的意义，为未来LLM的优化提供了新的方向。

title: Higher order trade-offs in hypergraph community detection
summary: Extending community detection from pairwise networks to hypergraphs introduces fundamental theoretical challenges. Hypergraphs exhibit structural heterogeneity with no direct graph analogue: hyperedges of varying orders can connect nodes across communities in diverse configurations, introducing new trade-offs in defining and detecting community structure. We address these challenges by developing a unified framework for community detection in non-uniform hypergraphs under the Hypergraph Stochastic Block Model. We introduce a general signal-to-noise ratio that enables a quantitative analysis of trade-offs unique to higher-order networks, such as which hypergedges we choose to split across communities and how we choose to split them. Building on this framework, we derive a Bethe Hessian operator for non-uniform hypergraphs that provides efficient spectral clustering with principled model selection. We characterize the resulting spectral detectability threshold and compare it to belief propagation limits, showing the methods coincide for uniform hypergraphs but diverge in non-uniform settings. Synthetic experiments confirm our analytical predictions and reveal systematic biases toward preserving higher-order and balanced-shape hyperedges. Application to empirical data demonstrates the practical relevance of these higher-order detectability trade-offs in real-world systems.

AI.title_translation: 高阶超图社区检测中的权衡
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个统一的框架，用于在非均匀超图中进行社区检测，并引入了一个通用的信噪比来分析高阶网络特有的权衡，推导了超图的贝叶斯海森算子，实现了高效的谱聚类，并对合成数据和实际数据进行了实验验证。
AI.motivation: 从成对网络扩展到超图进行社区检测带来了理论挑战，因为超图的结构异质性（例如不同阶数的超边）引入了定义和检测社区结构的新权衡。
AI.method: 提出一个统一的框架，用于在非均匀超图下进行社区检测，并引入了一个通用的信噪比来分析高阶网络特有的权衡。在此框架基础上，推导了非均匀超图的贝叶斯海森算子，实现了高效的谱聚类和原则性的模型选择。
AI.result: 推导的贝叶斯海森算子实现了高效的谱聚类，并对检测阈值进行了表征。结果表明，该方法在均匀超图和非均匀超图设置下表现不同，并且在合成实验中观察到系统性地偏向保留高阶和平衡形状的超边。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的统一框架和分析方法能够有效应对超图社区检测中的挑战，揭示了高阶检测的权衡，并为实际应用提供了基础。
AI.translation: 将社区检测从成对网络扩展到超图带来了根本性的理论挑战。超图表现出结构异质性，这在图论中没有直接的类似物：不同阶数的超边可以在不同的配置中连接跨社区的节点，从而在定义和检测社区结构方面引入新的权衡。我们通过在超图随机块模型下开发一个用于非均匀超图社区检测的统一框架来应对这些挑战。我们引入了一个通用的信噪比，它能够对独特的、仅存在于高阶网络中的权衡进行定量分析，例如我们选择将哪些超边分割到社区中以及我们如何选择分割它们。在此框架的基础上，我们推导了一个用于非均匀超图的贝叶斯海森算子，它提供了高效的谱聚类和原则性的模型选择。我们表征了由此产生的谱检测阈值，并将其与置信传播极限进行了比较，结果表明这些方法在均匀超图中是相同的，但在非均匀设置中存在差异。合成实验证实了我们的分析预测，并揭示了系统性地偏向保留高阶和平衡形状的超边的偏差。在实际数据上的应用证明了这些高阶检测权衡在现实系统中的实际相关性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一个用于非均匀超图社区检测的统一框架，该框架通过引入通用的信噪比来量化高阶网络特有的权衡。研究推导了非均匀超图的贝叶斯海森算子，实现了高效的谱聚类和模型选择，并分析了检测阈值。实验结果证实了理论预测，并表明该方法在处理真实世界数据时具有实际意义。
AI.keywords: 超图社区检测, 高阶权衡, 贝叶斯海森算子, 谱聚类, 检测阈值
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了超图社区检测中的一个重要且具有挑战性的问题，通过引入新的理论框架和分析工具，为理解和处理高阶网络中的社区结构提供了新的视角。其在理论分析和实验验证方面都取得了显著成果，尤其是在揭示非均匀超图中的高阶权衡方面具有创新性。然而，贝叶斯海森算子的计算复杂度和在大规模数据集上的可扩展性可能是一个潜在的局限性，有待进一步研究。

title: Coded Caching for Combinatorial Multi-Access Hotplug Networks from $t$-Designs
summary: We study hotplug coded caching in combinatorial multi-access networks, which generalizes existing hotplug coded caching models by allowing users to access multiple caches, while only a subset of caches is online during the delivery phase. We first generalize the Hotplug Placement Delivery Array (HpPDA) framework to the combinatorial multi-access setting. Based on this generalized framework, we propose a t-design-based coded caching scheme for combinatorial multi-access networks. We characterize a class of design parameters under which every active user has access to a sufficient number of coded subfiles to decode its requested file, and show that appropriate parameter choices allow for the elimination of redundant multicast transmissions. As a result, the proposed scheme achieves a family of rate memory trade offs with flexible subpacketization. We present numerical comparisons illustrating that the proposed t-scheme outperforms existing hotplug coded caching schemes in certain memory regimes.

title: DR-Arena: an Automated Evaluation Framework for Deep Research Agents
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate as Deep Research (DR) Agents capable of autonomous investigation and information synthesis, reliable evaluation of their task performance has become a critical bottleneck. Current benchmarks predominantly rely on static datasets, which suffer from several limitations: limited task generality, temporal misalignment, and data contamination. To address these, we introduce DR-Arena, a fully automated evaluation framework that pushes DR agents to their capability limits through dynamic investigation. DR-Arena constructs real-time Information Trees from fresh web trends to ensure the evaluation rubric is synchronized with the live world state, and employs an automated Examiner to generate structured tasks testing two orthogonal capabilities: Deep reasoning and Wide coverage. DR-Arena further adopts Adaptive Evolvement Loop, a state-machine controller that dynamically escalates task complexity based on real-time performance, demanding deeper deduction or wider aggregation until a decisive capability boundary emerges. Experiments with six advanced DR agents demonstrate that DR-Arena achieves a Spearman correlation of 0.94 with the LMSYS Search Arena leaderboard. This represents the state-of-the-art alignment with human preferences without any manual efforts, validating DR-Arena as a reliable alternative for costly human adjudication.

title: A New Construction Structure on Coded Caching with Linear Subpacketization: Non-Half-Sum Latin Rectangle
summary: Coded caching is recognized as an effective method for alleviating network congestion during peak periods by leveraging local caching and coded multicasting gains. The key challenge in designing coded caching schemes lies in simultaneously achieving low subpacketization and low transmission load. Most existing schemes require exponential or polynomial subpacketization levels, while some linear subpacketization schemes often result in excessive transmission load. Recently, Cheng et al. proposed a construction framework for linear coded caching schemes called Non-Half-Sum Disjoint Packing (NHSDP), where the subpacketization equals the number of users $K$. This paper introduces a novel combinatorial structure, termed the Non-Half-Sum Latin Rectangle (NHSLR), which extends the framework of linear coded caching schemes from $F=K$ (i.e., the construction via NHSDP) to a broader scenario with $F=\mathcal{O}(K)$. By constructing NHSLR, we have obtained a new class of coded caching schemes that achieves linearly scalable subpacketization, while further reducing the transmission load compared with the NHSDP scheme. Theoretical and numerical analyses demonstrate that the proposed schemes not only achieves lower transmission load than existing linear subpacketization schemes but also approaches the performance of certain exponential subpacketization schemes.

title: A New Construction Structure on Multi-access Coded Caching with Linear Subpacketization: Cyclic Multi-Access Non-Half-Sum Disjoint Packing
summary: We consider the $(K,L,M,N)$ multi-access coded caching system introduced by Hachem et al., which consists of a central server with $N$ files and $K$ cache nodes, each of memory size $M$, where each user can access $L$ cache nodes in a cyclic wrap-around fashion. At present, several existing schemes achieve competitive transmission performance, but their subpacketization levels grow exponentially with the number of users. In contrast, schemes with linear or polynomial subpacketization always incur higher transmission loads. We aim to design a multi-access coded caching scheme with linear subpacketization $F$ while maintaining low transmission load. Recently, Cheng et al. proposed a construction framework for coded caching schemes with linear subpacketization (i.e., $F=K$) called non-half-sum disjoint packing (NHSDP). Inspired by this structure, we introduce a novel combinatorial structure named cyclic multi-access non-half-sum disjoint packing (CMA-NHSDP) by extending NHSDP to MACC system. By constructing CMA-NHSDP, we obtain a new class of multi-access coded caching schemes. Theoretical and numerical analyses show that our scheme achieves lower transmission loads than some existing schemes with linear subpacketization. Moreover, the proposed schemes achieves lower transmission load compared to existing schemes with exponential subpacketization in some case.

title: Scalable Algorithms for Approximate DNF Model Counting
summary:
Model counting of Disjunctive Normal Form (DNF) formulas is a critical problem in applications such as probabilistic inference and network reliability. For example, it is often used for query evaluation in probabilistic databases. Due to the computational intractability of exact DNF counting, there has been a line of research into a variety of approximation algorithms. These include Monte Carlo approaches such as the classical algorithms of Karp, Luby, and Madras (1989), as well as methods based on hashing (Soos et al. 2023), and heuristic approximations based on Neural Nets (Abboud, Ceylan, and Lukasiewicz 2020).
  We develop a new Monte Carlo approach with an adaptive stopping rule and short-circuit formula evaluation. We prove it achieves Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning bounds and is asymptotically more efficient than the previous methods. We also show experimentally that it out-performs prior algorithms by orders of magnitude, and can scale to much larger problems with millions of variables.

title: SatMap: Revisiting Satellite Maps as Prior for Online HD Map Construction
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE ICPR for possible publication
summary: Online high-definition (HD) map construction is an essential part of a safe and robust end-to-end autonomous driving (AD) pipeline. Onboard camera-based approaches suffer from limited depth perception and degraded accuracy due to occlusion. In this work, we propose SatMap, an online vectorized HD map estimation method that integrates satellite maps with multi-view camera observations and directly predicts a vectorized HD map for downstream prediction and planning modules. Our method leverages lane-level semantics and texture from satellite imagery captured from a Bird's Eye View (BEV) perspective as a global prior, effectively mitigating depth ambiguity and occlusion. In our experiments on the nuScenes dataset, SatMap achieves 34.8% mAP performance improvement over the camera-only baseline and 8.5% mAP improvement over the camera-LiDAR fusion baseline. Moreover, we evaluate our model in long-range and adverse weather conditions to demonstrate the advantages of using a satellite prior map. Source code will be available at https://iv.ee.hm.edu/satmap/.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE ICPR for possible publication

title: AEQ-Bench: Measuring Empathy of Omni-Modal Large Models
summary: While the automatic evaluation of omni-modal large models (OLMs) is essential, assessing empathy remains a significant challenge due to its inherent affectivity. To investigate this challenge, we introduce AEQ-Bench (Audio Empathy Quotient Benchmark), a novel benchmark to systematically assess two core empathetic capabilities of OLMs: (i) generating empathetic responses by comprehending affective cues from multi-modal inputs (audio + text), and (ii) judging the empathy of audio responses without relying on text transcription. Compared to existing benchmarks, AEQ-Bench incorporates two novel settings that vary in context specificity and speech tone. Comprehensive assessment across linguistic and paralinguistic metrics reveals that (1) OLMs trained with audio output capabilities generally outperformed models with text-only outputs, and (2) while OLMs align with human judgments for coarse-grained quality assessment, they remain unreliable for evaluating fine-grained paralinguistic expressiveness.

title: Transformer-Based Cognitive Radio: Adaptive Modulation Strategies Using Transformer Models
summary: Cognitive Radio (CR) systems, which dynamically adapt to changing spectrum environments, could benefit significantly from advancements in machine learning technologies. These systems can be enhanced in terms of spectral efficiency, robustness, and security through innovative approaches such as the use of Transformer models. This work investigates the application of Transformer models, specifically the GPT-2 architecture, to generate novel modulation schemes for wireless communications. By training a GPT-2 model on a dataset of existing modulation formulas, new modulation schemes has been created. These generated schemes are then compared to traditional methods using key performance metrics such as Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and Power Spectrum Density (PSD). The results show that Transformer-generated modulation schemes can achieve performance comparable to, and in some cases outperforming, traditional methods. This demonstrates that advanced CR systems could greatly benefit from the implementation of Transformer models, leading to more efficient, robust, and secure communication systems.

title: Breaking Up with Normatively Monolithic Agency with GRACE: A Reason-Based Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Safe and Ethical AI Alignment
comments: 10 pages, 4 figures, accepted at 2nd Annual Conference of the International Association for Safe & Ethical AI (IASEAI'26)
summary: As AI agents become increasingly autonomous, widely deployed in consequential contexts, and efficacious in bringing about real-world impacts, ensuring that their decisions are not only instrumentally effective but also normatively aligned has become critical. We introduce a neuro-symbolic reason-based containment architecture, Governor for Reason-Aligned ContainmEnt (GRACE), that decouples normative reasoning from instrumental decision-making and can contain AI agents of virtually any design. GRACE restructures decision-making into three modules: a Moral Module (MM) that determines permissible macro actions via deontic logic-based reasoning; a Decision-Making Module (DMM) that encapsulates the target agent while selecting instrumentally optimal primitive actions in accordance with derived macro actions; and a Guard that monitors and enforces moral compliance. The MM uses a reason-based formalism providing a semantic foundation for deontic logic, enabling interpretability, contestability, and justifiability. Its symbolic representation enriches the DMM's informational context and supports formal verification and statistical guarantees of alignment enforced by the Guard. We demonstrate GRACE on an example of a LLM therapy assistant, showing how it enables stakeholders to understand, contest, and refine agent behavior.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, accepted at 2nd Annual Conference of the International Association for Safe & Ethical AI (IASEAI'26)

title: BikeActions: An Open Platform and Benchmark for Cyclist-Centric VRU Action Recognition
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE ICPR for possible publication
summary: Anticipating the intentions of Vulnerable Road Users (VRUs) is a critical challenge for safe autonomous driving (AD) and mobile robotics. While current research predominantly focuses on pedestrian crossing behaviors from a vehicle's perspective, interactions within dense shared spaces remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce FUSE-Bike, the first fully open perception platform of its kind. Equipped with two LiDARs, a camera, and GNSS, it facilitates high-fidelity, close-range data capture directly from a cyclist's viewpoint. Leveraging this platform, we present BikeActions, a novel multi-modal dataset comprising 852 annotated samples across 5 distinct action classes, specifically tailored to improve VRU behavior modeling. We establish a rigorous benchmark by evaluating state-of-the-art graph convolution and transformer-based models on our publicly released data splits, establishing the first performance baselines for this challenging task. We release the full dataset together with data curation tools, the open hardware design, and the benchmark code to foster future research in VRU action understanding under https://iv.ee.hm.edu/bikeactions/.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE ICPR for possible publication

title: Diagnosing Generalization Failures in Fine-Tuned LLMs: A Cross-Architectural Study on Phishing Detection
summary: The practice of fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) has achieved state-of-the-art performance on specialized tasks, yet diagnosing why these models become brittle and fail to generalize remains a critical open problem. To address this, we introduce and apply a multi-layered diagnostic framework to a cross-architectural study. We fine-tune Llama 3.1 8B, Gemma 2 9B, and Mistral models on a high-stakes phishing detection task and use SHAP analysis and mechanistic interpretability to uncover the root causes of their generalization failures. Our investigation reveals three critical findings: (1) Generalization is driven by a powerful synergy between architecture and data diversity. The Gemma 2 9B model achieves state-of-the-art performance (>91\% F1), but only when trained on a stylistically diverse ``generalist'' dataset. (2) Generalization is highly architecture-dependent. We diagnose a specific failure mode in Llama 3.1 8B, which performs well on a narrow domain but cannot integrate diverse data, leading to a significant performance drop. (3) Some architectures are inherently more generalizable. The Mistral model proves to be a consistent and resilient performer across multiple training paradigms. By pinpointing the flawed heuristics responsible for these failures, our work provides a concrete methodology for diagnosing and understanding generalization failures, underscoring that reliable AI requires deep validation of the interplay between architecture, data, and training strategy.

title: Learning from Brain Topography: A Hierarchical Local-Global Graph-Transformer Network for EEG Emotion Recognition
summary: Understanding how local neurophysiological patterns interact with global brain dynamics is essential for decoding human emotions from EEG signals. However, existing deep learning approaches often overlook the brain's intrinsic spatial organization, failing to simultaneously capture local topological relations and global dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose Neuro-HGLN, a Neurologically-informed Hierarchical Graph-Transformer Learning Network that integrates biologically grounded priors with hierarchical representation learning. Neuro-HGLN first constructs a spatial Euclidean prior graph based on physical electrode distances to serve as an anatomically grounded inductive bias. A learnable global dynamic graph is then introduced to model functional connectivity across the entire brain. In parallel, to capture fine-grained regional dependencies, Neuro-HGLN builds region-level local graphs using a multi-head self-attention mechanism. These graphs are processed synchronously through local-constrained parallel GCN layers to produce region-specific representations. Subsequently, an iTransformer encoder aggregates these features to capture cross-region dependencies under a dimension-as-token formulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Neuro-HGLN achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks, providing enhanced interpretability grounded in neurophysiological structure. These results highlight the efficacy of unifying local topological learning with cross-region dependency modeling for robust EEG emotion recognition.

title: On the suboptimality of linear codes for binary distributed hypothesis testing
summary: We study a binary distributed hypothesis testing problem where two agents observe correlated binary vectors and communicate compressed information at the same rate to a central decision maker. In particular, we study linear compression schemes and show that simple truncation is the best linear scheme in two cases: (1) testing opposite signs of the same magnitude of correlation, and (2) testing for or against independence. We conjecture, supported by numerical evidence, that truncation is the best linear code for testing any correlations of opposite signs. Further, for testing against independence, we also compute classical random coding exponents and show that truncation, and consequently any linear code, is strictly suboptimal.

title: A Safety Report on GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro, Qwen3-VL, Doubao 1.8, Grok 4.1 Fast, Nano Banana Pro, and Seedream 4.5
summary: The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has produced substantial gains in reasoning, perception, and generative capability across language and vision. However, whether these advances yield commensurate improvements in safety remains unclear, in part due to fragmented evaluation practices limited to single modalities or threat models. In this report, we present an integrated safety evaluation of 7 frontier models: GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro, Qwen3-VL, Doubao 1.8, Grok 4.1 Fast, Nano Banana Pro, and Seedream 4.5. We evaluate each model across language, vision-language, and image generation settings using a unified protocol that integrates benchmark evaluation, adversarial evaluation, multilingual evaluation, and compliance evaluation. Aggregating our evaluations into safety leaderboards and model safety profiles across multiple evaluation modes reveals a sharply heterogeneous safety landscape. While GPT-5.2 demonstrates consistently strong and balanced safety performance across evaluations, other models exhibit pronounced trade-offs among benchmark safety, adversarial alignment, multilingual generalization, and regulatory compliance. Both language and vision-language modalities show significant vulnerability under adversarial evaluation, with all models degrading substantially despite strong results on standard benchmarks. Text-to-image models achieve relatively stronger alignment in regulated visual risk categories, yet remain brittle under adversarial or semantically ambiguous prompts. Overall, these results show that safety in frontier models is inherently multidimensional--shaped by modality, language, and evaluation scheme, underscoring the need for standardized safety evaluations to accurately assess real-world risk and guide responsible model development and deployment.

title: PERM: Psychology-grounded Empathetic Reward Modeling for Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in human-centric applications, yet they often fail to provide substantive emotional support. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been utilized to enhance empathy of LLMs, existing reward models typically evaluate empathy from a single perspective, overlooking the inherently bidirectional interaction nature of empathy between the supporter and seeker as defined by Empathy Cycle theory. To address this limitation, we propose Psychology-grounded Empathetic Reward Modeling (PERM). PERM operationalizes empathy evaluation through a bidirectional decomposition: 1) Supporter perspective, assessing internal resonation and communicative expression; 2) Seeker perspective, evaluating emotional reception. Additionally, it incorporates a bystander perspective to monitor overall interaction quality. Extensive experiments on a widely-used emotional intelligence benchmark and an industrial daily conversation dataset demonstrate that PERM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by over 10\%. Furthermore, a blinded user study reveals a 70\% preference for our approach, highlighting its efficacy in generating more empathetic responses. Our code, dataset, and models are available at https://github.com/ZhengWwwq/PERM.

title: SVII-3D: Advancing Roadside Infrastructure Inventory with Decimeter-level 3D Localization and Comprehension from Sparse Street Imagery
summary: The automated creation of digital twins and precise asset inventories is a critical task in smart city construction and facility lifecycle management. However, utilizing cost-effective sparse imagery remains challenging due to limited robustness, inaccurate localization, and a lack of fine-grained state understanding. To address these limitations, SVII-3D, a unified framework for holistic asset digitization, is proposed. First, LoRA fine-tuned open-set detection is fused with a spatial-attention matching network to robustly associate observations across sparse views. Second, a geometry-guided refinement mechanism is introduced to resolve structural errors, achieving precise decimeter-level 3D localization. Third, transcending static geometric mapping, a Vision-Language Model agent leveraging multi-modal prompting is incorporated to automatically diagnose fine-grained operational states. Experiments demonstrate that SVII-3D significantly improves identification accuracy and minimizes localization errors. Consequently, this framework offers a scalable, cost-effective solution for high-fidelity infrastructure digitization, effectively bridging the gap between sparse perception and automated intelligent maintenance.

title: CoGen: Creation of Reusable UI Components in Figma via Textual Commands
summary:
The evolution of User Interface design has emphasized the need for efficient, reusable, and editable components to ensure an efficient design process. This research introduces CoGen, a system that uses machine learning techniques to generate reusable UI components directly in Figma, one of the most popular UI design tools. Addressing gaps in current systems, CoGen focuses on creating atomic components such as buttons, labels, and input fields using structured JSON and natural language prompts.
  The project integrates Figma API data extraction, Seq2Seq models, and fine-tuned T5 transformers for component generation. The key results demonstrate the efficiency of the T5 model in prompt generation, with an accuracy of 98% and a BLEU score of 0.2668, which ensures the mapping of JSON to descriptive prompts. For JSON creation, CoGen achieves a success rate of up to 100% in generating simple JSON outputs for specified component types.

title: Enhancing the quality of gauge images captured in smoke and haze scenes through deep learning
comments: 17 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables, SPIE Applications of Machine Learning 2023, San Diego, US
summary: Images captured in hazy and smoky environments suffer from reduced visibility, posing a challenge when monitoring infrastructures and hindering emergency services during critical situations. The proposed work investigates the use of the deep learning models to enhance the automatic, machine-based readability of gauge in smoky environments, with accurate gauge data interpretation serving as a valuable tool for first responders. The study utilizes two deep learning architectures, FFA-Net and AECR-Net, to improve the visibility of gauge images, corrupted with light up to dense haze and smoke. Since benchmark datasets of analog gauge images are unavailable, a new synthetic dataset, containing over 14,000 images, was generated using the Unreal Engine. The models were trained with an 80\% train, 10\% validation, and 10\% test split for the haze and smoke dataset, respectively. For the synthetic haze dataset, the SSIM and PSNR metrics are about 0.98 and 43\,dB, respectively, comparing well to state-of-the art results. Additionally, more robust results are retrieved from the AECR-Net, when compared to the FFA-Net. Although the results from the synthetic smoke dataset are poorer, the trained models achieve interesting results. In general, imaging in the presence of smoke are more difficult to enhance given the inhomogeneity and high density. Secondly, FFA-Net and AECR-Net are implemented to dehaze and not to desmoke images. This work shows that use of deep learning architectures can improve the quality of analog gauge images captured in smoke and haze scenes immensely. Finally, the enhanced output images can be successfully post-processed for automatic autonomous reading of gauges
comment: 17 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables, SPIE Applications of Machine Learning 2023, San Diego, US

title: Network Integrated Sensing and Communication
summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a cornerstone technology for 6G networks, offering unified support for high-rate communication and high-accuracy sensing. While existing literature extensively covers link-level designs, the transition toward large-scale deployment necessitates a fundamental understanding of network-level performance. This paper investigates a network ISAC model where a source node communicates with a destination via a relay network, while intermediate nodes concurrently perform cooperative sensing over specific spatial regions. We formulate a novel optimization framework that captures the interplay between multi-node routing and sensing coverage. For a one-dimensional path network, we provide an analytical characterization of the complete sensing-throughput region. Extending this to general network topologies, we establish that the sensing-throughput Pareto boundary is piecewise linear and provide physical interpretations for each segment. Our results reveal the fundamental trade-offs between sensing coverage and communication routing, offering key insights for the design of future 6G heterogeneous networks.

title: Error-Correcting Codes for Two Bursts of t1-Deletion-t2-Insertion with Low Computational Complexity
summary: Burst errors involving simultaneous insertions, deletions, and substitutions occur in practical scenarios, including DNA data storage and document synchronization, motivating developments of channel codes that can correct such errors. In this paper, we address the problem of constructing error-correcting codes (ECCs) capable of handling multiple bursts of $t_1$-deletion-$t_2$-insertion ($(t_1,t_2)$-DI) errors, where each burst consists of $t_1$ deletions followed by $t_2$ insertions in a binary sequence. We make three key contributions: Firstly, we establish the fundamental equivalence of (1) two bursts of $(t_1,t_2)$-DI ECCs, (2) two bursts of $(t_2,t_1)$-DI ECCs, and (3) one burst each of $(t_1,t_2)$-DI and $(t_2,t_1)$-DI ECCs. Then, we derive lower and upper bounds on the code size of two bursts of $(t_1,t_2)$-DI ECCs, which can naturally be extended to the case of multiple bursts. Finally, we present constructions of two bursts of $(t_1,t_2)$-DI ECCs. Compared to the codes obtained by the syndrome compression technique, the resulting codes achieve significantly lower computational complexity.

title: Mixtures of Transparent Local Models
summary: The predominance of machine learning models in many spheres of human activity has led to a growing demand for their transparency. The transparency of models makes it possible to discern some factors, such as security or non-discrimination. In this paper, we propose a mixture of transparent local models as an alternative solution for designing interpretable (or transparent) models. Our approach is designed for the situations where a simple and transparent function is suitable for modeling the label of instances in some localities/regions of the input space, but may change abruptly as we move from one locality to another. Consequently, the proposed algorithm is to learn both the transparent labeling function and the locality of the input space where the labeling function achieves a small risk in its assigned locality. By using a new multi-predictor (and multi-locality) loss function, we established rigorous PAC-Bayesian risk bounds for the case of binary linear classification problem and that of linear regression. In both cases, synthetic data sets were used to illustrate how the learning algorithms work. The results obtained from real data sets highlight the competitiveness of our approach compared to other existing methods as well as certain opaque models. Keywords: PAC-Bayes, risk bounds, local models, transparent models, mixtures of local transparent models.

title: Hybrid Encryption with Certified Deletion in Preprocessing Model
summary: Certified deletion allows Alice to outsource data to Bob and, at a later time, obtain a verifiable guarantee that the file has been irreversibly deleted at her request. The functionality, while impossible using classical information alone, can be achieved using quantum information. Existing approaches, rely on one-time pad (OTP) encryption, or use computational hardness assumptions that may be vulnerable to future advances in classical or quantum computing. In this work, we introduce and formalize hybrid encryption with certified deletion in the preprocessing model (pHE-CD) and propose two constructions. The constructions combine an information-theoretic key encapsulation mechanism (iKEM) with a data encapsulation mechanism that provides certified deletion (DEM-CD) and, respectively, provide {\em information-theoretic certified deletion}, where both confidentiality and deletion properties are provided against a computationally unbounded adversary; and {\em everlasting certified deletion}, where confidentiality is computational before deletion, and upon successful verification of the deletion certificate, the message becomes information-theoretically hidden from an adversary that is computationally unbounded. Our pHE-CD schemes provide IND-$q_e$-CPA notion of security and support encryption of arbitrarily long messages. In the second construction, using a computationally secure DEM-CD that is quantum-safe (i.e. constructed using quantum coding and AES), we obtain quantum-safe security with keys that are significantly shorter than the message. Instantiating the proposed framework using quantum enabled kem (qKEM) as the iKEM, is a future work.

title: Defending Large Language Models Against Jailbreak Attacks via In-Decoding Safety-Awareness Probing
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive performance across natural language tasks and are increasingly deployed in real-world applications. Despite extensive safety alignment efforts, recent studies show that such alignment is often shallow and remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing defense mechanisms, including decoding-based constraints and post-hoc content detectors, struggle against sophisticated jailbreaks, often intervening robust detection or excessively degrading model utility. In this work, we examine the decoding process of LLMs and make a key observation: even when successfully jailbroken, models internally exhibit latent safety-related signals during generation. However, these signals are overridden by the model's drive for fluent continuation, preventing timely self-correction or refusal. Building on this observation, we propose a simple yet effective approach that explicitly surfaces and leverages these latent safety signals for early detection of unsafe content during decoding. Experiments across diverse jailbreak attacks demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances safety, while maintaining low over-refusal rates on benign inputs and preserving response quality. Our results suggest that activating intrinsic safety-awareness during decoding offers a promising and complementary direction for defending against jailbreak attacks. Code is available at: https://github.com/zyz13590/SafeProbing.

title: SDN-Driven Innovations in MANETs and IoT: A Path to Smarter Networks
summary: Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANETs) and Internet of Things (IoT) networks operate in decentralized and dynamic environments, making them ideal for scenarios lacking traditional infrastructure. However, these networks face challenges such as inefficient routing, limited scalability, and security vulnerabilities due to their decentralized nature and resource constraints. This paper explores the integration of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) as a unified solution that leverages its centralized control and network programmability to improve routing, resource management, and security. A mathematical model evaluates the impact of SDN integration on Capital Expenditure (CAPEX), Operational Expenditure (OPEX), and performance metrics. Results demonstrate that SDN-enhanced MANETs and IoT networks offer superior scalability, reduced latency, increased throughput, and lower packet loss, especially in dynamic and large-scale environments. While SDN introduces computational overhead, it significantly enhances routing efficiency, resource optimization, and adaptability. The proposed framework provides a robust and scalable solution, enabling the development of network architectures that efficiently manage growing node densities, dynamic topologies, and high data traffic. This approach ensures resilience, making it well-suited to meet the performance and reliability demands of modern, large-scale applications.

title: HeartMuLa: A Family of Open Sourced Music Foundation Models
summary: We present a family of open-source Music Foundation Models designed to advance large-scale music understanding and generation across diverse tasks and modalities. Our framework consists of four major components: (1) HeartCLAP, an audio-text alignment model; (2) HeartTranscriptor, a robust lyric recognition model optimized for real-world music scenarios; and (3) HeartCodec, a low-frame-rate (12.5 Hz) yet high-fidelity music codec tokenizer that captures long-range musical structure while preserving fine-grained acoustic details and enabling efficient autoregressive modeling; (4) HeartMuLa, an LLM-based song generation model capable of synthesizing high-fidelity music under rich, user-controllable conditions (e.g., textual style descriptions, lyrics, and reference audio). In addition, it provides two specialized modes: (i) fine-grained musical attribute control, which allows users to specify the style of different song sections (e.g., intro, verse, chorus) using natural language prompts; and (ii) short, engaging music generation, which is suitable as background music for short videos. Lastly, HeartMuLa improves significantly when scaled to 7B parameters. For the first time, we show that a Suno-level, commercial-grade system can be reproduced using academic-scale data and GPU resources. We expect these foundation models to serve as strong baselines for future research and to facilitate practical applications in multimodal content production.

title: Unleashing the Capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models for Intelligent Perception of Roadside Infrastructure
summary: Automated perception of urban roadside infrastructure is crucial for smart city management, yet general-purpose models often struggle to capture the necessary fine-grained attributes and domain rules. While Large Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel at open-world recognition, they often struggle to accurately interpret complex facility states in compliance with engineering standards, leading to unreliable performance in real-world applications. To address this, we propose a domain-adapted framework that transforms VLMs into specialized agents for intelligent infrastructure analysis. Our approach integrates a data-efficient fine-tuning strategy with a knowledge-grounded reasoning mechanism. Specifically, we leverage open-vocabulary fine-tuning on Grounding DINO to robustly localize diverse assets with minimal supervision, followed by LoRA-based adaptation on Qwen-VL for deep semantic attribute reasoning. To mitigate hallucinations and enforce professional compliance, we introduce a dual-modality Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) module that dynamically retrieves authoritative industry standards and visual exemplars during inference. Evaluated on a comprehensive new dataset of urban roadside scenes, our framework achieves a detection performance of 58.9 mAP and an attribute recognition accuracy of 95.5%, demonstrating a robust solution for intelligent infrastructure monitoring.

title: Inference-time Physics Alignment of Video Generative Models with Latent World Models
summary: State-of-the-art video generative models produce promising visual content yet often violate basic physics principles, limiting their utility. While some attribute this deficiency to insufficient physics understanding from pre-training, we find that the shortfall in physics plausibility also stems from suboptimal inference strategies.
